chapters.title: Chapter 251: Road To Strength Begins With Ragebaiting A Dragon
paragraphs: Silas froze mid-breath.
He stared at the serene loving expression on the Nature Goddess’s face with his brain processing her words for two seconds before a deadpan bewildered thought crossed his mind.

’...Wait a minute,’ Silas thought dryly with an eyebrow twitching. ’Even if I’m in a female disguise, my internal soul is still 100% male... but from an outside perspective, if she’s kissing a female body and enjoying it... doesn’t that just make her low-key gay?’
Before Silas could voice his strange philosophical realization out loud—
CLICK
The heavy timber double doors of the Keep swung open smoothly.
Aeliana stepped out onto the porch, carrying a wooden ledger in her hands.
The silver-haired elven arcanist wore a bright radiant smile as her silver eyes landed on Silas holding Eluned in his arms.
"Welcome back, Lord Silas!" Aeli greeted him melodically, stepping down the stone stairs.
Silas set Eluned back down on her feet, turning his head toward his head arcanist.

"Good to be back, Aeli," Silas replied, his posture straightening. He looked at her seriously, adding, "By the way, Aeli... when our official Lord War commences next week, you are going to have to hide your face and physical identity completely if you want to participate on the battlefield."
Aeli paused, tilting her head. "Hide my identity?"

"Yes," Silas nodded firmly. "Lord Sky’s camera drones will be broadcasting the entire war live to Earth. Everyone in the Secret Realm already knows that you are the Hero bound to Silas Graves. If you appear on camera in your normal form, the government will instantly connect Blessed Land directly to my real-world identity."
Hearing his concern, Aeli suddenly let out a bizarre and slightly strange chuckle.

"Fuhufu~" Aeli giggled softly with a proud triumphant glint shining in her eyes. "Lord Silas... you truly underestimate your head Secretary! I foresaw this exact dilemma hours ago, and I have already devised the ultimate flawless disguise!"
Silas blinked his golden eyes in genuine surprise.
’Damn, really?’ Silas thought, impressed. ’She actually thought that far ahead on her own?’
"Observe, My Lord!" Aeli proclaimed proudly, striking a dramatic pose on the stone steps!
She reached behind her back, pulling out a massive bulky neon-yellow-and-black motorized biker’s helmet.
Without a single shred of shame, Aeli jammed the heavy plastic helmet directly over her long silver hair and elven ears, snapping the dark tinted visor shut with a loud sound.
CLICK!

Standing there on the Keep porch in her elegant flowing white arcanist robes topped off with a giant, ridiculous neon-yellow motorcycle helmet, Aeli raised her thumbs into the air and struck a heroic anime pose.

"TA-DAAAA!" Aeli’s voice echoed, completely muffled from inside the thick plastic helmet. "With this headgear, my facial features are completely concealed! Nobody will ever be able to recognize me at all..."
Silas stood completely frozen on the porch.
Beside him, Eluned stared at the helmeted elf in deadpan speechless silence.
Even Valkyrie, the massive Alpha wolf mate resting nearby slowly turned her heavy head, giving Aeli a disappointed and judgment-filled wolf look that practically screamed.
’Are you serious right now?’
Silas let out a long weary sigh, walking over to the posing elven arcanist.

"Aeli..." Silas said deadpan, reaching his hand out toward her chest. "A disguise is supposed to cover your entire body, your clothing, your mana signature, and your silhouette... putting a motorcycle helmet over your head while wearing your bright white elven robes doesn’t hide anything."
To emphasize his point, Silas reached out to tap her shoulder but because Aeli was wearing a bulky helmet that threw off her physical proportion, his fingers accidentally miscalculated the distance.
POKE.
Silas’s index finger pressed directly into the soft center of Aeli’s left chest plump through her thin silk tunic, right over her sensitive nipple.

"Mmmph~?!" Aeli let out a sharp muffled squeak of embarrassment from inside the helmet with her entire body going completely rigid as a bright crimson flush exploded across her face behind the dark visor.
Silas instantly yanked his hand back, coughing awkwardly as he rubbed the back of his neck.
"Ahem! Sorry, bad angle," Silas cleared his throat quickly. "My point stands. You need a proper full-body concealment spell or an actual artifact tunic."

"A-Ah! Y-Yes! Of course, My Lord!" Aeli stammered frantically from inside the helmet, her muffled voice trembling with embarrassment. "It... it’s a work in progress! I was planning on layering spatial camouflage spells over it! I’m going to consult Thora right now!"
Without waiting for another word, the bright-red elven arcanist turned on her heel and sprinted frantically across the courtyard toward the Foundry, still wearing the giant neon motorcycle helmet.
Silas watched her disappear into the forge, letting out a short fond chuckle as he shook his head.
He turned back toward Valkyrie, walking over and gently patting the massive wolf behind her ears.
"Thanks for the hard run, Valkyrie," Silas smiled. "Go ahead and take a break."
GRRR-RUFF!
Valkyrie let out a happy bark, turning and trotting off toward the eastern lawn where her three direwolf pups were playfully tumbling in the grass.
Silas turned his attention back to Eluned, who was standing beside him swinging her arms softly.

"Eluned," Silas instructed warmly. "While Tasmin is coordinating the communication links, I need you to help oversee the central drop-off zone. When Morwenna, Brida, and the other hunting teams return today, help them unload and organize all the monster carcasses so we can sort the trade rations for Sky."
"Consider it done, My Lord!" Eluned answered cheerfully.
Silas looked down at the sweet devoted Nature Goddess, feeling a sudden surge of deep affection.
He reached out with his broad hand, wrapping his arm firmly around her waist and pulling her body flush against his hip.
Before she could react, Silas reached down with his hand, giving her plump, soft rear a firm deliberate squeeze.
"Ahhn~!" Eluned let out a loud and deeply melodious moan with her cheeks turning bright pink as her body went weak against his chest.
Silas leaned down close to her ear, his deep voice dropping into a low and dangerously seductive whisper that made her toes curl inside her shoes.
"As an additional reward for creating that amazing barrier today... tonight, Elu... I will do anything you want."
Eluned’s breath completely hitched in her throat.

Her green eyes widened to the size of dinner plates as her heart hammered violently against her ribs like a trapped bird as she looked up at his sharp handsome face with her voice trembling in breathless hopeful disbelief.
"A-Anything...?" Eluned stammered out with her cheeks burning hot. "Y-You promise, My Lord?! You won’t take it back?!"
Silas offered her a confident, wicked smirk, nodding firmly. "I promise. Whatever you want."
Eluned’s face lit up with a radiant smile of pure ecstatic joy as she stood up on her tiptoes, planting a sweet passionate kiss right on his cheek.
"I am definitely going to take full advantage of that promise, My Lord!" Eluned giggled happily, stepping back out of his arm. "I’m going to go manage the monster carcasses right now!"
She turned around and skipped cheerfully across the courtyard toward the storage gates with her long silver-green hair bouncing with every step as her mind went into overload.
Inside Eluned’s divine mind, a glorious unstoppable master plan was rapidly taking shape.

’IT’S TIME!’ Eluned cheered internally, her heart singing with pure excitement! ’Tonight... tonight is the night! I am going to make sure my Lord becomes so utterly and completely obsessed with my body that he won’t be able to resist putting a baby inside me!’
The ancient Nature Goddess cutely twiddled her slender thumbs together as she walked, a dreamy blissful blush covering her entire face as her thoughts spiraled into pure adoration.

’Mmm... I really won’t mind bearing one of Silas’s babies at all...’ Eluned thought, her heart swelling with warmth. ’In fact... maybe two babies... Okay, fine, ten babies! Or maybe a hundred at least!’
To an immortal divine deity, bearing a large family for the man she worshipped was the ultimate expression of love.

Silas was already so handsome, brave, and caring... the mere thought of having dozens of tiny, black-haired golden-eyed miniature copies of Silas and herself running around the Keep’s gardens made her soul sing with longing.
’It’s only a matter of time now...’ Eluned squealed internally, hugging her arms tightly around her chest. ’I can’t wait for tonight!’
Standing on the porch of the Keep, Silas watched Eluned skip away with a strangely energetic bounce in her step.
He let out a long but fond sigh, shaking his head as he pulled the black disguise ring out of his pocket and inspected the dark metal band in his palm.
’I need to practice using this transformation ring a lot more...’ Silas reflected with his mind shifting into high-gear preparation.

Over the next six days leading up to the Lord War, he didn’t just have to manage massive architectural renovations, build new residential barracks for seventy-two incoming female troops, and spend his overflowing Upgrade Points on S-Rank ascensions... he also had to completely master fighting inside Vespera’s physical vessel.
In a high-stakes broadcast battle against an undefeated Classic Lord, he couldn’t afford a single moment of physical clumsiness, awkward balance, or telegraphing movement.
Vespera’s body had to look like a natural master of the blade... not a temporary disguise worn by a six-foot-two man.

’Not only do I need to master her single-armed center of gravity,’ Silas analyzed in his thoughts. ’but I also need a controlled environment where I can practice wielding my newly acquired Tier 3 elemental spells at full combat output without blowing up my own Keep walls...’
Silas turned around, pushing open the heavy timber doors and stepping into the quiet, cool interior of the Keep’s main hall.
He climbed the grand wooden staircase, ascending up to the second floor corridor.
As he walked down the torch-lit hallway toward his private quarters, he passed by an open doorway near the end of the hall.
Silas paused, glancing casually inside the room.
Sprawled out across a massive, plush king-sized bed in the center of the room was Talira... the Primordial Crimson Dragon.

The red-haired dragoness was wearing a loose silk tunic, lying flat on her back across the soft blankets with her long legs kicked out, staring up at the wooden ceiling rafters with a long and exasperated sigh.
"Ughhhh..." Talira groaned aloud to the empty room, flopping her arm dramatically over her face. "I am so bored... there is literally nothing to burn around here..."
Silas stood in the hallway doorway, staring at the lazy dragoness.
A sudden and wickedly brilliant glint flashed inside his golden-ringed eyes as a slow mischievous smirk spread across his face.
’Oh,’ Silas thought triumphantly. ’Jackpot.’
BANG!
Silas violently kicked the heavy oak door wide open, letting it slam hard against the stone wall.
Talira startled, snapping her head toward the doorway as her vertical dragon pupils slit in surprise.
Silas stepped into the room, crossing his broad arms over his chest as he looked down at the lounging dragon with an uncompromising glare.

"It’s high time you begin working for your keep around here, Talira!" Silas announced loudly with his voice booming through the bedroom. "Get off your lazy ass! You think it’s easy feeding an appetite of a giant dragon such as yourself?!"

Talira sat up slowly on the edge of the plush mattress, her glowing crimson eyes narrowing into sharp vertical slits as she glared at the man who had just kicked her bedroom door open with an obnoxious bang.
Her fiery red hair tumbled wildly over her bare shoulders, and her spade-like tail swished agitatedly against the silk sheets.

Just because she had developed a subtle burning curiosity about him... just because he was vastly different from the cruel treacherous humans her mother had warned her about before dying inside that suffocating sealed dimension did not mean she was going to tolerate blatant disrespect from that same human.
She was an adult Primordial Crimson Dragon.
Her bloodline was ancient, her pride was absolute, and she was nobody’s pet.
"Get away from me," Talira spat. "I am not taking orders from you, human! I don’t give a damn what you want, and I certainly do not respect you!"
Silas didn’t back down an inch.
He stood in the doorway with his broad arms crossed over his chest with his golden-ringed eyes looking down at her with a thoroughly unimpressed deadpan stare.

"What is there not to respect about me?" Silas countered flatly, stepping into the room. "I feed you meat every single day. I give you clean water to drink. I gave you a soft bed and a roof over your head and the women you’ve come to see as your sisters in this Keep are my loyal subjects."
Talira gritted her sharp white fangs with the air around her body spiking in temperature as a subtle heat haze distorted the furniture.
"That doesn’t mean you own me!" Talira growled defensively, her fingernails elongating into razor-sharp black talons that bit into the wooden headboard.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Lord Vs. Dragon [I]
paragraphs: "I’m not asking to own you," Silas said, resting his hand on his hip as his eyes scanned her lounging figure. "I’m telling you that we’re about to go to war with another territory in six days... Once we win, our boundaries will expand again, and our influence in the Sovereign Realm will skyrocket. I want to bring you along to intimidate them with your true form and if things get rough, maybe you can actually fight alongside us instead of lounging on my silk sheets all day."
Talira stared at him in utter mind-boggling disbelief with her vertical dragon pupils dilating in shock.
’A Saint?!’ Talira screamed inside her own mind, remembering Aeliana’s passionate speech back inside the sealed artifact. ’Aeliana called this guy a Saint?! He is no Saint! He’s a complete devil!’
Just because he didn’t walk around with a cackling evil villain smile plastered across his face didn’t make him any less terrifyingly ambitious.
He was actively looking to hoard dozens of new people into his territory, expand his empire, and use a primordial dragon as a giant winged vector of fear to make it happen.

"You want me to fight for you?!" Talira demanded loudly, springing off the bed as her crimson eyes flashed with fierce battle-hunger. "Then defeat me in a battle first before any of these things! Until you beat me with your own hands, I won’t move a single muscle for your petty war!"
Talira was confident in many things, but martial combat was at the very top of her list.
She was an apex predator born of ancient dragon blood.

As long as she wasn’t forced to fight Lady Eluned, Lady Morwenna, or Aeliana... the three terrifying monsters in this Keep who could manipulate divine nature, tides, or spatial freeze...Talira was 100% sure that she would be completely fine against a human Lord!
Silas looked at her fierce confident posture and let out a dry smirk.
"A duel? That’s fine by me," Silas accepted effortlessly, rolling his broad shoulders. "I’ve been needing a solid workout to test out a few things anyway."
Then, Silas paused, rubbing his chin with his calloused hand as he ran into a glaring logistical problem.

’Where the hell are we supposed to fight?’ Silas thought, scanning the bedroom. ’The underground training vault downstairs is sturdy, but can that place handle her true dragon form without collapsing the Keep’s stone foundations? There’s also the stadium outside, but I’d prefer somewhere I can move freely and unleash high-tier elemental spells without Lord Sky’s high-altitude recon drones picking up our mana signatures...’
He needed a secure isolated space where he could go all out without destroying his own property or exposing his trump cards to the outside world.
CREAK!
Silas’s sharp ears picked up a tiny hesitant sound near the doorway.
He turned his head slightly, noticing a lock of long silver hair and a single wide green eye peeking out from around the wooden doorframe.
"Aeli?" Silas called out smoothly. "Do you have a solution for this?"
Aeliana flinched violently, her entire body freezing behind the door.
She gasped softly with her pale cheeks turning bright crimson as she realized she had been caught red-handed while eavesdropping.
"I-I’m not here!" Aeli stammered out frantically from behind the wood, her voice becoming high-pitched and flustered.
She took a panicked step backward, realized how completely ridiculous that sounded, and sheepishly stepped into the room.
Aeli held her hands neatly behind her back, looking down at the floorboards with an embarrassed adorable smile.

"I... I mean... I happened to be passing by, My Lord," Aeli mumbled, clearing her throat to regain her dignified composure. "And... I actually do have a skill that can handle the battle cleanly. But..."
She peeked up at Silas through her long eyelashes, a sly, sweet glint touching her silver eyes.
"...I want a reward if I manage to do it, Lord Silas."
Silas raised an eyebrow, amused by her bold request. "What reward do you want, Aeli?"
Aeli’s cheeks flushed a deeper shade of pink, her slender fingers fidgeting together behind her back.

"I... I just want to spend some quality time with my Lord," Aeli requested softly, her melodic voice dripping with sweet affection. "Maybe... the next time you go out to negotiate with the other Lord, or when you visit the outer borders... I could come along with you?"
Silas smiled warmly, stepping forward and gently tapping her nose with his finger.
"Deal," Silas agreed without a second of hesitation. "You’ve got yourself a date."
Aeli’s entire face lit up with a breathtaking, radiant smile of pure joy as she clasped her hands over her chest, practically floating on air.

"Thank you, My Lord!" Aeli beamed happily. "I have developed a brand-new, high-tier spatial domain spell... a pocket dimension dome! It will be big enough for the both of you to fight to your hearts’ content without damaging a single pebble in the territory!"
Silas patted her head, praising her genuinely. "Good work, Aeli. Lead the way."
Talira looked at the elven arcanist with her sharp dragon eyes softening slightly.
"Thank you, Aeliana," the dragoness murmured, respecting the elf’s incredible spatial mastery.

A short while later, the three of them stood inside the heavy stone training vault located in the lower basement of the Keep... the exact same vault where Silas had previously practiced his nature magic control.

Silas and Talira walked out into the spacious center of the room, standing fifty paces apart and eyeing each other down, while Aeliana positioned herself far over to the right side, near the entry archway.
Aeli took a deep breath with her silver hair lifting off her shoulders as a serene focus settled over her features.
She raised both of her slender hands into the air with her voice echoing clearly.
"Dome!"
FLASH!
The world turned completely white.

A massive blinding dome of pure spatial energy expanded outward from her palms in a fraction of a second with The damp granite walls, the stone ceiling, and the dirt floor of the basement vault vanished entirely, replaced by a boundless pristine white world that seemed to have no physical limit.
Silas blinked, looking around in utter amazement.
There were no walls, no ceilings, no environmental obstacles, and no horizon... it was just a vast solid white plane beneath their boots that felt completely unbreakable.
Aeli stood near the edge of the light with her face slightly pale from the sudden mana drain, but her eyes were filled with fierce determination.
"I will use this chance to train myself so I can maintain this domain for much longer, My Lord!" Aeli called out, her voice echoing through the endless white expanse.
Looking at the boundless spatial dimension his head arcanist had summoned out of thin air, Silas felt a deep sense of conviction.
’She’s getting insanely versatile,’ Silas thought with his golden-ringed eyes shining. ’I’m more and more convinced that I need to make her S-Rank as soon as possible.’
Silas reached into his pocket, pulling out the dark black metal disguise ring. He slipped the band smoothly onto his ring finger.
BOOM!

A dense violent surge of royal purple mana erupted around his frame, twisting his physical height, compressing his broad shoulders, dissolving his left arm into an empty rolling black sleeve, and shifting his golden eyes into a deep, luminous shade of violet.
When the light cleared, Silas was gone. Standing in the center of the white void was Vespera... the black-haired, single-armed female Lord.
Talira stared at the transformation, letting out a loud contemptuous dragon snort as red smoke curled from her nostrils.
"Hmph! What a ridiculous trick!" Talira shouted with her voice booming across the white expanse. "Even if you become a woman, your power is not increasing regardless!"
Vespera reached down with her single right hand, drawing her Tier 2 silver longsword from its sheath with a sharp ringing metallic sound.
She tilted her head, her deep purple eyes sparkling with a cold provocative smile.
"And even if you become a dragon," Vespera retorted smoothly. "your intellect is not increasing regardless!"
"WHY YOU...!" Talira shrieked in explosive rage.
CRACK! SNAP! BOOM!
Talira’s human body violently tore apart.

Her spine elongated, her pale skin burst into thousands of dense, volcanic-red scales as her jaw unhinged into a terrifying reptilian snout and two massive swept-back black horns sprouted from her skull.
Within seconds, her human form was completely gone.
Standing in the white void was the true magnificent form of the Primordial Crimson Dragon!

She was the size of a massive fortress wing, her fifty-foot wingspan spreading wide, casting a heavy shadow across the white ground as her long spiked tail whipped through the air like a wrecking ball.
ROOOOOAAAR!
Talira unleashed an earth-shattering dragon roar that sent visible sonic shockwaves tearing across the white dimension.
STOMP!
Her massive multi-ton clawed feet slammed into the ground, shattering the white space beneath her boots as she shot forward like a crimson volcanic missile, aiming to crush Vespera into the floor.
"DIE, HUMAN!" Talira screamed mid-charge with her dual-harmonic voice shaking the void as the battle had officially begun!
Talira reached Vespera in less than a second with her massive right claw sweeping downward in a lethal horizontal arc aimed to disembowel the female Lord.
WHOOSH!
Vespera didn’t try to block the multi-ton dragon claw with her blade.
Instead, she pushed off her right boot, fully utilizing her newly transformed and lightweight female body.
Because this vessel was significantly lighter than her original six-foot-two male frame, her agility and rotational speed were absolute insanity.
With zero left-arm mass to drag her balance down, Vespera spun her body like a streamlined top, slipping cleanly underneath Talira’s massive claws by a fraction of an inch.

’Whoa...!’ Vespera thought with her purple eyes widening in shock as she drifted through the air. ’Now that I think about it... The center of gravity in this body is ridiculously compact! Because I don’t have a second hand, my weight distribution is completely centralized! I can change directional angles mid-air almost instantaneously without telegraphing...’
Having realized the unique mobility advantages of her single-armed female disguise, Vespera capitalized immediately.
SWISH!

While floating mid-air beside Talira’s massive scale-armored neck, Vespera funneled a dense tide of her Gold Core mana into her single right arm, igniting her silver longsword in a blazing pillar of compressed white-hot flames.
’Blaze Strike!’ Vespera thought. ’It’s time to start using spells...!’
BOOM!
Vespera executed a single-handed high-speed horizontal slash directly against Talira’s neck scales.
The compressed fire edge detonated on impact, sending a massive shower of orange sparks and scorching heat blasting across the dragon’s neck!
CLANG!
The blade connected solidly, but Talira’s primordial crimson scales were hyper-dense.
The attack left a dark, smoking scorch mark across her neck armor, but failed to cut deep into her flesh.
"HA! IS THAT ALL YOU’VE GOT?!" Talira roared with her massive dragon head snapping around with terrifying speed.
SWOOSH!
Talira whipped her massive, fifty-foot spiked tail around in a wide vertical arc, smashing it down toward Vespera like a falling iron pillar.
"Not even close!" Vespera countered smoothly.
FWOOSH!
Vespera activated her next elemental spell, wrapping her entire female body in a dense, swirling cloak of roaring defensive fire.
’Mantle of the Inferno!’ Vespera thought.
The roaring fire cloak exploded around her frame, absorbing the impact of Talira’s spiked tail.
BANG!
The massive tail slammed into the fire barrier blasting Vespera backward through the air, but the aura completely deflected the razor-sharp dragon spikes from tearing her skin.
Vespera tumbled three times through the air, adjusting her footing and landing lightly on her boots eighty paces away.
She looked at her single right hand with her violet eyes gleaming as a fundamental realization about the fire element flashed through her mind mid-fight.

’Fire... huh? It doesn’t feel like just raw destruction, at least that’s what the textbooks used to say...’ Silas realized deeply inside his disguise. ’When compressed through a single conduit, fire mana acts like a pressurized liquid plasma shield! It expands outward to repel heavy physical mass... That’s the whole thing about the mantle.’
Across the white field, Talira’s glowing crimson eyes burned with fierce competitive fury.
She spread her massive wings wide, beating them violently.
FLAP! FLAP!
A terrifying superheated gale of wind swept across the arena as Talira opened her massive jaws wide.
Deep within her throat, a blinding sphere of white-hot, volcanic dragon fire began to condense at high speed.
"BURN TO ASH!" Talira screamed.
ROAR!

Talira unleashed her iconic apocalyptic dragon breath as a colossal, fifty-foot-wide river of white-hot volcanic fire erupted from her mouth, surging across the white dimension to incinerate Vespera entirely.
’Is it just me or are Dragons too overpowered? Maybe I made a mistake being reborn as a Human...’
Vespera stood her ground with her purple eyes narrowing into sharp slits.
She raised her single longsword, aligning the steel directly with her eye line as she channeled her Gold Core mana into a concentrated beam.
’Incineration Ray!’ Vespera thought.
KRA-THOOM!
A hyper-concentrated razor-thin needle of pure, blinding white laser-fire shot out from the tip of Vespera’s longsword.
Instead of trying to overwhelm Talira’s massive fifty-foot sea of flames with equal volume, Vespera’s attack acted like a high-precision scalpel.

The laser beam pierced cleanly into the center of the incoming dragon fire, cutting directly through the core of the inferno and splitting Talira’s dragon breath into two harmless streams that roared past Vespera’s left and right sides.
BOOOOOM!

I want to bring you along to intimidate them with your true form and if things get rough, maybe you can actually fight alongside us instead of lounging on my silk sheets all day."
Talira stared at him in utter mind-boggling disbelief with her vertical dragon pupils dilating in shock.
’A Saint?!’ Talira screamed inside her own mind, remembering Aeliana’s passionate speech back inside the sealed artifact. ’Aeliana called this guy a Saint?!

"Then defeat me in a battle first before any of these things!

Talira was confident in many things, but martial combat was at the very top of her list.
She was an apex predator born of ancient dragon blood.

Aeli held her hands neatly behind her back, looking down at the floorboards with an embarrassed adorable smile.
I mean...
I happened to be passing by, My Lord," Aeli mumbled, clearing her throat to regain her dignified composure.
"And...
I actually do have a skill that can handle the battle cleanly.
But..."
She peeked up at Silas through her long eyelashes, a sly, sweet glint touching her silver eyes.
"...I want a reward if I manage to do it, Lord Silas."
Silas raised an eyebrow, amused by her bold request.
"What reward do you want, Aeli?"
Aeli’s cheeks flushed a deeper shade of pink, her slender fingers fidgeting together behind her back.
I just want to spend some quality time with my Lord," Aeli requested softly, her melodic voice dripping with sweet affection.
"Maybe... the next time you go out to negotiate with the other Lord, or when you visit the outer borders...
I could come along with you?"
Silas smiled warmly, stepping forward and gently tapping her nose with his finger.
"Deal," Silas agreed without a second of hesitation.
"You’ve got yourself a date."
Aeli’s entire face lit up with a breathtaking, radiant smile of pure joy as she clasped her hands over her chest, practically floating on air.
"Thank you, My Lord!" Aeli beamed happily.
"I have developed a brand-new, high-tier spatial domain spell... a pocket dimension dome!
It will be big enough for the both of you to fight to your hearts’ content without damaging a single pebble in the territory!"
Silas patted her head, praising her genuinely.
"Good work, Aeli.
Lead the way."
Talira looked at the elven arcanist with her sharp dragon eyes softening slightly.
"Thank you, Aeliana," the dragoness murmured, respecting the elf’s incredible spatial mastery.

A short while later, the three of them stood inside the heavy stone training vault located in the lower basement of the Keep... the exact same vault where Silas had previously practiced his nature magic control.

Silas and Talira walked out into the spacious center of the room, standing fifty paces apart and eyeing each other down, while Aeliana positioned herself far over to the right side, near the entry archway.
Aeli took a deep breath with her silver hair lifting off her shoulders as a serene focus settled over her features.
She raised both of her slender hands into the air with her voice echoing clearly.
"Dome!"
FLASH!
The world turned completely white.

A massive blinding dome of pure spatial energy expanded outward from her palms in a fraction of a second with The damp granite walls, the stone ceiling, and the dirt floor of the basement vault vanished entirely, replaced by a boundless pristine white world that seemed to have no physical limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Lord Vs. Dragon [II]
paragraphs: The split dragon fire detonated against the far boundary of Aeli’s white dome, illuminating the void in blinding red light.
"WHAT?!" Talira gasped in complete shock with her dragon eyes bulging.
Before Talira could shut her jaws, Vespera blurred into motion.
WHOOSH!
Using her single-armed lightweight acceleration, Vespera closed the eighty-pace distance in less than a heartbeat, appearing directly beneath Talira’s towering chest.
Driving her right boot into the white ground, Vespera channeled earth mana directly beneath the dragon’s feet.
’Obsidian Impaler!’ Vespera thought.
CRACK! CRACK! CRACK!

The white floor beneath Talira violently ruptured as five massive, fifteen-foot-tall spears of razor-sharp, compressed obsidian glass erupted directly out of the ground beneath her belly, thrusting upward like dark spears.
BANG! BANG! BANG!
The obsidian spears struck Talira’s underbelly scales with terrifying force.
While they didn’t impale through her dragon heart, the raw explosive thrust lifted the multi-ton dragon off her feet, forcing her massive body backward and making her lose her balance.
"AGHHH!" Talira shrieked in pain and frustration.
Inside her mind, the dragon’s pride was burning to a crisp... She was getting out-maneuvered, out-smarted, and pushed back by a single-armed human wearing a woman’s body?
’NO!’ Talira screamed internally with her dragon heart pounding violently! ’I AM A PRIMORDIAL CRIMSON DRAGON! I WILL NOT LOSE TO A HUMAN...!’
BOOM!
Suddenly, a violent miraculous evolution erupted from deep within Talira’s ancient bloodline.
The perks of dragon biology... rapid combat growth and instantaneous cellular adaptation triggered under the overwhelming stress of the battle.
Talira’s massive crimson body violently expanded as her physical scale grew twenty percent larger, her wingspan stretching out to over seventy feet.
Her scales hardened into an even darker, volcanic black-crimson hue, and two additional swept-back horns sprouted from her skull.
And even more terrifyingly... a brand-new elemental aura ignited around her wings!
FWOOSH!
’This is just cheating, isn’t i—’
A roaring destructive cyclone of compressed, emerald-green wind mana suddenly erupted around Talira’s body, fusing seamlessly with her volcanic fire.
She had unlocked her secondary draconic element mid-combat... True Wind Magic.
"ROAAAAAR!" Talira roared, her expanded, dual-harmonic voice shaking the entire spatial dome! "FEEL THE POWER OF A TRUE DRAGON!"
Talira flapped her massive seventy-foot wings as the newly awakened wind mana amplified her aerial velocity tenfold.
She shot forward at Mach 3 speed with her massive form turning into a terrifying blur of fire and green wind.
"TAKE THIS! TAKE THIS! TAKE THIS!"
She unleashed a barrage of supersonic claw slashes and wind-blade waves that tore across the white dimension.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
"DIE! DIE! DIE!" Talira screamed continuously with her battle cries filling the void as her skills grew sharper by the second.
Vespera’s purple eyes lit up with intense ecstatic thrill as she felt her core throb.
"YES! THAT’S IT, TALIRA! SHOW ME MORE!" Vespera shouted back as she didn’t retreat an inch. She leaned into the storm of wind and fire, engaging her own wind techniques!
SWOOSH!
Swinging her sword in a wide vertical arc, Vespera fired off her wind blade.
’Gale Guillotine!’ Vespera thought!
A massive sixty-foot razor blade of emerald wind shot out, colliding against Talira’s incoming wind-blade waves.
BOOM!
The sound echoed, shattering both spells into swirling gusts of air.
As Talira closed the distance, attempting to crush her with a massive, multi-ton claw slam, Vespera thrust her single palm forward.
’Hurricane Repulsion!’ Vespera thought.
BANG!
’I can finally understand what Mages with multiple kinds of spells feel in situations like this.’
They were simply too many options to choose from... It was madness to not pick one!

An atmospheric shockwave of pressurized air erupted from Vespera’s palm, striking Talira’s massive claw mid-air and forcing the strike three feet off target, causing the giant claws to smash harmlessly into the white floor.
CRASH!
’I’m still concerned on how Aeli is maintaining this, regardless...’
Vespera didn’t waste a single millisecond.

She tapped into her Gold Core’s highest-voltage lightning affinity as jagged roaring arcs of royal purple and golden electricity instantly erupted across her entire female body, coiling around her longsword like striking serpents.
Inside her mind, Silas was rapidly connecting the dots of lightning physics... like he had been doing with the other elements.

’Lightning isn’t just about speed or raw damage...’ Silas realized with clarity. ’It’s about continuous chain-reaction execution! It flows like liquid through nervous pathways which is why Harper moves the way she does...’
It felt so exhilarating...
’Thunderclap Blitz!’ Vespera thought.
KRA-THOOM!

Vespera turned into a literal bolt of golden-purple lightning as she executed nine instantaneous, supersonic dashes through the air, appearing at nine different spatial angles around Talira’s massive dragon body in less than half a minute.
ZIP! ZIP! ZIP!
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
With every single dash, Vespera delivered a brutal single-handed sword strike against Talira’s joints, wing-hinges, and neck scales.
Sparks exploded into the air like fireworks as the rapid-fire lightning strikes rattled Talira’s massive frame, overriding her nervous system with high-voltage paralysis.
"AAGHH! STOP! STOP MOVING SO FAST!" Talira shrieked, thrashing her head wildly as blue-and-gold electricity crackled across her scales.
Appearing directly above Talira’s massive dragon head, Vespera held her longsword vertically, pointing the tip directly down at the dragon’s skull.
’Voltaic Execution Chain!’ Vespera thought!
BOOOOOOM!
A massive lightning-bolt chain of pure electric energy shot out from her sword, impaling directly into Talira’s head and chaining down her entire spine all the way to her tail.
The high-voltage load locked Talira’s muscles in place, preventing her from flapping her wings or moving her claws.
"AHHHHHHHH!!!!"
’I think... I can chain the last one into it too!’ Vespera’s eyes were glowing gold now, she seemed to have grasped it once more...
That same epiphany!
Channeling every single drop of her remaining lightning mana into her single right hand, Vespera gathered a colossal sun-like sphere of blinding apocalyptic purple-and-gold electricity over her head!
’Fulgur Annihilation!’ Vespera thought!
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Vespera drove the massive sphere of destruction straight down into Talira’s back.
A cataclysmic explosion of blinding light, roaring thunder, and destructive shockwaves erupted across the entire white spatial dome.
"AAAAAGGGGGHHHHHHH!"

Talira let out a long earth-shaking shriek of defeat as the overwhelming, apocalyptic lightning blast completely shattered her draconic defensive wards, fried her core reserves, and sent her multi-ton dragon body crashing violently down onto the white floor.
CRASH! RUMBLE!
"Augh!" Aeli grunted but she held strong as the cracks repaired almost instantly, she was being motivated by the very thought of not disappointing Silas.
The massive crimson dragon hit the ground hard, skidding three hundred meters across the white void before coming to a complete, motionless halt.
The blinding light slowly faded as the crackling thunder died down into quiet static.
Vespera landed lightly on her boots fifty paces away with her breath coming in heavy, steady gasps.
Her black shirt was slightly torn at the shoulder, and a deep bruise was forming along her ribs where a stray wind-wave had grazed her.
Quietly engaging her healing spell, Vespera let the golden light wash over her frame.
’Radiant Cellular Reconstruction,’ Vespera thought softly.

A gentle soothing golden aura wrapped around her female body. In a fraction of a second, the deep bruise on her ribs vanished, her torn muscle fibers re-knit themselves, and her physical stamina was instantly fully restored.
’No wonder people that can use Light magic are sought after... fucking cheaters. This means I should be able to use buff skills too.’
Over near the fallen dragon, a bright crimson light flared.
FLASH!
Unable to maintain the immense mana cost of her true form any longer, Talira’s massive seventy-foot dragon body dissolved into glowing red spirit particles.
When the light faded, Talira was back in her human form.
She was kneeling on her hands and knees on the white floor, wearing her torn silk tunic as her body trembling uncontrollably from total mana exhaustion.
Blood was trickling from the corner of her dark lips, her fiery red hair was messy and scorched, and her crimson eyes were wide and filled with dazed disbelief.
Her draconic power was completely exhausted.
Yet... her stubborn, ancient dragon pride refused to let her yield.
"I... I can still... fight...!" Talira gasped out, her voice raspy and weak.
Using the last sliver of her physical muscle strength, Talira pushed herself off the ground.
She staggered forward on wobbling legs, raising her trembling, pale fists to throw a desperate feral punch straight toward Vespera’s face.
"I WON’T SUBMIT TO A HUMAN!" Talira screamed weakly.
SWISH!
Vespera didn’t even raise a weapon.
With effortless single-armed duelist precision, Vespera simply sidestepped the slow exhausted punch.
She caught Talira’s outstretched wrist with her single right hand, gently redirecting the dragoness’s forward momentum.
As Talira overshot her balance and began falling forward into the empty air, completely spent—
SWOOP.
Vespera reached out her single right arm, wrapping it firmly and securely around Talira’s slender waist.
She pulled the exhausted red-haired dragoness tightly against her chest, holding her securely in a warm protective embrace before her knees could touch the cold floor.
Talira’s head flopped weakly against Vespera’s shoulder with her breathing heavy.
The violent, feral rage that had consumed her mind for centuries was completely gone, replaced by a strange and deeply comforting sense of safety.
’Wha... What is this...’
Vespera looked down at the battered, trembling dragoness resting in her single arm.
She reached up with her fingers, gently stroking Talira’s messy red hair with a soft, warm, and genuinely fond smile.
"You did good, Talira," Vespera praised her gently, her raspy female voice dropping into a low whisper right beside her ear.
She tightened her grip around the dragon’s waist, adding with a firm promise.
"You fought like a true queen today. But from now on... you better listen to your Lord."
Talira rested her head heavily against Vespera’s shoulder.
She felt the warm unshakeable strength of the person holding her.
She felt the gentle, soothing touch stroking her hair. For the first time since her mother had passed away hundreds of years ago... the lonely traumatized dragoness felt seen once more.
A single warm tear slipped from Talira’s crimson eye, tracing down her pale cheek.
Her vision began to blur into dark peaceful shadows as blissful exhaustion finally overtook her core.
As her consciousness slowly drifted away into sleep, a quiet thought echoed through the quiet sanctuary of her fading mind.
’Yes... My... Lor—’
Vespera caught Talira smoothly with her single arm locked like a vise around the dragoness’s waist as the last sparks of crimson mana dissolved into the air.
With a soft exhaled breath, she turned and handed the limp, exhausted red-haired girl over to Aeli.
Aeli caught Talira under her shoulders, supporting the dragoness’s weight with ease.
The elven arcanist raised her free hand, snapping her fingers with a soft resonant bell tone.
WHOOSH!
The infinite white spatial dome violently collapsed inward with the blinding expanse dissolving into particles of light.
In a fraction of a second, the familiar stone walls, cold granite floor, and damp air of the Keep’s training vault returned around them.
"An absolutely magnificent performance, My Lord," Aeli praised warmly, looking over at Vespera with eyes sparkling with adoration.
She reached up with her slender hand, gently tapping Vespera’s head in an affectionate praise-filled gesture that made the Lord’s eyelids twitch slightly.
Vespera reached for her left hand, slipping off the black metal ring.
FLASH!

A brief brilliant burst of golden Gold Core mana surged around her frame. Her height stretched back out to six-foot-two, her shoulders broadened, her left arm materialized back into place, and her golden-ringed eyes returned to their natural state.
Silas slumped back against the stone wall, sliding down until his rear hit the cold floor.
He let out a long, heavy sigh, rolling his muscular shoulders.
"Phew..." Silas muttered, running a hand through his dark hair. "That was... quite the workout."
Silas closed his eyes, leaning his head back against the granite blocks. Inside his chest, he could feel his core thrumming violently.
The volume of mana he had cycled during that high-intensity clash with Talira was causing his Gold Core to vibrate with a deep liquid warmth.
’I’m so damn close...’ Silas thought, his mind tracking his internal progress.
He was standing right on the precipice of reaching the second stage of Core Advancement.
Breaking through that threshold would grant him a massive, astronomical permanent boost of 30,000 points of raw mana.
To finally trigger the evolution, he just needed to achieve ’Adept’ mastery in the remaining fundamental elemental branches he had recently acquired.

The intense battle he had just fought... forcing him to rapidly cast, weave, and compress multi-elemental spells through a lightweight single-armed female vessel had accelerated his core’s comprehension at a terrifying rate.

sentences.text: The split dragon fire detonated against the far boundary of Aeli’s white dome, illuminating the void in blinding red light.
"WHAT?!" Talira gasped in complete shock with her dragon eyes bulging.
Before Talira could shut her jaws, Vespera blurred into motion.
WHOOSH!
Using her single-armed lightweight acceleration, Vespera closed the eighty-pace distance in less than a heartbeat, appearing directly beneath Talira’s towering chest.
Driving her right boot into the white ground, Vespera channeled earth mana directly beneath the dragon’s feet.
’Obsidian Impaler!’ Vespera thought.
CRACK!
CRACK!
CRACK!

The white floor beneath Talira violently ruptured as five massive, fifteen-foot-tall spears of razor-sharp, compressed obsidian glass erupted directly out of the ground beneath her belly, thrusting upward like dark spears.
BANG!
BANG!
BANG!
The obsidian spears struck Talira’s underbelly scales with terrifying force.
While they didn’t impale through her dragon heart, the raw explosive thrust lifted the multi-ton dragon off her feet, forcing her massive body backward and making her lose her balance.
"AGHHH!" Talira shrieked in pain and frustration.
Inside her mind, the dragon’s pride was burning to a crisp...
She was getting out-maneuvered, out-smarted, and pushed back by a single-armed human wearing a woman’s body?
’NO!’ Talira screamed internally with her dragon heart pounding violently! ’I AM A PRIMORDIAL CRIMSON DRAGON!
I WILL NOT LOSE TO A HUMAN...!’
BOOM!
Suddenly, a violent miraculous evolution erupted from deep within Talira’s ancient bloodline.
The perks of dragon biology... rapid combat growth and instantaneous cellular adaptation triggered under the overwhelming stress of the battle.
Talira’s massive crimson body violently expanded as her physical scale grew twenty percent larger, her wingspan stretching out to over seventy feet.
Her scales hardened into an even darker, volcanic black-crimson hue, and two additional swept-back horns sprouted from her skull.
And even more terrifyingly... a brand-new elemental aura ignited around her wings!
FWOOSH!
’This is just cheating, isn’t i—’
A roaring destructive cyclone of compressed, emerald-green wind mana suddenly erupted around Talira’s body, fusing seamlessly with her volcanic fire.
She had unlocked her secondary draconic element mid-combat...
True Wind Magic.
"ROAAAAAR!" Talira roared, her expanded, dual-harmonic voice shaking the entire spatial dome!
"FEEL THE POWER OF A TRUE DRAGON!"
Talira flapped her massive seventy-foot wings as the newly awakened wind mana amplified her aerial velocity tenfold.
She shot forward at Mach 3 speed with her massive form turning into a terrifying blur of fire and green wind.
"TAKE THIS!
TAKE THIS!
TAKE THIS!"
She unleashed a barrage of supersonic claw slashes and wind-blade waves that tore across the white dimension.
SWISH!
SWISH!
SWISH!
"DIE!
DIE!
DIE!" Talira screamed continuously with her battle cries filling the void as her skills grew sharper by the second.
Vespera’s purple eyes lit up with intense ecstatic thrill as she felt her core throb.
"YES!
THAT’S IT, TALIRA!
SHOW ME MORE!" Vespera shouted back as she didn’t retreat an inch.
She leaned into the storm of wind and fire, engaging her own wind techniques!
SWOOSH!
Swinging her sword in a wide vertical arc, Vespera fired off her wind blade.
’Gale Guillotine!’ Vespera thought!
A massive sixty-foot razor blade of emerald wind shot out, colliding against Talira’s incoming wind-blade waves.
BOOM!
The sound echoed, shattering both spells into swirling gusts of air.
As Talira closed the distance, attempting to crush her with a massive, multi-ton claw slam, Vespera thrust her single palm forward.
’Hurricane Repulsion!’ Vespera thought.
BANG!
’I can finally understand what Mages with multiple kinds of spells feel in situations like this.’
They were simply too many options to choose from...
It was madness to not pick one!

An atmospheric shockwave of pressurized air erupted from Vespera’s palm, striking Talira’s massive claw mid-air and forcing the strike three feet off target, causing the giant claws to smash harmlessly into the white floor.
CRASH!
’I’m still concerned on how Aeli is maintaining this, regardless...’
Vespera didn’t waste a single millisecond.

She tapped into her Gold Core’s highest-voltage lightning affinity as jagged roaring arcs of royal purple and golden electricity instantly erupted across her entire female body, coiling around her longsword like striking serpents.
Inside her mind, Silas was rapidly connecting the dots of lightning physics... like he had been doing with the other elements.
’Lightning isn’t just about speed or raw damage...’ Silas realized with clarity. ’It’s about continuous chain-reaction execution!
It flows like liquid through nervous pathways which is why Harper moves the way she does...’
It felt so exhilarating...
’Thunderclap Blitz!’ Vespera thought.
KRA-THOOM!

Vespera turned into a literal bolt of golden-purple lightning as she executed nine instantaneous, supersonic dashes through the air, appearing at nine different spatial angles around Talira’s massive dragon body in less than half a minute.
ZIP!
ZIP!
ZIP!
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
With every single dash, Vespera delivered a brutal single-handed sword strike against Talira’s joints, wing-hinges, and neck scales.
Sparks exploded into the air like fireworks as the rapid-fire lightning strikes rattled Talira’s massive frame, overriding her nervous system with high-voltage paralysis.
"AAGHH!
STOP!
STOP MOVING SO FAST!" Talira shrieked, thrashing her head wildly as blue-and-gold electricity crackled across her scales.
Appearing directly above Talira’s massive dragon head, Vespera held her longsword vertically, pointing the tip directly down at the dragon’s skull.
’Voltaic Execution Chain!’ Vespera thought!
BOOOOOOM!
A massive lightning-bolt chain of pure electric energy shot out from her sword, impaling directly into Talira’s head and chaining down her entire spine all the way to her tail.
The high-voltage load locked Talira’s muscles in place, preventing her from flapping her wings or moving her claws.
"AHHHHHHHH!!!!"
’I think...
I can chain the last one into it too!’ Vespera’s eyes were glowing gold now, she seemed to have grasped it once more...
That same epiphany!
Channeling every single drop of her remaining lightning mana into her single right hand, Vespera gathered a colossal sun-like sphere of blinding apocalyptic purple-and-gold electricity over her head!
’Fulgur Annihilation!’ Vespera thought!
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Vespera drove the massive sphere of destruction straight down into Talira’s back.
A cataclysmic explosion of blinding light, roaring thunder, and destructive shockwaves erupted across the entire white spatial dome.
"AAAAAGGGGGHHHHHHH!"

Talira let out a long earth-shaking shriek of defeat as the overwhelming, apocalyptic lightning blast completely shattered her draconic defensive wards, fried her core reserves, and sent her multi-ton dragon body crashing violently down onto the white floor.
CRASH!
RUMBLE!
"Augh!" Aeli grunted but she held strong as the cracks repaired almost instantly, she was being motivated by the very thought of not disappointing Silas.
The massive crimson dragon hit the ground hard, skidding three hundred meters across the white void before coming to a complete, motionless halt.
The blinding light slowly faded as the crackling thunder died down into quiet static.
Vespera landed lightly on her boots fifty paces away with her breath coming in heavy, steady gasps.
Her black shirt was slightly torn at the shoulder, and a deep bruise was forming along her ribs where a stray wind-wave had grazed her.
Quietly engaging her healing spell, Vespera let the golden light wash over her frame.
’Radiant Cellular Reconstruction,’ Vespera thought softly.
A gentle soothing golden aura wrapped around her female body.
In a fraction of a second, the deep bruise on her ribs vanished, her torn muscle fibers re-knit themselves, and her physical stamina was instantly fully restored.
’No wonder people that can use Light magic are sought after... fucking cheaters.
This means I should be able to use buff skills too.’
Over near the fallen dragon, a bright crimson light flared.
FLASH!
Unable to maintain the immense mana cost of her true form any longer, Talira’s massive seventy-foot dragon body dissolved into glowing red spirit particles.
When the light faded, Talira was back in her human form.
She was kneeling on her hands and knees on the white floor, wearing her torn silk tunic as her body trembling uncontrollably from total mana exhaustion.
Blood was trickling from the corner of her dark lips, her fiery red hair was messy and scorched, and her crimson eyes were wide and filled with dazed disbelief.
Her draconic power was completely exhausted.
Yet... her stubborn, ancient dragon pride refused to let her yield.
I can still... fight...!" Talira gasped out, her voice raspy and weak.
Using the last sliver of her physical muscle strength, Talira pushed herself off the ground.
She staggered forward on wobbling legs, raising her trembling, pale fists to throw a desperate feral punch straight toward Vespera’s face.
"I WON’T SUBMIT TO A HUMAN!" Talira screamed weakly.
SWISH!
Vespera didn’t even raise a weapon.
With effortless single-armed duelist precision, Vespera simply sidestepped the slow exhausted punch.
She caught Talira’s outstretched wrist with her single right hand, gently redirecting the dragoness’s forward momentum.
As Talira overshot her balance and began falling forward into the empty air, completely spent—
SWOOP.
Vespera reached out her single right arm, wrapping it firmly and securely around Talira’s slender waist.
She pulled the exhausted red-haired dragoness tightly against her chest, holding her securely in a warm protective embrace before her knees could touch the cold floor.
Talira’s head flopped weakly against Vespera’s shoulder with her breathing heavy.
The violent, feral rage that had consumed her mind for centuries was completely gone, replaced by a strange and deeply comforting sense of safety.
’Wha...
What is this...’
Vespera looked down at the battered, trembling dragoness resting in her single arm.
She reached up with her fingers, gently stroking Talira’s messy red hair with a soft, warm, and genuinely fond smile.
"You did good, Talira," Vespera praised her gently, her raspy female voice dropping into a low whisper right beside her ear.
She tightened her grip around the dragon’s waist, adding with a firm promise.
"You fought like a true queen today.
But from now on... you better listen to your Lord."

Silas slumped back against the stone wall, sliding down until his rear hit the cold floor.

"Phew..." Silas muttered, running a hand through his dark hair.
"That was... quite the workout."
Silas closed his eyes, leaning his head back against the granite blocks.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Packing
paragraphs: Silas tilted his head back with a thoughtful smirk touching his lips as he analyzed the logic of the whole thing.

’If I already possess Tier 3 spell scrolls for all of these elemental branches,’ Silas reasoned pragmatically inside his thoughts, ’then as long as I actively cast them in battle and truly understand their structural flow... reaching Adept rank should just be a matter of repetition and execution, right?’
It was an avenue he would definitely need to experiment with later tonight or maybe tomorrow.
Silas opened his eyes, looking up at Aeli, who was holding the sleeping dragoness against her side.
"Aeli," Silas commanded smoothly. "Take Talira up to her room and lay her on her bed. And once Thora gets back from her border run... tell her I have a new assignment for her."
Aeli tilted her head, her silver hair swaying. "What kind of assignment, My Lord?"

"I want Thora to begin forging a specialized set of battle armor for Talira," Silas instructed. "It needs to be engraved prominently with the official crest of the Blessed Land. And make sure the design adapts seamlessly when she transforms into her true dragon form... tell Thora to add an extra reinforced, mythril-tipped spike at the end of the tail for maximum impact."
Hearing the sheer tactical savagery of adding a tail-spike to a primordial dragon, Aeli’s eyes lit up. She snapped a sharp, crisp salute, her chest puffing out proudly.
"Consider it done, Lord Silas!" Aeli beamed.
With a subtle shimmer of spatial mana, Aeli activated her short-range teleportation, vanishing from the training vault along with Talira in a flash of silver light.
Left entirely alone in the quiet stone room, Silas let his head fall back against the wall once more.
’So little time...’ Silas thought, feeling a rare wave of mental exhaustion washing over his mind.
There was an overwhelming mountain of tasks piling up on his shoulders.
He had six days left before an undefeated Classic Lord brought a two-hundred-man army and a rolling iron fortress to his front gates.
He had to manage territory expansions, oversee the construction of new residential barracks, train his single-armed disguise, and upgrade his core personnel.
And worse yet... what was going to happen after this Lord War was over?
Eventually, the World Council and the global news networks back on Earth were going to demand an official appearance from ’Lord Vespera.’
He was going to have to navigate high-society politics, corporate headhunters, and international government meetings using a fake, single-armed female identity.
’Man... my life used to be so simple,’ Silas groaned internally, rubbing his temples. ’I just need to close my eyes for a few minutes...’
He didn’t mean to fall asleep.
He just wanted a quick ten-minute breather to clear his head before he had to transform back into Vespera, haul a mountain of raw monster meat, and ride out to meet Lord Sky at the border clearing.
Breathing in the cool air of the vault, Silas let his eyelids drift shut, slipping into a light, peaceful slumber.
A few minutes later, a gentle spatial ripple hummed in the corner of the vault.
Aeli stepped back into the room after safely tucking Talira into her bed.
Seeing her Lord sitting against the stone wall with his eyes closed with his chest rising and falling in steady relaxed rhythms, the arcanist softened her posture completely.
She walked over on silent feet, kneeling down beside him.
With extreme care and gentleness, Aeli reached out, shifting Silas’s upper body so that he was lying flat on his back, placing his head comfortably across both of her soft lap-cushioned thighs.
Aeli looked down at her Lord’s handsome face.
In the dim torchlight of the vault, she could see the faint lines of tension around his eyes... the subtle physical toll of carrying an entire territory’s survival on his shoulders.

"You try far too hard, My Lord..." Aeli whispered softly, her melodic voice filled with an overwhelming heartbreaking tenderness. "You carry everything for all of us... you truly deserve to get some real sleep."
She reached down with her slender fingers, gently brushing a strand of dark hair away from his forehead.
Seeing a small bead of sweat glistening on his jaw from his intense duel with the dragon, Aeli felt a sudden uncontrollable surge of affection rising from the very depths of her soul.
Her breath caught in her throat. Her pale cheeks flushed a delicate pink, her green eyes darkening with a deep light.
Aeli tilted her face forward, leaning down low until her lips brushed against his.
SLURP...
Aeli extended her soft pink tongue, lightly licking across Silas’s lower lip, tasting the salty trace of her Lord’s sweat.
A soft shuddering sigh escaped her throat as she pulled back a fraction of an inch, resting her forehead against his with her heart hammering wildly against her ribs.

’I don’t care about the wars... I don’t care about anything else...’ Aeli thought passionately, staring at his closed eyelids with adoration. ’I just want you to rest... I want to protect your peace forever.’
Later that evening, as the dark twilight of the Umbral Basin settled over the land...
Silas stood in the main Keep courtyard, fully rested and refreshed.
Standing right beside his right hip was Aeli, looking unusually cheerful with her cheeks carrying a permanent rosy glow as she held her hands behind her back.
They were standing directly outside the Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault... the massive standalone cold-storage facility built into the western side of the Keep courtyard.
The heavy steel doors of the vault were flung wide open.
Out from the dark interior billowed a thick, rolling cloud of freezing white preservation mist, sending a frigid chill washing over the warm cobblestones.
Inside, rows of glowing blue frost-runes illuminated hundreds of hung monster carcasses, organized neatly along iron hooks and steel butchery tables.
Silas looked at the billowing frost mist with a thoughtful glint in his golden eyes.

’I seriously need to spend the points to upgrade this place to Tier 3 soon,’ Silas evaluated mentally. ’The Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault is decent, but as our population doubles and we start handling multi-ton monster harvests from regional raids, we need a high-capacity cryo-vault that can preserve food indefinitely without mana degradation.’
He flicked his eyes toward the upper right corner of his vision, summoning his system interface to check his current currency.
PING!
[Current UP Balance: 1,240 UP]
Silas’s eyes widened slightly in genuine satisfaction.
The field hunting squads had gone completely above and beyond today.

Between Morwenna’s Abyss Corsairs clearing the riverbanks, Brida’s Team Bravo smashing heavy beast nests, and Fenna’s artillery team sniping flying Tier 2 monsters from the Watchtower, they had shattered the thousand-point milestone.

He had more than enough Upgrade Points to execute his planned S-Rank ascensions for Aeli and Rowenna, with plenty left over for structural renovations... though more hunts would need to happen tomorrow.
Earlier, when the field teams had returned to the Keep gates, Silas had made sure to personally greet every single woman, praising their hard work and handing out extra rations.

He had even tried to give Morwenna a special compliment for her squad’s staggering kill count though the feral Pirate Queen had merely smirked, scoffed dismissively, and demanded that instead of verbal praise, Silas had to sit down with her later tonight so she could teach him the advanced high-velocity footwork of her Tidal-Blade Arts.
Not only that, but Morwenna had casually agreed to act as his personal sparring partner over the next few days to help him fully master fighting inside Vespera’s single-armed body.
Standing there in the courtyard, looking at Morwenna’s sharp gorgeous face, Silas felt a sudden dangerous urge.
’Damn...’ Silas thought. ’I honestly just want to grab her waist and kiss her right on the mouth...’
However, Silas quickly checked his own desires.

While he had already established an intimate affectionate bond with Eluned... having shared passionate kisses and romantic promises with the Nature Goddess... his relationship with Morwenna was built on a slightly different wilder dynamic.
Morwenna was a prideful fierce Dread Queen of the seas.

If he tried to force a romantic move on her out of nowhere without properly earning her heart through combat and drink, he was far more likely to take an SSS-Rank water-blade to the ribs or a sharp punch straight to the face.
And Silas preferred keeping his face intact whenever possible.
HEAVE... CRASH!
A heavy metallic thud shattered Silas’s train of thought.
Stepping out of the freezing mist of the Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault were Tasmin, Brida, and a squad of heavily armored Shieldmaidens.
Together, they were dragging a colossal, six-foot-tall wooden trade crate bound in thick iron straps.
Tasmin wiped a thin layer of frost from her leather shoulder guard, stepping up to Silas with a crisp bow.

"Report, Lord Silas," Tasmin announced formally. "We have successfully packed and sealed the first major trade shipment for ’The Unmovable Wall.’ This crate contains roughly four tons of prime, freshly harvested game from today’s Basin raids... consisting primarily of Tier 2 Umbral Wolf flanks and high-density bird meat."
Silas rolled his golden eyes playfully with a smirk touching his lips.
"More bird meat, huh?" Silas chuckled. "It seems like new monster species are really starting to pop up everywhere in the Umbral Basin."
Over the past few hours, almost every single returning hunter had complained about encountering flock after flock of strange metallic-feathered raptor birds.
While they were significantly smaller than the twenty-five-foot Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc that Silas had bisected earlier, they were still aggressive Tier 2 airborne predators that hunted in packs.
Clearing them out was going to be a daily, annoying chore for the Scouts.
"Thanks for getting this sorted so quickly, girls," Silas praised, stepping forward and tapping the iron trade crate.
FLASH!
With a subtle spatial hum, the multi-ton crate of frozen meat vanished cleanly into his Lord Inventory.
Brida rested her massive axe against her shoulder, taking a heavy step forward as her brown eyes looked at Silas with a rare, serious edge.
"Captain..." Brida asked with her deep voice carrying across the quiet courtyard. "Are we really going to war against those ’Unmovable Wall’ people in six days?"

She hadn’t been present at the western border during the initial meeting, but as an S-Rank Titan Bastion... her high-tier physical perception had picked up the lingering pressure radiating from Lord Sky’s direction miles away.
She knew those invaders were no push-overs.
Before Silas could answer, a boisterous female voice called out from the side of the vault.
"Of course we’re going to war with them, big girl," Morwenna spoke up drily.
The Pirate Queen was casually sitting atop a wooden supply crate, swinging her long, leather-clad legs.

In her right hand, she held a long sharpened wooden stick. Impaled on the end of the stick was a thick, roasted, six-inch-wide oversized worm monster... another newly discovered fauna of the Umbral Basin.
Morwenna took a hearty, crunchy bite out of the roasted worm, chewing contentedly.
That particular worm monster had an absurd secret... Despite looking utterly repulsive on the outside, its inner meat tasted shockingly like sweet roasted chicken.

In fact, less than ten minutes ago, Morwenna had shamelessly pinned Silas against the Keep wall and forcefully stuffed a piping-hot piece of the roasted worm directly into his mouth just to see the shocked expression on his face when he tasted chicken.
Silas still couldn’t completely wrap his head around the mind-boggling reality that a giant slimy Basin earthworm tasted like high-grade poultry.
Morwenna swallowed her food, waving her wooden skewer dismissively as she looked at Brida.

"We’re going to face them, and we’re going to crush them," Morwenna declared with absolute, arrogant supreme confidence. "I felt their presences from across the forest earlier. There are a few moderately annoying and troublesome bugs hiding inside that rolling metal box of theirs... but honestly? If I were currently at my full, unsuppressed power... I could beat their entire two-hundred-man army in my sleep! Hell, I could beat them while in a coma!"
Brida blinked her wide eyes, looking at the Pirate Queen with genuine curiosity. "And... what about right now? At your current suppressed level?"
Morwenna took another crunchy bite of her chicken-worm, offering an utterly toothy smirk.
"Right now? I’ll still beat them in my sleep," Morwenna replied smoothly. "What the hell did you think I was gonna say?"
Silas stared at her with an eyebrow twitching violently as a massive sweatdrop formed on the back of his head.

’Why the fuck did you even bother repeating the phrase if the answer was literally going to be the exact same thing?!’ Silas complained in his own mind, feeling like a complete idiot for briefly expecting a bit of humbleness from her.
