Breathing in the cool air of the vault, Silas let his eyelids drift shut, slipping into a light, peaceful slumber.
A few minutes later, a gentle spatial ripple hummed in the corner of the vault.
Aeli stepped back into the room after safely tucking Talira into her bed.
Seeing her Lord sitting against the stone wall with his eyes closed with his chest rising and falling in steady relaxed rhythms, the arcanist softened her posture completely.
She walked over on silent feet, kneeling down beside him.
With extreme care and gentleness, Aeli reached out, shifting Silas’s upper body so that he was lying flat on his back, placing his head comfortably across both of her soft lap-cushioned thighs.
Aeli looked down at her Lord’s handsome face.
In the dim torchlight of the vault, she could see the faint lines of tension around his eyes... the subtle physical toll of carrying an entire territory’s survival on his shoulders.
"You try far too hard, My Lord..." Aeli whispered softly, her melodic voice filled with an overwhelming heartbreaking tenderness.
"You carry everything for all of us... you truly deserve to get some real sleep."
She reached down with her slender fingers, gently brushing a strand of dark hair away from his forehead.
Seeing a small bead of sweat glistening on his jaw from his intense duel with the dragon, Aeli felt a sudden uncontrollable surge of affection rising from the very depths of her soul.
Her breath caught in her throat.
Her pale cheeks flushed a delicate pink, her green eyes darkening with a deep light.
Aeli tilted her face forward, leaning down low until her lips brushed against his.
SLURP...
Aeli extended her soft pink tongue, lightly licking across Silas’s lower lip, tasting the salty trace of her Lord’s sweat.
A soft shuddering sigh escaped her throat as she pulled back a fraction of an inch, resting her forehead against his with her heart hammering wildly against her ribs.
’I don’t care about the wars...
I don’t care about anything else...’ Aeli thought passionately, staring at his closed eyelids with adoration. ’I just want you to rest...
I want to protect your peace forever.’
Later that evening, as the dark twilight of the Umbral Basin settled over the land...
Silas stood in the main Keep courtyard, fully rested and refreshed.
Standing right beside his right hip was Aeli, looking unusually cheerful with her cheeks carrying a permanent rosy glow as she held her hands behind her back.
They were standing directly outside the Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault... the massive standalone cold-storage facility built into the western side of the Keep courtyard.
The heavy steel doors of the vault were flung wide open.
Out from the dark interior billowed a thick, rolling cloud of freezing white preservation mist, sending a frigid chill washing over the warm cobblestones.
Inside, rows of glowing blue frost-runes illuminated hundreds of hung monster carcasses, organized neatly along iron hooks and steel butchery tables.
Silas looked at the billowing frost mist with a thoughtful glint in his golden eyes.

’I seriously need to spend the points to upgrade this place to Tier 3 soon,’ Silas evaluated mentally. ’The Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault is decent, but as our population doubles and we start handling multi-ton monster harvests from regional raids, we need a high-capacity cryo-vault that can preserve food indefinitely without mana degradation.’
He flicked his eyes toward the upper right corner of his vision, summoning his system interface to check his current currency.
PING!
[Current UP Balance: 1,240 UP]
Silas’s eyes widened slightly in genuine satisfaction.
The field hunting squads had gone completely above and beyond today.

Between Morwenna’s Abyss Corsairs clearing the riverbanks, Brida’s Team Bravo smashing heavy beast nests, and Fenna’s artillery team sniping flying Tier 2 monsters from the Watchtower, they had shattered the thousand-point milestone.

He had more than enough Upgrade Points to execute his planned S-Rank ascensions for Aeli and Rowenna, with plenty left over for structural renovations... though more hunts would need to happen tomorrow.
Earlier, when the field teams had returned to the Keep gates, Silas had made sure to personally greet every single woman, praising their hard work and handing out extra rations.

He had even tried to give Morwenna a special compliment for her squad’s staggering kill count though the feral Pirate Queen had merely smirked, scoffed dismissively, and demanded that instead of verbal praise, Silas had to sit down with her later tonight so she could teach him the advanced high-velocity footwork of her Tidal-Blade Arts.
Not only that, but Morwenna had casually agreed to act as his personal sparring partner over the next few days to help him fully master fighting inside Vespera’s single-armed body.
Standing there in the courtyard, looking at Morwenna’s sharp gorgeous face, Silas felt a sudden dangerous urge.
’Damn...’ Silas thought. ’I honestly just want to grab her waist and kiss her right on the mouth...’
However, Silas quickly checked his own desires.

While he had already established an intimate affectionate bond with Eluned... having shared passionate kisses and romantic promises with the Nature Goddess... his relationship with Morwenna was built on a slightly different wilder dynamic.
Morwenna was a prideful fierce Dread Queen of the seas.

If he tried to force a romantic move on her out of nowhere without properly earning her heart through combat and drink, he was far more likely to take an SSS-Rank water-blade to the ribs or a sharp punch straight to the face.
And Silas preferred keeping his face intact whenever possible.
HEAVE...
CRASH!
A heavy metallic thud shattered Silas’s train of thought.
Stepping out of the freezing mist of the Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault were Tasmin, Brida, and a squad of heavily armored Shieldmaidens.
Together, they were dragging a colossal, six-foot-tall wooden trade crate bound in thick iron straps.
Tasmin wiped a thin layer of frost from her leather shoulder guard, stepping up to Silas with a crisp bow.
"Report, Lord Silas," Tasmin announced formally.

"We have successfully packed and sealed the first major trade shipment for ’The Unmovable Wall.’ This crate contains roughly four tons of prime, freshly harvested game from today’s Basin raids... consisting primarily of Tier 2 Umbral Wolf flanks and high-density bird meat."
Silas rolled his golden eyes playfully with a smirk touching his lips.
"More bird meat, huh?" Silas chuckled.
"It seems like new monster species are really starting to pop up everywhere in the Umbral Basin."
Over the past few hours, almost every single returning hunter had complained about encountering flock after flock of strange metallic-feathered raptor birds.
While they were significantly smaller than the twenty-five-foot Abyssal Iron-Weave Roc that Silas had bisected earlier, they were still aggressive Tier 2 airborne predators that hunted in packs.
Clearing them out was going to be a daily, annoying chore for the Scouts.
"Thanks for getting this sorted so quickly, girls," Silas praised, stepping forward and tapping the iron trade crate.
FLASH!
With a subtle spatial hum, the multi-ton crate of frozen meat vanished cleanly into his Lord Inventory.
Brida rested her massive axe against her shoulder, taking a heavy step forward as her brown eyes looked at Silas with a rare, serious edge.
"Captain..." Brida asked with her deep voice carrying across the quiet courtyard.
"Are we really going to war against those ’Unmovable Wall’ people in six days?"

She hadn’t been present at the western border during the initial meeting, but as an S-Rank Titan Bastion... her high-tier physical perception had picked up the lingering pressure radiating from Lord Sky’s direction miles away.
She knew those invaders were no push-overs.
Before Silas could answer, a boisterous female voice called out from the side of the vault.
"Of course we’re going to war with them, big girl," Morwenna spoke up drily.
The Pirate Queen was casually sitting atop a wooden supply crate, swinging her long, leather-clad legs.
In her right hand, she held a long sharpened wooden stick.
Impaled on the end of the stick was a thick, roasted, six-inch-wide oversized worm monster... another newly discovered fauna of the Umbral Basin.
Morwenna took a hearty, crunchy bite out of the roasted worm, chewing contentedly.
That particular worm monster had an absurd secret...
Despite looking utterly repulsive on the outside, its inner meat tasted shockingly like sweet roasted chicken.

In fact, less than ten minutes ago, Morwenna had shamelessly pinned Silas against the Keep wall and forcefully stuffed a piping-hot piece of the roasted worm directly into his mouth just to see the shocked expression on his face when he tasted chicken.
Silas still couldn’t completely wrap his head around the mind-boggling reality that a giant slimy Basin earthworm tasted like high-grade poultry.
Morwenna swallowed her food, waving her wooden skewer dismissively as she looked at Brida.
"We’re going to face them, and we’re going to crush them," Morwenna declared with absolute, arrogant supreme confidence.
"I felt their presences from across the forest earlier.
There are a few moderately annoying and troublesome bugs hiding inside that rolling metal box of theirs... but honestly?
If I were currently at my full, unsuppressed power...
I could beat their entire two-hundred-man army in my sleep!
Hell, I could beat them while in a coma!"
Brida blinked her wide eyes, looking at the Pirate Queen with genuine curiosity.
"And... what about right now?
At your current suppressed level?"
Morwenna took another crunchy bite of her chicken-worm, offering an utterly toothy smirk.
"Right now?
I’ll still beat them in my sleep," Morwenna replied smoothly.
"What the hell did you think I was gonna say?"
Silas stared at her with an eyebrow twitching violently as a massive sweatdrop formed on the back of his head.

’Why the fuck did you even bother repeating the phrase if the answer was literally going to be the exact same thing?!’ Silas complained in his own mind, feeling like a complete idiot for briefly expecting a bit of humbleness from her.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Once-In-A-Generation Jade Beauty
paragraphs: Yet, despite her ridiculous bickering and shameless arrogance, Silas couldn’t help but let a warm confident smile spread across his face.
That unshakeable and terrifying confidence was precisely why he loved his crew.
Silas stepped onto a small stone step, looking over Brida, Tasmin, Morwenna, and the assembled Shieldmaidens.

"Morwenna’s right," Silas announced firmly with his gravelly voice carrying an unshakeable authority that quieted the courtyard instantly. "It doesn’t matter who Lord Sky brings to our front gates... It doesn’t matter how many hidden Heroes he has hiding in his treads, or how many millions of viewers are watching his stream. The Blessed Land does not lose. We will win this war, and we will take their territory’s strength for our own."
"YEAHHHHH!"
"FOR THE BLESSED LAND!"
"FOR LORD SILAS!"
The Shieldmaidens cheered in a synchronized bloodthirsty roar.
Silas smiled, reaching into his pocket and pulling out the dark black metal disguise ring.
He slipped the band onto his left ring finger.
BOOM!

A dense wave of royal purple mana erupted around his body as in a fraction of a millisecond, his height compressed, his shoulders narrowed and his left arm vanished into an empty sleeve as his golden eyes transformed into a deep mesmerizing violet.
Standing before the crowd was Vespera.
Brida and the Shieldmaidens stared at his single-armed female form, letting out a wave of playful, admiring whistles and giggles.
"Damn, Boss!" Brida grinned cheekily. "You look gorgeous as a lady! You’ve got better hips than half the girls here!"
"Shut up, Brida," Vespera replied drily in her smooth raspy voice, though an amused smile touched her lips.
Vespera turned her head, calling out toward the Keep gardens:
"Valkyrie! Luna! Time to ride!"
HOWL!
GRRR-RUFF!
Two thunderous howls echoed across the grounds as the massive gold-furred Alpha wolf mate Valkyrie and the sleek gold direwolf Luna bounded over the stone fences, landing gracefully in the courtyard.
Vespera turned her purple eyes toward Aeli.
"Aeli," Vespera instructed smoothly. "If you’re coming along with me to the border camp, put on your helmet right now. Lord Sky might have his stream cameras active."
"Yes, My Lord!" Aeli answered eagerly.
She reached behind her back, pulling out her massive, neon-yellow-and-black motorized biker’s helmet.
Without an ounce of hesitation, Aeli jammed the giant plastic helmet straight over her silver hair and long elven ears, snapping the tinted visor shut with a loud click.
Standing there in her pristine, flowing white arcanist robes topped off with a giant motorcycle helmet, Aeli scrambled up onto Luna’s broad saddle, striking a heroic pose atop the direwolf.
’Being an author... I need to experience many things in order to understand what I see in the books.’
Vespera swung her body effortlessly up onto Valkyrie’s back, adjusting her balance with her single right hand.
She looked around at her troops, offering a confident breathtaking smile.
"We’ll be back shortly, girls," Vespera called out. "Keep the perimeter tight!"
"Safe travels, My Lord!" Tasmin bowed deeply.
Vespera pressed her boot lightly against Valkyrie’s flank. "Let us go!"
FWOOSH!
The heavy iron gates of the Keep ground open as Valkyrie and Luna exploded forward in a blur of gold fur, shooting out across the inner plains at high speed.

As the cold wind whipped past their faces, Vespera rode smoothly atop Valkyrie, while Aeli rode beside her on Luna, holding onto her saddle reins with her neon helmet bouncing slightly against the wind.
Vespera turned her deep violet eyes toward the helmeted elf with her voice carrying clearly over the roaring wind.
"By the way, Aeli... thanks for letting me use your lap earlier while I was resting in the vault. That was really comfortable."
Inside the giant motorcycle helmet, Aeli went completely, utterly rigid.
Her heart skipped three beats as a bright burning crimson flush exploded across her hidden face!
"A-Ah! Y-You’re very welcome, Lord Silas... I mean, Lord Vespera!" Aeli stammered out frantically with her muffled voice trembling from inside the plastic visor.
Vespera tilted her head slightly, her purple eyes flickering with playful suspicion.

"Though... it was strange," Vespera added thoughtfully, scratching her cheek with her single hand. "When I woke up... my lips tasted kind of weirdly sweet and salty. Do you happen to know the reason for that, Aeli?"
"EEEEEEEKKK~!" Aeli let out a high-pitched adorable and panicked squeak that echoed muffled inside her helmet.
Her mind went into a red-alert panic.

"I-I HAVE NO IDEA WHAT YOU’RE TALKING ABOUT, MY LORD!" Aeli lied frantically, waving her hands in flustered desperation. "IT... IT MUST HAVE BEEN THE MANA IN THE VAULT! OR... OR MAYBE A SPATIAL CONDENSATION EFFECT! YES! SPATIAL MOISTURE!"
Vespera looked at the flustered helmeted elf, letting out a soft and genuine laugh that echoed musically over the wind.
"Heh... you’re really cute, Aeli," Vespera chuckled softly, shaking her head as she looked back toward the path ahead.
Aeli slumped forward on Luna’s saddle, clutching her chest through her white robes, her face burning hotter than a volcanic forge inside her motorcycle helmet.
’He thinks I’m cute...’ Aeli squealed silently inside her mind with her soul practically melting into a puddle of blissful joy. ’He called me cute...!’
Ten minutes later, the two direwolves broke through the western tree line, sliding to a smooth stop at the edge of the wild border clearing.
Standing in the center of the clearing was the colossal, three-story treaded iron war-rig of ’The Unmovable Wall.’
As Vespera and Aeli trotted into the clearing, Silas’s purple eyes scanned the enemy camp and a deep exasperated frown immediately tugged at her lips.
The atmosphere in Lord Sky’s camp was a chaotic mess of loud partying.
Over two hundred soldiers, vanguard warriors, and element-casters were gathered around massive open bonfires.
They were drinking heavy iron mugs of ale, singing boisterous tavern songs, roasting bird meat, and laughing merrily without a single care in the world.
There were no scouting patrols posted along the perimeter.
There were no defensive wards being actively maintained and there wasn’t even a single officer reviewing tactical maps.
Vespera grimaced internally, a wave of disgusted disbelief washing over Silas’s mind behind her female disguise.

’Are you fucking kidding me...?’ Silas thought, staring at the drunken, merry army. ’They are literally engaged in a territorial standoff with an unknown top-ranked domain... and instead of strategizing, drilling formations, or setting up defensive traps... they’re throwing an open-air kegger party?!’
Silas let out a silent weary sigh.
’These Classic Lords who rely on stream popularity really get way too comfortable...’

Still, Vespera noticed one key detail that eased her annoyance... hovering around the camp, the six brass camera drones were completely powered down, their glowing lenses dark, resting quietly on magnetic charging docks atop the war-rig’s roof.
Lord Sky had officially turned off his live stream broadcast for the evening to give his crew privacy.
THUD!
Valkyrie came to a complete halt twenty paces away from the central mahogany meeting table.

Lord Sky, who was standing near a roaring bonfire wearing a loose leather tunic over his chest, though still keeping his featureless silver-and-black alloy mask firmly over his face, spotted their arrival.
He set down his drinking horn and walked forward, waving his hand in a cheerful friendly greeting.
"Welcome back, Lord Vespera!" Sky greeted warmly, his voice relaxed. "We didn’t expect you back so quickly this evening!"
Vespera didn’t immediately reply to his greeting.
Instead, she casually raised her single right hand, channeling a subtle wave of spatial inventory mana.
FLASH... HEAVE!
BOOOOOOM!

Without saying a single word, Vespera released the colossal six-foot-tall iron-bound trade crate directly out of her Lord Inventory, letting it drop straight out of empty air to slam violently onto the mud clearing.

The multi-ton impact rattled the ground so hard that several drinking mugs sitting on the nearby mahogany table jumped six inches into the air as the drunken soldiers around the bonfires flinched, snapping their heads toward the massive box in utter shock!
Vespera slowly folded her single right arm over her waist, offering Sky a smooth and breathtakingly cool smile.
"Good evening, Lord Sky," Vespera greeted him back with her voice carrying effortless authority across the silent clearing.
She gestured casually with her chin toward the massive wooden crate resting in the mud before adding:
"I brought over today’s promised meat shipment... tell me, Lord Sky... will four tons of prime Basin game be enough to satisfy your hungry army for the night?"
"Of course! It’s more than enough however...!"
Lord Sky leaned his silver-and-black alloy mask slightly to the side with his eyes scanning the figure sitting atop the sleek mount beside Vespera.
The woman was wearing pristine, flowing white arcanist robes that radiated a subtle high-tier magical aura.
But jammed directly over her head was a massive, neon-yellow-and-black motorized biker’s helmet, complete with a dark tinted visor that completely hid her face from view.

"If you don’t mind me asking, Lord Vespera..." Sky began, pointing a gauntleted finger toward the helmeted rider, "who is your companion here? And... what is the reason for the high-tech headgear? Is that a specialized artifact?"
Sitting atop Luna’s saddle, Aeli froze completely.
Behind the dark tinted visor of her giant motorcycle helmet, the elven arcanist’s silver eyes widened to the size of dinner plates with her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird.
’Fuck!’ Aeli panicked frantically in her own mind, her fingers clutching Luna’s leather reins so tightly her knuckles turned white. ’What do I say?! What kind of excuse do I use?!’
Aeli’s mind raced through possible cover stories at light speed.
’Should I tell him I have a sudden, horrific skin disease on my face right now?! That my skin broke out in ugly magic boils and it’s not pleasant to look at?!’
The moment that thought crossed her mind, Aeli violently shook her head inside the helmet.

’No, no, no! That’s a terrible excuse! If I tell another Lord that I have an untreated skin condition, it’ll make the Blessed Land look like an impoverished backwater territory that lacks basic medical potions and high-tier healing facilities... It would completely drag our Lord’s prestigious reputation through the dirt!’
Before Aeli could succumb to social paralysis and accidentally stammer out something ridiculous from inside her plastic visor—
STEP!
Vespera casually shifted her weight on Valkyrie’s saddle.
She turned her deep purple eyes toward Sky, offering a smooth and effortlessly charming smile as her voice cut smoothly through the cool evening air.

"Forgive her strange appearance, Lord Sky," Vespera explained smoothly, gesturing toward Aeli with her single right hand. "My companion here is simply quite uncomfortable with showing her face to strangers. In fact... back in our world on Earth, she can be considered an extraordinary once-in-a-generation Jade Beauty."
Vespera tilted her head with her purple eyes sparkling with playful intrigue.

"Because her natural beauty is so overwhelming that it tends to cause violent rivalries and endless distractions wherever she walks, she prefers to keep herself completely concealed when visiting outside territories."
"PUFFT—!"
Inside the giant neon biker helmet, Aeli’s face exploded into a thermonuclear burning crimson flush.

’A... A JADE BEAUTY?!’ Aeli screamed internally with her soul practically ascending to the heavens. ’My Lord just called me a once-in-a-generation Jade Beauty in front of a famous Classic Lord?! AHHHHHH!’

Overwhelmed with dizzying embarrassment, Aeli instinctively leaned forward, reaching out with her slender hands to tightly clutch the black fabric of Vespera’s empty left sleeve, hiding her helmeted head behind her Lord’s shoulder like a shy flustered child.
Lord Sky stared at the helmeted "Jade Beauty" clinging timidly to Vespera’s sleeve, then threw his head back and burst into a loud and thoroughly amused laugh.

"Hahaha! A Jade Beauty hiding under a motorcycle helmet!" Sky chuckled merrily, shaking his head beneath his alloy mask. "Well, I certainly cannot blame her for wanting privacy in a realm full of predatory Lords! That is a remarkably unique choice of disguise, I’ll give her that!"
Sky looked back at Vespera, his posture relaxing into a warm, business-like rhythm.

"In any case," Sky continued, gesturing toward the multi-ton wooden trade crate resting in the mud, "since the gifts we have received from Blessed Land today are so extraordinarily plentiful... tons of prime game is no small gesture, you can rest assured that ’The Unmovable Wall’ will return the favor in equal kind."
’I’d expect so...’
Sky rested his hands on his hips. "So tell me, Lord Vespera... what would you like in exchange for this shipment?"
Vespera smoothed down her dark trousers with her single right hand with her violet eyes gleaming.

"A few more variation boxes of those luxury Valorian spices couldn’t hurt," Vespera answered casually. "And as for the metals... a few more ingots of rare alloy would be wonderful. If you happen to have anything rarer than True-Silver Tungsten in your vaults, I certainly wouldn’t say no."

Lord Sky leaned his silver-and-black alloy mask slightly to the side with his eyes scanning the figure sitting atop the sleek mount beside Vespera.
The woman was wearing pristine, flowing white arcanist robes that radiated a subtle high-tier magical aura.
But jammed directly over her head was a massive, neon-yellow-and-black motorized biker’s helmet, complete with a dark tinted visor that completely hid her face from view.
"If you don’t mind me asking, Lord Vespera..." Sky began, pointing a gauntleted finger toward the helmeted rider, "who is your companion here?
And... what is the reason for the high-tech headgear?
Is that a specialized artifact?"
Sitting atop Luna’s saddle, Aeli froze completely.
Behind the dark tinted visor of her giant motorcycle helmet, the elven arcanist’s silver eyes widened to the size of dinner plates with her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird.
’Fuck!’ Aeli panicked frantically in her own mind, her fingers clutching Luna’s leather reins so tightly her knuckles turned white. ’What do I say?!
What kind of excuse do I use?!’
Aeli’s mind raced through possible cover stories at light speed.
’Should I tell him I have a sudden, horrific skin disease on my face right now?!
That my skin broke out in ugly magic boils and it’s not pleasant to look at?!’
The moment that thought crossed her mind, Aeli violently shook her head inside the helmet.
’No, no, no!
That’s a terrible excuse!

If I tell another Lord that I have an untreated skin condition, it’ll make the Blessed Land look like an impoverished backwater territory that lacks basic medical potions and high-tier healing facilities...
It would completely drag our Lord’s prestigious reputation through the dirt!’
Before Aeli could succumb to social paralysis and accidentally stammer out something ridiculous from inside her plastic visor—
STEP!
Vespera casually shifted her weight on Valkyrie’s saddle.
She turned her deep purple eyes toward Sky, offering a smooth and effortlessly charming smile as her voice cut smoothly through the cool evening air.
"Forgive her strange appearance, Lord Sky," Vespera explained smoothly, gesturing toward Aeli with her single right hand.
"My companion here is simply quite uncomfortable with showing her face to strangers.
In fact... back in our world on Earth, she can be considered an extraordinary once-in-a-generation Jade Beauty."
Vespera tilted her head with her purple eyes sparkling with playful intrigue.

"Because her natural beauty is so overwhelming that it tends to cause violent rivalries and endless distractions wherever she walks, she prefers to keep herself completely concealed when visiting outside territories."
"PUFFT—!"
Inside the giant neon biker helmet, Aeli’s face exploded into a thermonuclear burning crimson flush.
A JADE BEAUTY?!’ Aeli screamed internally with her soul practically ascending to the heavens. ’My Lord just called me a once-in-a-generation Jade Beauty in front of a famous Classic Lord?!
AHHHHHH!’

Overwhelmed with dizzying embarrassment, Aeli instinctively leaned forward, reaching out with her slender hands to tightly clutch the black fabric of Vespera’s empty left sleeve, hiding her helmeted head behind her Lord’s shoulder like a shy flustered child.
Lord Sky stared at the helmeted "Jade Beauty" clinging timidly to Vespera’s sleeve, then threw his head back and burst into a loud and thoroughly amused laugh.
"Hahaha!
A Jade Beauty hiding under a motorcycle helmet!" Sky chuckled merrily, shaking his head beneath his alloy mask.
"Well, I certainly cannot blame her for wanting privacy in a realm full of predatory Lords!
That is a remarkably unique choice of disguise, I’ll give her that!"
Sky looked back at Vespera, his posture relaxing into a warm, business-like rhythm.

"In any case," Sky continued, gesturing toward the multi-ton wooden trade crate resting in the mud, "since the gifts we have received from Blessed Land today are so extraordinarily plentiful... tons of prime game is no small gesture, you can rest assured that ’The Unmovable Wall’ will return the favor in equal kind."
’I’d expect so...’
Sky rested his hands on his hips.
"So tell me, Lord Vespera... what would you like in exchange for this shipment?"
Vespera smoothed down her dark trousers with her single right hand with her violet eyes gleaming.
"A few more variation boxes of those luxury Valorian spices couldn’t hurt," Vespera answered casually.
"And as for the metals... a few more ingots of rare alloy would be wonderful.
If you happen to have anything rarer than True-Silver Tungsten in your vaults, I certainly wouldn’t say no."

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Spider Trouble
paragraphs: Inside her mind, Silas was smirking slyly.

’Truth be told,’ Silas reflected behind his female disguise, ’I’m not lacking in high-tier alloys or rare crafting ores back at the Keep’s vault in the slightest... In fact, if I really wanted to, I could probably pull out a stack of mythril ingots from my spatial storage and sell them to Sky right here and now.’
However, Silas had no intention of doing that under this disguise.

’Selling high-tier raw materials and dominating the commercial trade markets is going to be a Silas Graves play back in the real world,’ Silas reasoned coldly. ’As for the Blessed Land and my persona Vespera... our global public image needs to remain strictly attuned for uncompromising battle. We receive gifts, we claim war spoils, and we dominate.’
Sky smiled broadly behind his silver mask, waving his hand dismissively.

"Spices and rare alloys? Consider it done!" Sky agreed instantly. "I have plenty of high-grade Central City reserves stored in the lower holds. I can easily add a few extra catalyst crystals to the trade bundle as well."
Then, Sky paused. His relaxed demeanor shifted slightly with his voice taking on a slightly more serious and cautious tone.

"However... before I have my logistics officers fetch your trade goods from the vault," Sky reported, leaning in slightly, "there is a small, rather urgent matter I need to discuss with you, Lord Vespera."
Vespera raised an elegant eyebrow. "Oh? What kind of matter?"
Before Sky could explain—
STEP!STEP! STEP!
Heavy measured footsteps echoed across the muddy clearing.
Stepping out from the shadow of the mobile fortress’s iron treads was Sky’s Main Hero... the tall imposing blindfolded swordsman named Hiro.
He carried his massive, double-edged broadsword strapped across his broad back with his posture radiating a sharp cold steel mana.
Sky turned to his blind Hero, gesturing toward the multi-ton wooden trade crate resting in the dirt.
"Hiro," Sky commanded smoothly. "Take this trade crate into the main kitchen hold. Have the line cooks begin butchering the wolf flanks for tonight’s stew."
Hiro paused, bowing his head respectfully. "Understood, Master."
Hiro turned his blindfolded face toward the four-ton wooden crate.
He didn’t bend over to lift it with his arms nor did he call for a hand-truck or summon a lifting team.
Instead, Hiro took a single deliberate step forward.
TAP!
With lightning-fast martial precision, Hiro casually slipped the tip of his leather boot beneath the bottom edge of the four-ton trade crate.
BOOM!
Hiro flicked his leg upward.

A shockwave of pure physical mana exploded from his boot as the massive four-ton iron-bound wooden crate was violently launched twenty feet straight up into the air, spinning rapidly against the evening sky.
Before the multi-ton box could plummet back down to crush the mud floor, Hiro didn’t even sweat.
He casually raised his right arm straight above his head, extending a single calloused index finger.
The massive, four-ton wooden trade crate landed squarely on the tip of Hiro’s single index finger, coming to an instantaneous dead-stop halt.
The multi-ton box hovered in mid-air, perfectly balanced on one finger above his head like a spinning basketball.
Hiro turned his blindfolded head toward Vespera and Aeli, letting out a subtle arrogant snort through his nose.

’I refuse to be outdone by this single-armed woman and her helmeted pet,’ Hiro thought fiercely in his own mind with his jaw tightening as he balanced the multi-ton weight effortlessly on his finger. ’If I allow these outsiders to display such dominance in our camp... Lord Sky might actually start looking down on my capabilities as his primary Hero!’

With the four-ton crate spinning flawlessly on his single finger, Hiro turned on his heel and casually strolled up the wide iron ramp of the mobile fortress, carrying the massive load into the kitchen hold as if he were holding a feather.
Vespera stared at the blind swordsman’s vanishing back with an eyebrow twitching beneath her female disguise.
Beside her, Aeli tilted her motorcycle helmet, letting out a quiet muffled chirp from inside the plastic visor.
"Show-off..."
Sky cleared his throat awkwardly, letting out a sheepish embarrassed laugh as he rubbed the back of his neck.
"Ahem! Forgive Hiro’s behavior, Lord Vespera," Sky apologized politely. "He’s... extraordinarily competitive when it comes to physical strength. He doesn’t like feeling outshone by guest Heroes."
Vespera let out a short raspy chuckle, waving her single right hand. "It’s fine. He has good balance."
She looked into Sky’s masked eyes, bringing the conversation back on track. "So... what was it you wanted to discuss with me?"
Sky’s expression hardened beneath his alloy mask.
He reached his gauntleted hand deep into his leather cloak pocket, pulling out a small, sealed glass vial, holding it up between his thumb and forefinger.
Inside the glass vial was a black disgusting palm-sized scouting spider.
The spider was pitch-black, covered in coarse, oily bristles, featuring eight glowing purple compound eyes.
Trailing out from the back of its abdomen was a thick, sticky thread of pure white silk that pulsated with a faint corrupted dark mana.
Sky looked at the dead spider with his voice becoming serious.

"Over the past three hours," Sky revealed, "my perimeter wards picked up several of these miniature spider creatures crawling around the iron treads of my mobile fortress. They weren’t attacking my guards, nor were they feeding on leftover rations. They were actively scouting... They were using high-frequency silk vibrations to map out our camp’s layout and record our troop numbers."
Sky’s eyes narrowed behind his mask.

"I suspect that a high-tier monster lurking deep within the Umbral Basin is responsible for deploying these scout spiders. Now... as I mentioned earlier today, I generally prefer to avoid unnecessary monster hunts on foreign sectors... but I certainly don’t feel comfortable or safe knowing that a hidden predator is actively spying on my territory’s forward camp."
Vespera looked at the black spider in the glass vial, letting out a slow quiet internal sigh.
’Spider monsters in the Basin, huh?’ Silas thought behind his female disguise, a wave of familiar annoyance washing over his mind.
Spiders were yet another brand-new, unwanted species that had suddenly begun infesting the Umbral Basin over the past twenty-four hours.
In fact, earlier this afternoon, a few of the girls in Brida’s Team Bravo had brought back a small batch of harvested Basin spider legs to the Tier 2 Frost-Sealed Vault.

Kaelia, the Territory’s Master Chef, had attempted to clean, season, and roast the spider leg meat using high-tier culinary techniques but even after boiling and roasting, the meat remained a bitter, rubbery, and utterly repulsive texture that smelled of sulfur.
The girls had unanimously declared spider monsters a complete, useless waste of inventory space.
However... this sudden explosive influx of new monster species was triggering a deep concern in Silas’s mind.
’Something weird is definitely happening to the ecosystem of the Umbral Basin,’ Silas analyzed silently with his golden-ringed male eyes sharpening behind Vespera’s deep violet gaze.
There had never been this many diverse aggressive monster species appearing out of nowhere in such a short timeframe.
There were only two logical explanations for an ecological surge this rapid...

Either a massive terrifying Apex Boss monster had recently awakened in the deepest uncharted chasms of the basin... forcibly driving lower-tier species out of their natural habitats and pushing them toward the outer borders...
Or the unnatural shifting weather patterns and volatile mana density of the basin were forcing the local wildlife to undergo rapid biological mutations at an exponential rate.
’Man...’ Silas mused drily in his thoughts with a wave of dark humor touching his mind. ’This place is starting to seem a lot more like Australia back on old Earth these days.’
Australia didn’t exist in this current world... neither in the modern human cities back on Earth nor in the boundless sectors of the Sovereign Realm.
But back in old Earth, Silas remembered scrolling through old TikTok memes detailing the absurd and bizarre animals that roamed the Australian outback.

He had never visited the country himself, but those hilarious nightmare-inducing memes about massive spiders, flying lizards, and deadly creatures being discovered every week felt frighteningly applicable to his current life in the Umbral Basin.
Sky stowed the glass vial back into his pocket, turning his attention back to Vespera.

"I plan on turning the hunt for this spider nest into tonight’s official live-stream event," Sky proposed, his voice lighting up with enthusiasm. "I’ll be taking Hiro along with me into the woods to track the silk trail back to its source. And... since you are currently here at my camp, Lord Vespera... I would be honored if you and your companion would join us for the stream hunt tonight! It would make for a blockbuster broadcast!"
Hearing his proposal, Vespera froze slightly.
Inside her mind, Silas went into an immediate internal scheduling crisis.
FWOOSH!
A mental calendar materialized in Silas’s mind, packed to the absolute brim with pressing tasks.
’Wait a minute!’ Silas complained frantically in his thoughts. ’I am way too busy for a late-night spider hunt right now...’
Silas ran through his overwhelming evening checklist.

First: He needed to return to the Keep immediately so Morwenna could teach him the advanced high-velocity footwork of the second form of her Tidal-Blade Arts... a reward he had explicitly promised the feral Pirate Queen for her hard work today!

Second: He had given his sacred word to Eluned, promising the ancient Nature Goddess that he would do anything she wanted tonight and based on her dreamy baby-making demeanor earlier at the courtyard gates, Silas knew with 100% certainty that Eluned was currently waiting in his bed wearing a silk nightgown, ready to try and produce miniature copies of him.

Third: Tomorrow morning, he had to oversee massive physical construction projects... building new residential barracks for the seventy-two incoming female troops he was going to claim after winning the war and maybe personal housing for the girls themselves.
Fourth: He had over 1,240 UP sitting in his system bank that desperately needed to be spent on batch-upgrading Aeli and Rowenna to S-Rank status.
’I literally have zero spare time tonight!’ Silas groaned internally. ’I’m supposed to be practicing sword arts, pleasing a nature deity, upgrading my mages, and building houses...’
And yet... as Silas looked at Sky standing in the border clearing, his greed quickly took over.
Appearing on a high-visibility live stream alongside an undefeated Classic Lord was an priceless promotional opportunity.

It would solidify ’Lord Vespera’s’ legendary status, intimidate rival regional Lords who might be watching, and give him a chance to test his single-armed body in actual live-fire group combat before the official war next week.
Vespera let out a soft delicate female sigh with a resigned beautiful smile appearing on her lips.
She raised her single right hand, offering Sky a crisp elegant salute.
"If it serves your broadcast, Lord Sky," Vespera accepted smoothly. "then I would be delighted to join your hunt tonight."
Sky’s eyes lit up behind his silver mask as he clapped his hands together.
"Fantastic!" Sky cheered happily. "Hiro just returned from the kitchen hold... Give me thirty seconds to initialize the stream broadcast channels!"
Sky reached up with his gauntleted hand, gently tapping a small, runic button on the left side of his alloy helmet.
CLICK... WHIRRRR!
From small mechanical compartments built directly into the shoulders and back of his tactical armor, six metallic orb-shaped brass camera drones lifted off.
Their internal anti-gravity thrusters whirred to life, floating up into the air in a wide, hovering formation around Sky, Vespera, and Aeli.
Their glowing, crystal lenses flashed with bright azure-blue light as they connected directly to the high-speed global satellite network back on Earth.
PING! PING! PING!
Within three seconds of the stream feed going live, the viewer counter overlaying the left corner of Sky’s HUD began ticking upward at terrifying light speed.
50,000 viewers... 200,000 viewers... 800,000 viewers... 2,000,000 CONCURRENT VIEWERS IN LESS THAN THIRTY SECONDS!
Inside her disguise, Silas’s eyes widened slightly in genuine shock at the astronomical numbers.

’Two million people tuned in within thirty seconds?!’ Silas thought, utterly amazed. ’Being associated with the Blessed Land domain is a literal gold mine for stream engagement... Maybe I should start charging Sky.’
Sky stepped up directly in front of the central camera drone, raising two fingers in a relaxed charismatic salute to his global audience.

"Good evening, chat!" Sky greeted his stream warmly, his voice broadcasting crystal-clear to millions of screens back on Earth. "Welcome back to ’The Unmovable Wall’ live broadcast! As promised earlier today, we are running a special, late-night regional expedition here at the outer borders of the Umbral Basin!"
Sky gestured broadly to his right, presenting Vespera to the camera.
"Joining us for tonight’s hunt," Sky introduced proudly, "is none other than the illustrious Lord of Blessed Land herself... Lord Vespera!"

chapters.title: Chapter 257: A Troubling Lord To Face
paragraphs: Vespera offered the floating camera drone a smooth smile, raising her single right hand in a polite wave. "Good evening, everyone."
The stream chat overlaying Sky’s vision instantly went into a chaotic frenzy.
The text scrolled across the screen so fast it turned into an unreadable white blur as eight specific comments flashed prominently on the HUD.
[@GamerGod99: AHHHHHH LORD VESPERA IS BACK! MY QUEEN! ❤️]
[@SovereignWatcher: 2 MILLION VIEWERS IN 30 SECONDS! BLESSED LAND IMPACT!]
[@NoobMaster69: SHE IS SO GORGEOUS BRO! LOOK AT THAT SMILE!]
[@PVP_Legend: What are we hunting tonight Sky?! Show us some blood!]
[@ValoriaFan: So relieved Lord Vespera is safe! She’s so aesthetic!]
[@DarkKnight_00: Late night Basin raid?! Let’s gooooo!]
[@StreamLover: Blessed Land peak content incoming!]
[@TacticalNuke: Who is that person wearing a motorcycle helmet on a direwolf lmao?!]
Sky caught the last comment, laughing warmly as he gestured toward Aeli sitting atop Luna.

"And for those of you asking in the chat," Sky announced cheerfully, "this helmeted companion riding beside Lord Vespera is one of Blessed Land’s high-tier Heroes! Lord Vespera has informed me that beneath that tactical helmet... she is an extraordinary, once-in-a-generation Jade Beauty who conceals her face to prevent global chaos!"
Hearing Sky repeat the "Jade Beauty" title to over two million live stream viewers, Aeli felt her entire body go stiff inside her plastic helmet.

Panicking completely, Aeli reached out with her trembling white-gloved hands, tightly clutching Vespera’s black sleeve, ducking her head behind her Lord’s shoulder as she shyly raised a single hand toward the floating camera drone, offering a tiny muffled wave.
"H-Hi..." Aeli whispered softly from inside the helmet.

She wasn’t usually so shy or reactive but she was trying a different persona, it was like Lord Silas... he was using a different persona to take this Lord by surprise when their war started and she would do the same.
The live stream chat went into a meltdown of pure adoration.
[@GamerGod99: AHHHHHH SHE SAID HI! SHE IS SO ADORABLE!]
[@AnimeFanatic: JADE BEAUTY IN A MOTORCYCLE HELMET?! MY NEW FAVORITE TROPE!]
[@ValoriaFan: Look at her clinging to Vespera’s sleeve! She’s so shy!]
[@SovereignWatcher: FACE REVEAL WHEN?! WE NEED A FACE REVEAL!]
[@Degenerate_X: Blessed Land is literally full of breedable women lmao!]
Sky’s eyes caught that last perverted comment scrolling across his vision, and a prominent vein popped on his temple beneath his alloy mask.
"Moderator! Ban [@Degenerate_X] permanently from the stream network immediately!" Sky barked into his internal system channel, clearing his throat quickly.
Vespera let out a soft amused sigh, looking over at Sky.
"So, Lord Sky... how exactly are we going to track these scout spiders back to their nest in a basin this vast?"
Standing beside Sky, Hiro... the blindfolded main Hero stepped forward.
He reached out his gloved hand, taking the dead scout spider from Sky’s palm.
Hiro turned his blindfolded face toward Vespera with his voice deep and calm.
"Lord Vespera," Hiro spoke, "as a dedicated viewer of our stream broadcasts, I assume you are already familiar with my tracking technique?"
Vespera offered a sharp knowing smile, nodding her black-haired head. "Of course. Your signature skill... [Pathfinder’s Thread]."
Hiro possessed many high-tier sword skills, but his most famous, legendary ability across the streaming network was his Homing perception.

By taking any physical remnant, organic material, or silk strand originating from a target entity, Hiro could channel his steel mana to forcibly trace the target’s original spatial origin point, carving an illuminated path through the physical environment.
Hiro held the dead spider in his palm, closing his blindfolded eyes as he let out a low focused grunt.
"Pathfinder’s Thread!" Hiro commanded softly.
CRACKLE... FLASH!
Hiro’s body violently erupted with a surge of brilliant sapphire-blue steel mana.
The dead spider in his palm dissolved into fine, glowing blue dust particles.
The white silk thread trailing from its abdomen absorbed the blue energy, expanding outward into a blinding beam of pure radiant sapphire light.
SWISH!
The radiant blue light shot out from Hiro’s hand, piercing directly through the dark twilight of the forest.
It didn’t just point a vague direction... The sapphire light physically carved a glowing three-foot-wide luminous blue path directly across the mud, roots, and trees of the Umbral Basin.
The glowing path stretched deep into the dark misty forest, perfectly mapping out the exact winding physical trail that the scout spider had traversed from its mother’s nest to Sky’s camp.
Even though Hiro was completely blind, his spatial vibration perception allowed him to feel the blue light cutting through the atmosphere with clarity.
"The path is open," Hiro announced, drawing his massive double-edged broadsword from his back with a ringing sound. "The origin nest lies roughly three miles northwest of our current position."
Lord Sky drew his broadsword as well, a fierce battle-hungry grin spreading across his face beneath his alloy mask.
He looked back at his floating camera drones, pointing his blade down the glowing blue trail.

"You heard him, chat!" Sky roared enthusiastically, leaping five feet into the air and landing squarely on the glowing sapphire path. "The hunt is officially on! Let me lead! Let me lead! Let’s go crush this spider nest!"
FWOOSH!
Sky exploded forward down the glowing blue trail at high speed with his boots kicking up dark mud.
Hiro blurred into motion right behind him, his broadsword trailing blue sparks against the air.
Vespera looked at Aeli, her deep purple eyes twinkling with excitement as she gripped Valkyrie’s reins with her single right hand.
"Hold on tight!" Vespera commanded softly. "Let us show his stream how the Blessed Land hunts!"
HOWL!
GRRR-RUFF!
Valkyrie and Luna let out thunderous howls that shook the surrounding trees.

With a massive surge of speed, the two wolves leaped off the mud, shooting down the glowing sapphire path after Sky and Hiro like gold lightning bolts, plunging deep into the dark uncharted depths of the Umbral Basin night.
WHOOSH!
Vespera’s silver longsword carved a razor-sharp horizontal arc through the dark air!
A surging crescent of emerald wind mana erupted from the tip of her blade, cleanly decapitating a horse-sized Umbral Spider mid-leap.
Dark viscous green blood sprayed across the muddy forest floor as the creature’s heavy multi-legged torso tumbled uselessly into a thicket of briars.
Beside her, Valkyrie let out a deep chest-rattling growl with her massive silver paws pinning a second spider to the earth before her jaws snapped shut with a bone-crunching sound.
CRUNCH!
Out of the corner of her deep purple eyes, Vespera caught a flash of bright sapphire-blue light.
CLANG!
Hiro, the blindfolded main Hero of ’The Unmovable Wall,’ let out a low focused grunt.
"Ugh!"
He drew his double-edged broadsword just three inches from its scabbard, unleashing a concentrated wave of pressurized blue steel mana.
The blue aura cleaved cleanly through the air, bisecting a charging Rank 2 spider from head to thorax before the beast could even fire its webbing.
They were currently standing right outside the mouth of a massive dark cavern.
The glowing sapphire path carved by Hiro’s [Pathfinder’s Thread] terminated directly at the pitch-black cave entrance.
It was abundantly clear to everyone that this dark tunnel was the central nest of the scouting spiders.
However, guarding the cave entrance was a swarm of over thirty lesser arachnids... ranging from palm-sized crawling scouts to horse-sized armored horrors!
Vespera didn’t waste time with basic sword swings.
She channeled her Gold Core’s wind mana into her single right palm, feeling the air currents swirl rapidly around her fingers.
’Gale Guillotine!’ Vespera thought.
BOOM!
Vespera thrust her sword forward in a wide sweeping circle!
In a fraction of a second, the entire clearing outside the cave transformed into a sea of roaring emerald-green wind blades.
Dozens of three-foot-long razor gusts shot out in all directions, turning the swarm of spider monsters into a gruesome, airborne meat-grinder.
SLICK! SLICK! CRUNCH! SPLAT!
Over fifteen spiders were instantly sliced into dozens of falling oozing pieces.
Black and green blood rained down over the mud, completely clearing the left flank of the cave mouth in a single, effortless one-handed casting.
Up on the floating camera drones, Sky’s live stream went into a frantic frenzy.
[@GamerGod99: HOLY SHIT! A SEA OF WIND BLADES?! 🔥]
[@SovereignWatcher: LORD VESPERA IS CASUALLY WIPING CROWDS WITH ONE HAND!]
[@NoobMaster69: SHE IS SO CLEAN BRO! NO WASTED MOVEMENTS AT ALL!]
[@PVP_Legend: Look at that wind density! That’s at least Tier 3 control!]
[@ValoriaFan: MY QUEEN IS CARVING UP THE NEST! LET’S GOOOO!]
Seeing Vespera clear half the field with a single casual swing, Hiro’s jaw tightened beneath his blindfold.
His calloused fingers gripped his broadsword’s hilt until his knuckles turned white.
STOMP!
Hiro violently slammed his right boot into the dark soil!
KRA-THOOM!
A massive terrifying shockwave of wind and blue steel mana erupted out of his foot, cracking the solid bedrock beneath the mud in a twenty-meter radius.
The explosive physical force slammed directly into the remaining fifteen spider monsters, knocking them completely off balance and launching their bodies thirty feet straight up into the air.
While the spiders were suspended helplessly mid-air, Hiro drew his broadsword entirely from its sheath.
SLIDE... FLASH!
The blade flared with a blinding sun-like sapphire light as Hiro executed a single, blindingly fast multi-directional iaijutsu slash!
SWISH-SWISH-SWISH-SWISH!
Even though Hiro didn’t physically jump into the air, dozens of dense, criss-crossing blue light-slashes materialized around the airborne spiders simultaneously.
BANG! BANG! BANG!
All fifteen airborne spiders were violently diced into hundreds of microscopic, falling chunks.
A massive shower of black blood, severed spider legs, and shattered carapace plates rained down over the cracked ground like a grotesque, dark storm.
SPLAT! CLICK!
Hiro smoothly sheathed his broadsword with a sharp metallic sound, standing tall in the center of the bloody carnage without a single drop of grime touching his pristine leather uniform.
Lord Sky looked at the falling spider chunks, then turned his head toward his Hero, shaking his head with an exasperated quiet sigh.
"You really don’t need to show off like that, Hiro..." Sky muttered under his breath, rubbing his mask’s temple.
Sky turned his gaze toward Vespera, his eyes narrowing thoughtfully behind his alloy faceplate as he carefully analyzed her combat profile.

’She’s an extraordinarily capable wind mage...’ Sky reflected silently inside his mind. ’And her sword craft is top-tier. I handle Water magic as my primary elemental branch, but seeing the way she holds her longsword... I have zero doubts that if I were to face Lord Vespera in a direct, one-on-one sword duel, I am severely outmatched in raw bladework. She trusts her sword implicitly... It’s like an extension of her own arm.’
Sky ran complex calculations in his head.

’Her wind magic output is easily dense enough to blow away and disperse my high-pressure water spells. In a straightforward head-on confrontation between the two of us, I would inevitably lose... unless I rely on that.’
Sky knew his own limitations.
As a Lord who built his entire reputation, wealth, and empire on live streaming, his active combat arsenal was naturally public knowledge.
Stream viewers demanded variety... they hated seeing a Lord spam the exact same three spells in every single match.
To keep millions of subscribers entertained while winning high-stakes Lord Wars, Sky had to constantly devise creative unconventional tactical strategies to overcome superior opponents.
And right now, for the upcoming official Lord War against Blessed Land next week, Sky had already formulated a key tactical counter.

’For the war next week,’ Sky thought with a confident smirk beneath his mask, ’I’ve already assigned two of my elite Heroes who specialize in pure Light Magic to lock down Tasmin. Light magic naturally disrupts, burns, and neutralizes shadow manipulation, so Tasmin’s dark domain will be completely suppressed.’
Sky looked past Vespera with his masked face fixing onto Aeli sitting atop Luna.

’I don’t know much about the rest of Vespera’s officer roster...’ Sky mused, his eyes scanning the helmeted elf. ’She’s keeping her territory’s internal roster remarkably secretive... but that doesn’t matter. My war-band’s overall numbers and combined utility will carry the day. I just need to remain extra prepared. Now... you, helmeted girl... what exactly is your power?’
While Sky was busy analyzing his rivals, Vespera stood beside Valkyrie, looking over at Hiro with a slightly raised amused eyebrow beneath her female disguise.

’Is this blind guy seriously trying to compete with me?’ Silas thought dryly inside his mind. ’What is it with male Heroes and their desperate need to flex their physical output the second a pretty woman enters the field?’
Vespera turned her head toward Aeli softly. "Are you doing alright?"

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Spider’s Lair [I]
paragraphs: Inside her giant neon biker helmet, Aeli sat up straight on Luna’s saddle, holding her arcanist focus tightly.
"Yes, My Lord! I am completely fine!" Aeli answered eagerly with her voice echoing slightly muffled from inside the plastic visor.
In truth, Aeli had been quite impressed by the raw destruction Hiro had displayed just now.
Launching fifteen horse-sized monsters into the sky with a single boot-stomp and dicing them mid-air required astronomical physical strength.
However... it was nothing Aeli hadn’t seen before.
In the Blessed Land, Aeli was surrounded by terrifying monsters every single day.
Morwenna could summon ocean tides that swallowed whole armies, she had said so herself.
Eluned could rewrite ecosystems with a wave of her hand, the only reason she didn’t do so to Blessed Land was because she wanted them to level up and grow stronger.
Talira was a literal Primordial Crimson Dragon who breathed white-hot volcanic fire.
Lord Silas possessed a Gold Core that she knew was something that a god like Odin had... and Aeli herself commanded starlight.
Hiro’s blue steel blade was impressive for a human Hero, but compared to the divine horrors living inside her Keep, it was completely average.
Yet... despite his ordinary power level, Aeli felt a strange unsettling prickle along the back of her neck as she looked at the blind swordsman.

’Something feels wrong about him...’ Aeli thought nervously, her green eyes narrowing behind her dark tinted visor. ’He’s wearing a thick cloth blindfold over his eyes... so why does it feel like he’s looking straight through my disguise and staring directly at my soul?’
Sky stepped up to the mouth of the dark cavern, looking inside the narrow web-choked stone tunnel.
He turned back to Vespera and Aeli, gesturing toward their massive mounts.

"The internal passage of this cave is far too narrow and steep for the wolves to navigate safely," Sky pointed out sensibly. "We’ll have to disengage from our mounts here and assign them to hold perimeter watch outside."
Vespera nodded in agreement. "A solid call."
Vespera swung her body down from Valkyrie’s back, landing lightly on her boots. Aeli followed suit, sliding down off Luna’s saddle.
Vespera turned around, reaching up with her single right hand to gently pat Valkyrie along her silver-furred neck.
"Watch the cave entrance, Valkyrie," Vespera instructed smoothly. "Don’t let any stray spiders escape into the woods."
SLURP!
Valkyrie let out a low affectionate huff and suddenly leaned down, giving Vespera’s cheek a huge loving lick.
Vespera let out a soft melodic female laugh, wiping her cheek with her sleeve as she stroked the direwolf’s head.
"Heh... good girl."
Up on the floating camera drones, the stream viewers went completely wild over the wholesome interaction.
[@GamerGod99: AHHHHHH THE WOLF KISSED HER!]
[@SovereignWatcher: VALKYRIE IS SUCH A GOOD GIRL!]
[@NoobMaster69: I want to be that direwolf so bad bro 😭]
[@PVP_Legend: Blessed Land mounts have 100/10 loyalty!]
[@ValoriaFan: She called her a good girl! My heart is melting!]
With the direwolves posted as perimeter guards outside, the four hunters... Vespera, Aeli, Lord Sky, and Hiro proceeded directly into the subterranean cavern.
The interior of the cave was deeply creepy.
Thick heavy sheets of sticky white spider silk draped across the jagged ceiling like dusty curtains.
The air was cold and smelled strongly of rotting sulfur and stagnant moisture.
Every step they took on the uneven stone echoed ominously through the pitch-black tunnels.
As they walked deeper into the gloom, Vespera’s physical movements betrayed a subtle barely noticeable hesitation.
Whenever her boots brushed past a thick clump of vibrating spider webbing, she subtly shifted her footing, taking a slight step away.
’It’s all according to plan... Now I need Sky to notice.’
Sky, who was walking right beside her, caught the subtle twitch instantly.
His sharp observational eyes tracked the way her shoulders tensed whenever a tiny scout spider skittered across the cave ceiling above them.
’Aha!’ Sky thought triumphantly inside his mind, secretly adding another entry to his mental ledger. ’Vespera is afraid of spiders! Perfect! A psychological weakness!’
Sky looked over at her, offering a warm chivalrous smile beneath his silver alloy mask.
"Are you feeling scared, Lord Vespera?" Sky asked gently, his voice filled with protective concern.
Vespera paused, letting out a soft delicate sigh as she looked at a giant web hanging overhead.
She didn’t bother putting on a fake bravado.
"I have to admit... I am quite scared of spiders," Vespera confessed honestly. "Their extra legs and compound eyes are utterly repulsive."
Sky chuckled warmly, puffing out his chest under his leather armor.
"Don’t worry about a thing," Sky promised gallantly, raising his broadsword slightly. "I’ll protect you from whatever is lurking down here."
The live stream chat caught Sky’s smooth protective line and the comment overlay instantly flooded with reactions.
[@GamerGod99: SKY IS RIZZING HER UP!]
[@SovereignWatcher: "Don’t worry, I’ll protect you!" BRO IS A ROMANTIC!]
[@NoobMaster69: SKY HAS THAT UNLIMITED RIZZ!]
[@PVP_Legend: Shoot your shot Sky!]
[@ValoriaFan: They look so cute together omg!]
[@DarkKnight_00: W Lord Sky protecting the queen!]
[@StreamLover: This stream turned into a dating show lmao!]
[@TacticalNuke: RIZZ LORD SKY!]
[@ProGamer_22: Smooth line Sky, smooth line!]
[@AnimeFanatic: PROTECT HER!]
However... before Sky could enjoy his smooth moment for even two seconds—
STEP!
Vespera turned her deep purple eyes toward him, offering a cool and completely flat response that instantly shut him down.
"I don’t need protecting, Lord Sky," Vespera stated plainly with her raspy voice sharp as steel.
The live stream chat instantly flipped 180 degrees into hilarious merciless scolding as five new comments shot to the top of the HUD.
[@GamerGod99: REJECTED! OUCH!]
[@NoobMaster69: BRO GOT DENIED IN 4K LIVE ON STREAM! 💀]
[@PVP_Legend: She said "I don’t need protecting" LMAO!]
[@ValoriaFan: That was so cruel! Poor Sky!]
[@TacticalNuke: EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!]
Sky’s jaw dropped behind his mask, his face flushing with massive embarrassment as he stammered awkwardly.
"A-Ah... right... of course... you one-shot a Tier 3 Boss earlier..."
Seeing his flustered, embarrassed reaction, Vespera tilted her head slightly.
She offered him a soft and alluring smile, adding with a sweet teasing purr in her voice.
"...However... I wouldn’t mind if it’s you, Lord Sky."
FREEZE.
Sky went completely rigid.

THUD!

And standing at the far end of the chamber, illuminated by the sickly yellow moss, was the Spider Boss.

It was a colossal terrifying monstrosity... easily thirty feet long, covered in jagged, iron-black armor plates, featuring eight glowing purple compound eyes and massive four-foot-long venomous mandibles that clicked aggressively.
Sitting right behind the Spider Boss was a towering clutch of ten massive pulsating spider eggs.
The eggs were each the size of a barrels, translucent white and glowing with a raw life-force mana.
The Spider Boss had literally just deposited the tenth egg onto the pile the exact second the hunters landed.
And surrounding the mother boss was a swarming horde of over fifty Rank 2 Umbral Spiders with their mandibles clicking loudly as they turned their compound eyes toward the intruders.
SCREEEEEECH!
The Spider Queen let out a shrill territorial screech that echoed off the cavern walls.
Sky drew his broadsword with his eyes narrowing behind his alloy mask as he looked at the massive clearing.
"This is the place!" Sky announced loudly. "Wipe them all out!"
"Understood!" Vespera agreed, drawing her longsword with her single right hand as she and Sky shot forward across the silk-covered floor simultaneously.
Standing near the back of the formation, Aeli gripped her wooden focus staff firmly.

’As of right now...’ Aeli thought inside her plastic biker helmet, ’I will strictly stick to using my secondary Ice magic... I can’t reveal my starlight right now... Maybe later in the war to keep them on their edge.’
Aeli slammed the butt of her wooden focus staff against the stone ground.
"Come forth...!"
FWOOSH... CRACKLE!
A terrifying sub-zero wave of sparkling blue frost instantly erupted outward from Aeli’s boots in a wide thirty-meter circle.
The thick white silk on the floor was instantly flash-frozen into brittle black ice.
Over twenty charging Rank 2 spiders had their hairy legs instantly frozen solid to the ground, trapped in blocks of solid glacier ice.
Without pausing, Aeli raised her free hand, condensing her ice mana into five razor-sharp six-foot-long javelins made of dense glowing blue ice.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
With blinding high-speed movements, Aeli hurled the ice javelins through the air like an Olympic athlete.
The frozen projectiles impaled cleanly through the heads of the frozen spiders and the unfrozen adds alike, shattering their carapaces and executing over a dozen monsters in five seconds.
