chapters.title: Chapter 259: Spider’s Lair [II / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Meanwhile, up on the frontline, Vespera was carving a path of total destruction directly toward the Spider Queen.
SWISH! CRUNCH!
Vespera executed a single-handed diagonal slash, cleanly bisecting two Rank 2 spiders that tried to jump her from the left flank.
She didn’t slow her momentum for a single millisecond, charging straight down the central lane toward the towering thirty-foot Boss monster.
’It looks quite terrifying, I guess I really don’t like spiders.’
Seeing the terrifying single-armed female human charging straight toward her, the Spider Queen’s compound eyes shrank in alarm.
"KREE?!"
Vespera raised her longsword, channeling her Gold Core’s wind mana into a sixty-foot razor blade.
’Gale Guillotine!’ Vespera thought.
BOOM!
Vespera unleashed the massive wave of emerald wind blades straight at the Spider Queen’s head. The spell cleaved through the damp air, clearing a wide empty corridor through the remaining spiders.
The Spider Queen’s compound eyes darted behind her body.

Her ten precious, newly laid eggs were resting directly behind her abdomen... If she dodged Vespera’s incoming wind blade, the sixty-foot spell would slam flush into her egg clutch and obliterate her unborn children instantly!
"SCREEEE!"
The Spider Queen chose to protect her nest.
She lurched her massive, thirty-foot body forward, throwing her heavily armored thorax directly into the path of the incoming wind blade to tank the strike.
Or... at least... that was what Vespera originally assumed the monster was doing.
In reality—
FLASH!
The second before the [Gale Guillotine] could touch the monster’s hide, the Spider Queen opened her gaping mandibles and unleashed a blinding high-frequency spray of invisible dense silk threads!
The silk threads were completely transparent to the naked eye up until the exact moment of impact.
They condensed into an intricate inter-locking woven shield floating three feet in front of the monster’s chest!
CLANG... KRA-THOOM!
Vespera’s powerful wind blade slammed flush into the invisible silk shield.

The force of the spell shattered the outer layer of the web armor, penetrating through like a heavy spear and carving a three-inch-deep, bleeding wound into the Spider Queen’s chest carapace but it completely failed to slice deep enough to reach her vital organs!
The Spider Queen let out a painful hiss, stepping back, but her body remained entirely functional.
Vespera pulled her longsword back, her deep purple eyes widening in genuine surprise.

’Are those silk webs really that insanely durable?!’ Silas thought in shock behind his female disguise. ’A point-blank Gale Guillotine infused with my Gold Core mana only carved a shallow three-inch wound through those threads?!’
A sudden economic idea flared inside Silas’s mind.

’If these spider webs possess that level of hyper-dense and spell-repelling durability...’ Silas realized with excitement, ’then I wouldn’t mind at all if those silk threads were brought back to the Keep! Our territory’s Tailor and Thora could use that material to craft legendary spell-resistant robes and lightweight armor sets for all the girls!’
However, there was an obvious logistical problem: a thirty-foot hostile Spider Queen was obviously not going to hand over her priceless silk threads willingly.
Vespera shifted her violet gaze, looking past the wounded Spider Queen to the pile of ten pulsating translucent white eggs resting in the back corner of the cavern.
A plan quickly began forming in Silas’s mind.

’Wait a minute...’ Silas analyzed carefully. ’Are those ten eggs specifically her royal bloodline? The lower-tier worker spiders in this nest don’t seem to possess higher intelligence... they just follow her hive command but her direct egg offspring might hatch into intelligent high-tier spider mounts or web-producers! If I capture those ten eggs alive and take them back to the Blessed Land, Reina could tame them! We could establish an endless internal supply of indestructible silk right inside our own place!’
Silas’s eyes shone with determination.
He was fully prepared to maneuver the fight, subdue the Spider Queen without destroying her nest, and secure those ten eggs as territorial loot.
However... fate had other plans.
At that exact moment, over on the right flank of the chamber—
Hiro, the blindfolded Hero, was currently surrounded by three massive Rank 2 armored spiders.
The beasts were firing continuous streams of sticky webbing and snapping their venomous mandibles at his throat.
Hiro dodged three incoming web sprays with precise, elegant sidesteps with his blindfolded face twisting into an annoyed arrogant scowl.

’This is getting utterly tedious...’ Hiro thought bitterly in his mind, his pride chafing at taking so long to clear lower-tier monsters on live stream. ’I refuse to waste any more time messing around with these worthless bugs while Lord Sky and that woman are watching!’
Hiro drew his broadsword back, channeling his specialized steel mana into an advanced, high-speed execution skill.
’Invisible Blade!’ Hiro thought!
SWISH-SWISH!
Hiro executed two instantaneous microscopic slashes.
Two dense invisible blades of pressurized steel mana shot out, cleanly decapitating the first two Rank 2 spiders before they could even react!
Without pausing for a breath, Hiro whirled around to face the third charging Rank 2 spider... He didn’t use his sword.
Instead, he channeled every ounce of his physical muscle strength into his left boot and delivered a brutal physical kick straight into the spider’s head.
BOOM!
The force was catastrophic as the third Rank 2 spider’s skull was shattered instantly, killing it on impact.
However... Hiro had kicked the spider carcass with far too much un-calculated force.
FWOOSH!

The massive dead spider carcass shot through the air like a heavy cannonball! It flew straight past the wounded Spider Queen, completely overshooting her position, and hurtled straight toward the back corner of the cavern.
CRUNCH! SPLAT! SQUELCH!
The multi-ton dead spider landed with a sickening crushing thud... directly flat on top of the pile of ten precious spider eggs!
All ten translucent white eggs were instantly crushed into pulverized oblivion!
A massive disgusting wave of thick, yellow unborn egg yolk and shattered eggshells erupted violently across the stone floor, filling the entire cavern with the pungent sweet scent of destroyed life.
Inside her disguise, Silas went completely frozen.
’Fucking hell...!’ Silas screamed internally, his face turning pale as he watched millions of credits worth of indestructible silk production get turned into an omelet in a single second!
For one long suffocating heartbeat, total silence gripped the subterranean chamber.
The Spider Queen slowly rotated her massive iron-black head.

Her eight glowing purple compound eyes stared at the crushed remains of her nest... at the thick pool of yellow yolk rapidly spreading across the dirt where her ten unborn children had rested just seconds ago.
Her entire body began to violently tremble.
She turned her compound eyes away from the yolk, her gaze locking directly onto Hiro... who was casually dusting off his leather boot and spitting on the ground without a single care in the world.
The Spider Queen’s mind completely shattered into pure, unadulterated, motherly grief and psychotic, apocalyptic rage!
"SCREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEECH!"

The Spider Queen unleashed a shrill and catastrophic scream of pure agony that was so insanely loud it physically cracked the stone bedrock beneath their boots, blowing a massive shockwave across the entire cavern.
A visible shockwave of sound and dark mana erupted from her gaping mandibles, blowing away the surrounding white silk webbing and sending rock dust raining down from the ceiling.
Her eight glowing purple compound eyes, previously filled with cold predatory instinct, were now burning with pure psychotic hatred.
She didn’t look at Vespera, she didn’t look at Lord Sky, and she didn’t look at Aeli.
Her entire mind was fixated on one single individual... the blindfolded swordsman who had just casually crushed her entire clutch of ten unborn children into a puddle of thick yellow yolk...
BOOM!
The thirty-foot monster lunged forward, her eight hairy iron-armored legs tearing up deep trenches in the stone floor.
She charged straight at Hiro with suicidal reckless speed, completely ignoring her own bleeding chest wound.
Up on the floating camera drones, the live stream chat erupted into a wave of panicked messages...
[@GamerGod99: HOLY SHIT SHE’S GOING CRAZY FOR HIRO!]
[@SovereignWatcher: WATCH OUT HIRO!]
[@NoobMaster69: SHE IS PISSED BRO!]
[@PVP_Legend: Hiro dodge that!]
[@ValoriaFan: Hiro look out!]
Hiro stood his ground, cursing under his breath as the massive shadow of the enraged mother boss enveloped his frame.
"Tch... annoying pest," Hiro muttered bitterly.
Because he wore a thick cloth blindfold over his eyes, Hiro couldn’t visually see the incoming thirty-foot spider.
Instead, his spatial perception relied on atmospheric displacement, sound frequency, and the subtle shifting of air currents caused by movement.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
The Spider Queen lashed out with her front two multi-ton razor limbs, while simultaneously spraying a barrage of high-pressure, sticky white webbing from her spinnerets.
Hiro was instantly forced onto the defensive.
He executed rapid precise sidesteps across the silk-covered ground, his leather boots blurring as he deflected the incoming multi-ton leg stabs with the flat of his broadsword.
CLANG! CLANG! BANG!
Sparks exploded into the damp air with every collision.
Hiro’s teeth were gritted tightly as he felt the force behind the monster’s grief-fueled frenzy.

’She’s moving faster than before,’ Hiro thought, his brow furrowing as he ducked beneath a sweeping web spray that hissed corrosively against the stone wall behind him. ’And against a Tier 3 Boss monster, simple physical deflections aren’t going to create an opening...’
Hiro knew he possessed high-tier wide-area execution techniques capable of cleaving the thirty-foot beast in half instantly.

However, doing so on a live stream would mean exposing yet another one of his hidden trump cards to the global audience and more importantly, to Lord Vespera, who was standing just thirty paces away watching his every move.
Deciding to play it safe for the broadcast, Hiro pushed off his back foot, executing a high-speed backward dash.
ZIP!
While airborne, he channeled his blue steel mana, unleashing a volley of invisible ranged slashes from his blade.
’Invisible Slash!’ Hiro thought.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
Multiple compressed waves of steel mana whirred through the air, striking the Spider Queen’s advancing thorax.
CLANG! CLANG!

Against ordinary monsters, those slashes would have sliced through flesh like butter. But against a Tier 3 Boss monster driving forward with maximum mana reinforcement, the invisible blades merely bounced off her thick black carapace plates, leaving shallow white scratches across her armor.
"SCREEE!"
The monster didn’t even slow down, leaping into the air with her mandibles open wide to crush Hiro’s upper body.
"Hiro!" Lord Sky roared from the left flank.
Sky didn’t stand by and watch his main Hero get overwhelmed.
He stepped forward, thrusting his gauntleted hand toward the airborne Spider Queen while channeling his primary elemental affinity.
’Hydraulic Surge!’ Sky thought.
BOOM!
A massive hundred-gallon torrent of pressurized blue water erupted directly from Sky’s open palm.
The heavy wave of water struck the thirty-foot spider flush in her exposed underbelly mid-leap.
The hydraulic impact was immense.
"GURGHHHH!"

The thirty-foot monster let out a startled shriek as the roaring water current completely canceled her forward momentum, sending her massive multi-ton body tumbling backward through the air until she crashed heavily onto the stone floor, landing completely upside down on her back with her eight hairy legs flailing helplessly.
CRASH!
Standing near the edge of the cavern, Vespera watched the entire exchange with a calm expression on her face.
Inside her female disguise, Silas Graves was studying Hiro with keen interest.

’He’s never used this level of sword control on his regular stream broadcasts before,’ Silas analyzed silently. ’He’s holding back his true output because of the cameras, but his base is remarkably clean.’
Up in the air, Hiro took full advantage of the opportunity Sky had created.
STOMP!
Hiro vaulted off a stone pillar, launching himself high into the cavern rafters directly above the upside-down Spider Queen.
While suspended mid-air, Hiro brought his double-edged broadsword across his chest, the steel blade igniting with an intense sapphire light.
His blindfolded face hardened into a scowl as he channeled his blue mana to its physical compression limit.
’Invisible Slash: Maximum Cuts!’ Hiro thought.
SWISH-SWISH-SWISH-SWISH-SWISH!
Hiro didn’t just swing his sword once or twice... he executed over fifty microscopic stroke variations in less than a tenth of a second.
The ambient air inside the chamber collapsed.
SLICK! SLICK! CRUNCH!
Even though no visible energy beams left his sword, dozens of deep horrifying slash marks violently manifested across the Spider Queen’s exposed underbelly simultaneously.
The hyper-dense wind-and-steel compression carved deeper and deeper through her carapace plates, ripping through muscle tissue and severing internal organs.
Vespera’s deep purple eyes glowed with a faint golden-tinged light as Silas activated his Gold Core sensory perception to break down the technique.
’I see...’ Silas thought with a revelation flashing through his mind. ’I see how the technique actually works.’

sentences.text: Meanwhile, up on the frontline, Vespera was carving a path of total destruction directly toward the Spider Queen.
SWISH!
CRUNCH!
Vespera executed a single-handed diagonal slash, cleanly bisecting two Rank 2 spiders that tried to jump her from the left flank.
She didn’t slow her momentum for a single millisecond, charging straight down the central lane toward the towering thirty-foot Boss monster.
’It looks quite terrifying, I guess I really don’t like spiders.’
Seeing the terrifying single-armed female human charging straight toward her, the Spider Queen’s compound eyes shrank in alarm.
"KREE?!"
Vespera raised her longsword, channeling her Gold Core’s wind mana into a sixty-foot razor blade.
’Gale Guillotine!’ Vespera thought.
BOOM!
Vespera unleashed the massive wave of emerald wind blades straight at the Spider Queen’s head.
The spell cleaved through the damp air, clearing a wide empty corridor through the remaining spiders.
The Spider Queen’s compound eyes darted behind her body.
Her ten precious, newly laid eggs were resting directly behind her abdomen...
If she dodged Vespera’s incoming wind blade, the sixty-foot spell would slam flush into her egg clutch and obliterate her unborn children instantly!
"SCREEEE!"
The Spider Queen chose to protect her nest.
She lurched her massive, thirty-foot body forward, throwing her heavily armored thorax directly into the path of the incoming wind blade to tank the strike.
Or... at least... that was what Vespera originally assumed the monster was doing.
In reality—
FLASH!
The second before the [Gale Guillotine] could touch the monster’s hide, the Spider Queen opened her gaping mandibles and unleashed a blinding high-frequency spray of invisible dense silk threads!
The silk threads were completely transparent to the naked eye up until the exact moment of impact.
They condensed into an intricate inter-locking woven shield floating three feet in front of the monster’s chest!
CLANG...
KRA-THOOM!
Vespera’s powerful wind blade slammed flush into the invisible silk shield.

The force of the spell shattered the outer layer of the web armor, penetrating through like a heavy spear and carving a three-inch-deep, bleeding wound into the Spider Queen’s chest carapace but it completely failed to slice deep enough to reach her vital organs!
The Spider Queen let out a painful hiss, stepping back, but her body remained entirely functional.
Vespera pulled her longsword back, her deep purple eyes widening in genuine surprise.

’Are those silk webs really that insanely durable?!’ Silas thought in shock behind his female disguise. ’A point-blank Gale Guillotine infused with my Gold Core mana only carved a shallow three-inch wound through those threads?!’
A sudden economic idea flared inside Silas’s mind.

’If these spider webs possess that level of hyper-dense and spell-repelling durability...’ Silas realized with excitement, ’then I wouldn’t mind at all if those silk threads were brought back to the Keep!
Our territory’s Tailor and Thora could use that material to craft legendary spell-resistant robes and lightweight armor sets for all the girls!’
However, there was an obvious logistical problem: a thirty-foot hostile Spider Queen was obviously not going to hand over her priceless silk threads willingly.
Vespera shifted her violet gaze, looking past the wounded Spider Queen to the pile of ten pulsating translucent white eggs resting in the back corner of the cavern.
A plan quickly began forming in Silas’s mind.
’Wait a minute...’ Silas analyzed carefully. ’Are those ten eggs specifically her royal bloodline?

The lower-tier worker spiders in this nest don’t seem to possess higher intelligence... they just follow her hive command but her direct egg offspring might hatch into intelligent high-tier spider mounts or web-producers!
If I capture those ten eggs alive and take them back to the Blessed Land, Reina could tame them!
We could establish an endless internal supply of indestructible silk right inside our own place!’
Silas’s eyes shone with determination.
He was fully prepared to maneuver the fight, subdue the Spider Queen without destroying her nest, and secure those ten eggs as territorial loot.
However... fate had other plans.
At that exact moment, over on the right flank of the chamber—
Hiro, the blindfolded Hero, was currently surrounded by three massive Rank 2 armored spiders.
The beasts were firing continuous streams of sticky webbing and snapping their venomous mandibles at his throat.
Hiro dodged three incoming web sprays with precise, elegant sidesteps with his blindfolded face twisting into an annoyed arrogant scowl.

’This is getting utterly tedious...’ Hiro thought bitterly in his mind, his pride chafing at taking so long to clear lower-tier monsters on live stream. ’I refuse to waste any more time messing around with these worthless bugs while Lord Sky and that woman are watching!’
Hiro drew his broadsword back, channeling his specialized steel mana into an advanced, high-speed execution skill.
’Invisible Blade!’ Hiro thought!
SWISH-SWISH!
Hiro executed two instantaneous microscopic slashes.
Two dense invisible blades of pressurized steel mana shot out, cleanly decapitating the first two Rank 2 spiders before they could even react!
Without pausing for a breath, Hiro whirled around to face the third charging Rank 2 spider...
He didn’t use his sword.
Instead, he channeled every ounce of his physical muscle strength into his left boot and delivered a brutal physical kick straight into the spider’s head.
BOOM!
The force was catastrophic as the third Rank 2 spider’s skull was shattered instantly, killing it on impact.
However...
Hiro had kicked the spider carcass with far too much un-calculated force.
FWOOSH!
The massive dead spider carcass shot through the air like a heavy cannonball!
It flew straight past the wounded Spider Queen, completely overshooting her position, and hurtled straight toward the back corner of the cavern.
CRUNCH!
SPLAT!
SQUELCH!
The multi-ton dead spider landed with a sickening crushing thud... directly flat on top of the pile of ten precious spider eggs!
All ten translucent white eggs were instantly crushed into pulverized oblivion!
A massive disgusting wave of thick, yellow unborn egg yolk and shattered eggshells erupted violently across the stone floor, filling the entire cavern with the pungent sweet scent of destroyed life.
Inside her disguise, Silas went completely frozen.
’Fucking hell...!’ Silas screamed internally, his face turning pale as he watched millions of credits worth of indestructible silk production get turned into an omelet in a single second!
For one long suffocating heartbeat, total silence gripped the subterranean chamber.
The Spider Queen slowly rotated her massive iron-black head.

Her eight glowing purple compound eyes stared at the crushed remains of her nest... at the thick pool of yellow yolk rapidly spreading across the dirt where her ten unborn children had rested just seconds ago.
Her entire body began to violently tremble.
She turned her compound eyes away from the yolk, her gaze locking directly onto Hiro... who was casually dusting off his leather boot and spitting on the ground without a single care in the world.
The Spider Queen’s mind completely shattered into pure, unadulterated, motherly grief and psychotic, apocalyptic rage!
"SCREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEECH!"

The Spider Queen unleashed a shrill and catastrophic scream of pure agony that was so insanely loud it physically cracked the stone bedrock beneath their boots, blowing a massive shockwave across the entire cavern.
A visible shockwave of sound and dark mana erupted from her gaping mandibles, blowing away the surrounding white silk webbing and sending rock dust raining down from the ceiling.
Her eight glowing purple compound eyes, previously filled with cold predatory instinct, were now burning with pure psychotic hatred.
She didn’t look at Vespera, she didn’t look at Lord Sky, and she didn’t look at Aeli.
Her entire mind was fixated on one single individual... the blindfolded swordsman who had just casually crushed her entire clutch of ten unborn children into a puddle of thick yellow yolk...
BOOM!
The thirty-foot monster lunged forward, her eight hairy iron-armored legs tearing up deep trenches in the stone floor.
She charged straight at Hiro with suicidal reckless speed, completely ignoring her own bleeding chest wound.
Up on the floating camera drones, the live stream chat erupted into a wave of panicked messages...
[@GamerGod99: HOLY SHIT SHE’S GOING CRAZY FOR HIRO!]
[@SovereignWatcher: WATCH OUT HIRO!]
[@NoobMaster69: SHE IS PISSED BRO!]
[@PVP_Legend: Hiro dodge that!]
[@ValoriaFan: Hiro look out!]
Hiro stood his ground, cursing under his breath as the massive shadow of the enraged mother boss enveloped his frame.
"Tch... annoying pest," Hiro muttered bitterly.
Because he wore a thick cloth blindfold over his eyes, Hiro couldn’t visually see the incoming thirty-foot spider.
Instead, his spatial perception relied on atmospheric displacement, sound frequency, and the subtle shifting of air currents caused by movement.
SWISH!
SWISH!
SWISH!
The Spider Queen lashed out with her front two multi-ton razor limbs, while simultaneously spraying a barrage of high-pressure, sticky white webbing from her spinnerets.
Hiro was instantly forced onto the defensive.
He executed rapid precise sidesteps across the silk-covered ground, his leather boots blurring as he deflected the incoming multi-ton leg stabs with the flat of his broadsword.
CLANG!
CLANG!
BANG!
Sparks exploded into the damp air with every collision.
Hiro’s teeth were gritted tightly as he felt the force behind the monster’s grief-fueled frenzy.

’She’s moving faster than before,’ Hiro thought, his brow furrowing as he ducked beneath a sweeping web spray that hissed corrosively against the stone wall behind him. ’And against a Tier 3 Boss monster, simple physical deflections aren’t going to create an opening...’
Hiro knew he possessed high-tier wide-area execution techniques capable of cleaving the thirty-foot beast in half instantly.

However, doing so on a live stream would mean exposing yet another one of his hidden trump cards to the global audience and more importantly, to Lord Vespera, who was standing just thirty paces away watching his every move.
Deciding to play it safe for the broadcast, Hiro pushed off his back foot, executing a high-speed backward dash.
ZIP!
While airborne, he channeled his blue steel mana, unleashing a volley of invisible ranged slashes from his blade.
’Invisible Slash!’ Hiro thought.
SWISH!
SWISH!
SWISH!
Multiple compressed waves of steel mana whirred through the air, striking the Spider Queen’s advancing thorax.
CLANG!
CLANG!
Against ordinary monsters, those slashes would have sliced through flesh like butter.

But against a Tier 3 Boss monster driving forward with maximum mana reinforcement, the invisible blades merely bounced off her thick black carapace plates, leaving shallow white scratches across her armor.
"SCREEE!"
The monster didn’t even slow down, leaping into the air with her mandibles open wide to crush Hiro’s upper body.
"Hiro!" Lord Sky roared from the left flank.
Sky didn’t stand by and watch his main Hero get overwhelmed.
He stepped forward, thrusting his gauntleted hand toward the airborne Spider Queen while channeling his primary elemental affinity.
’Hydraulic Surge!’ Sky thought.
BOOM!
A massive hundred-gallon torrent of pressurized blue water erupted directly from Sky’s open palm.
The heavy wave of water struck the thirty-foot spider flush in her exposed underbelly mid-leap.
The hydraulic impact was immense.
"GURGHHHH!"

The thirty-foot monster let out a startled shriek as the roaring water current completely canceled her forward momentum, sending her massive multi-ton body tumbling backward through the air until she crashed heavily onto the stone floor, landing completely upside down on her back with her eight hairy legs flailing helplessly.
CRASH!

Inside her female disguise, Silas Graves was studying Hiro with keen interest.

’He’s never used this level of sword control on his regular stream broadcasts before,’ Silas analyzed silently. ’He’s holding back his true output because of the cameras, but his base is remarkably clean.’

’Invisible Slash: Maximum Cuts!’ Hiro thought.

Hiro didn’t just swing his sword once or twice... he executed over fifty microscopic stroke variations in less than a tenth of a second.

SLICK!
CRUNCH!
Even though no visible energy beams left his sword, dozens of deep horrifying slash marks violently manifested across the Spider Queen’s exposed underbelly simultaneously.
The hyper-dense wind-and-steel compression carved deeper and deeper through her carapace plates, ripping through muscle tissue and severing internal organs.
Vespera’s deep purple eyes glowed with a faint golden-tinged light as Silas activated his Gold Core sensory perception to break down the technique.
’I see...’ Silas thought with a revelation flashing through his mind. ’I see how the technique actually works.’

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Freaking Rich! [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Hiro had never uttered the official name of the skill on stream, so Silas assumed the swordsman simply called it "Invisible Slash" in his own internal thoughts.
But in reality, the mechanics were far more intricate and demanding than a simple magic projectile.
Hiro wasn’t just throwing wind mana forward... he was using his broadsword’s edge to slice the air molecules themselves into hyper-compressed frictionless vacuum pockets.
He then used his steel mana as an invisible propellant wave, driving those vacuum pockets forward at Mach 4 velocity.
Because there was no light emission or elemental flame attached to a vacuum pocket, the attack remained completely invisible to the naked eye until it physically impacted the target’s skin.

It was an extraordinary display of advanced swordsmanship... requiring extreme blade control, precise wrist angles, and immense mana compression that would tear an inexperienced swordsman’s forearm tendons to shreds.
’It’s clear he has a profound fundamental understanding of the sword,’ Silas pondered deeply inside his disguise. ’Can I do that too...?’
Silas knew the answer was yes, but it would require practice.
Just because he had witnessed the structural flow of a high-tier skill didn’t mean he could execute it instantly without refining his own physical muscle memory first.
Down on the floor, Hiro wasn’t finished.
As he reached the apex of his flight, his broadsword flared with a terrifying ocean-deep blue light that illuminated the entire cavern.
He plummeted downward like a falling meteor, bringing his broadsword crashing down with every ounce of his physical strength.
"HARRRRGH!" Hiro shouted, his voice echoing loudly off the cave walls.
KRA-THOOM!
The blue blade struck the center of the Spider Queen’s head.

The force cleaved the thirty-foot Tier 3 Boss monster cleanly in half, splitting her entire body from head to abdomen as a towering geyser of black blood and purple fluid sprayed thirty feet into the air, splashing across the stone floor as the two severed halves of the monster collapsed lifelessly into the silk.
Up on the floating stream drones, the comment section exploded with ten instant messages praising his strength:
[@GamerGod99: HOLY SHIT HIRO CLEAVED A TIER 3 BOSS IN HALF!]
[@SovereignWatcher: THAT WAS ABSOLUTE PEAK SWORDSMANSHIP!]
[@NoobMaster69: HIRO IS A MONSTER BRO!]
[@PVP_Legend: THE CUTS WERE TOO CLEAN!]
[@ValoriaFan: Look at that blue aura!]
[@DarkKnight_00: Unmovable Wall’s main hero is insane!]
[@StreamLover: What a finisher!]
[@TacticalNuke: RIP Spider Queen lmao!]
[@AnimeFanatic: THAT WAS SO HYPED!]
Hiro landed lightly on his boots beside the steaming carcass, flicking the black blood off his blade before smoothly sheathing it.
’That thing went down quite fast, didn’t it...’ Vespera thought, watching the blood pool around Hiro’s boots. ’I thought a mutated Tier 3 Boss would have—’
Before Vespera could even finish her internal sentence—
ZIP!
Out from the rear abdomen of the left severed half of the dead Spider Queen, a hidden six-foot-long, razor-sharp poison stinger shot out like a pressurized steel spring.
The Spider Queen had calculated her own death, using the last lingering nerve impulses of her corpse to unleash a final lethal post-mortem trap.
The tip of the long black stinger was dripping with a thick pitch-black liquid that radiated a toxic core-corroding mana capable of permanently crippling an un-shielded warrior’s magic channels.
The toxic stinger flew straight toward Hiro’s exposed, blindfolded back at point-blank range.
Vespera’s sharp purple eyes caught the incoming projectile instantly.

With her single-armed lightweight agility and her Gold Core wind magic, Vespera easily possessed the reaction speed required to step forward, draw her sword, and deflect the poison stinger before it could touch Hiro’s armor.
Her hand twitched slightly on her sword hilt... but she didn’t move an inch.

’Why the hell would I intervene?’ Silas thought coldly behind his female disguise with cold logic dictating his inaction. ’We aren’t friends... In six days, Hiro is going to be standing on the opposite side of a battlefield trying to cut down my commanders. If he gets stabbed by a high-tier toxic stinger right now and spends the next week bedridden with a corroded mana core... that is a massive, free advantage for the Blessed Land.’
Silas watched the black stinger close the distance, fully prepared to enjoy the sight of an enemy champion getting incapacitated by his own arrogance.
However—
CLANG!
Hiro cursed softly under his breath.
Without even turning his head, his spatial vibration perception picked up the displacement of air behind his spine.
He executed an impossibly tight, blind turn, drawing his broadsword just two inches to slap the incoming stinger away with the flat of his blade.
The toxic stinger hit the stone wall, shattering into harmless fragments as the black poison hissed against the rock.
"Tch... persistent bug," Hiro grumbled, sheathing his sword again.
Vespera let out a long quiet exhale through her nose.
To Lord Sky and the live stream viewers watching on camera, it looked like Vespera was letting out a soft sigh of relief, relieved that her ally had survived a sneaky trap.
In reality... it was a long, deeply disappointed sigh over a missed tactical opportunity.
’Dammit,’ Silas grumbled internally. ’Fucker actually blocked it. Would’ve saved me a lot of trouble next week if that poison hit him.’
Lord Sky walked over, sheathing his broadsword with a satisfied smile beneath his alloy mask.
He looked around at the destroyed cavern, raising his hand toward the group.
"Outstanding work, team!" Sky congratulated cheerfully. "We’ve successfully wiped out the spider nest and eliminated the scouting threat to our camp!"
Vespera offered him a polite, charming smile, her raspy voice returning to its pleasant hospitable tone. "A clean execution, Lord Sky."
Sky looked down at the massive, severed halves of the Spider Queen, stepping forward while opening his Lord Inventory interface. "Let me gather the monster meat so my logistics staff can process it—"
Before Sky could touch the carcass, Vespera’s face subtly scrunched up into a look of genuine disgust. She raised her single right hand, stopping him with an urgent gesture.

"Don’t bother, Lord Sky," Vespera warned him flatly, her voice filled with experienced conviction. "I’ve already had my own cooks attempt to prepare spider meat back at my territory. Trust me... no amount of boiling, roasting, or Valorian spices can fix it. It tastes like bitter, rubbery sulfur, and it’s a complete waste of your inventory space."
Sky paused, his hand hovering inches away from the black carapace. He looked at her serious disgusted expression, blinking behind his mask.
"O-Ooh..." Sky mumbled sheepishly, pulling his hand back. "Right... good to know. Thanks for the heads up."
An hour later, back at the western border clearing...
The late night air was cool and crisp, lit by the glowing campfires of ’The Unmovable Wall.’
Near the base of the colossal three-story mobile war-rig, Lord Sky finished setting down the final wooden supply crate from his private vaults.
"And that’s the last of it!" Sky announced proudly, dusting off his gauntlets.
True to his word, Sky had provided an extraordinary trade package in exchange for the four tons of game Vespera had delivered earlier.

Neatly stacked in front of Vespera were ten additional ingots of rare Central City True-Silver Tungsten alloy, three wooden variation boxes filled with exotic Valorian spices... and resting right on top of the stack were several vacuum-sealed, frozen packages of pure, authentic Earth food.
Real, genuine, high-grade chicken!
Vespera’s deep purple eyes fixed onto the frozen poultry packages.
Inside her female disguise, Silas felt his mouth literally salivating. His golden-ringed eyes sparkled with food joy!

’ACTUAL CHICKEN!’ Silas cheered internally, his soul practically weeping with happiness. ’Real, honest-to-god chicken breasts and drumsticks! No more eating slimy, roasted Basin worms that merely taste like chicken! I get to eat actual chicken tonight or tomorrow...!’
Vespera quickly reached out her single right hand, touching the trade stack.
FLASH!
With a smooth spatial shimmer, the alloys, spices, and precious frozen chicken vanished cleanly into her Lord Inventory.
She looked at Sky, bowing her black-haired head gracefully.
"Thank you, Lord Sky," Vespera thanked him warmly, her voice filled with deep appreciation. "Your generosity is unmatched."
Sky smiled warmly behind his silver mask.
He gestured toward his six floating camera drones hovering overhead, which were still actively broadcasting to the global network.
"Before we wrap up for the night," Sky requested politely, "let’s say a formal goodbye to the live stream chat."
Vespera offered the central camera drone a breathtaking, radiant smile, raising her single hand in an elegant wave. "Goodnight, everyone. Until next time."
Beside her, Aeli who was still wearing her giant, neon-yellow motorcycle helmet timidly stepped forward.
Clinging tightly to Vespera’s empty left sleeve, the helmeted elven arcanist raised her white-gloved hand and offered a tiny, adorable wave toward the lens.
"G-Goodnight..." Aeli whispered softly from inside her plastic visor.
The live stream chat went into one final explosive meltdown of sweet goodbye messages before Sky tapped his helmet button.
[@GamerGod99: GOODNIGHT MY QUEEN VESPERA! ❤️]
[@SovereignWatcher: GOODNIGHT HELMET JADE BEAUTY! 👋]
[@NoobMaster69: BEST STREAM EVER SKY!]
[@PVP_Legend: See you guys at the Lord War next week! 🛡️]
[@ValoriaFan: Sleep well Lord Vespera! ✨]
[@DarkKnight_00: Peak broadcast! 10/10!]
CLICK!
Sky turned off the stream broadcast.
The six brass camera drones powered down, their glowing blue lenses going dark as they whirred back into their mechanical housing compartments on his armor.
The moment the broadcast went offline, Sky pulled up his private Lord analytics HUD to check his stream metrics for the evening session.
When his eyes landed on the final viewer counter, Sky froze dead in his tracks!
’Fifty million...?’ Sky thought, his jaw dropping beneath his alloy mask in mind-shattering shock. ’Just this short, one-hour late-night stream hit 50,000,000 CONCURRENT VIEWERS?!’
It was an utterly insane record-breaking figure!
Under normal circumstances, Sky considered himself an extraordinarily successful streamer.
On an average broadcast traveling across standard sectors, he usually averaged roughly 8 to 9 million viewers... maybe peaking at 12 million if a major boss battle was taking place.

His primary revenue didn’t even come from direct stream ads... it came from multi-million-dollar corporate sponsorships, ad revenue from his official LordTube highlight channel (which regularly pulled tens of millions of views per video), and recurring monthly subscriptions on his private creator platform, Itraeon.
Subscriber platforms like Itraeon alone netted him millions of Spirit Credits every single month.
But today... simply by collaborating with ’Lord Vespera’ and the Blessed Land for less than twenty-four hours, his numbers had entered an astronomical dimension!
Their brief afternoon meeting stream had topped out at 35 million viewers, and this late-night spider hunt had shattered records with 50 million active concurrent screens.
Not only that, but earlier today on camera, Sky had casually posed for a quick promotional screenshot alongside Vespera.
According to his live Itraeon dashboard, over one hundred thousand new paid members had signed up for his premium tier in the past six hours just to download those high-definition photos of Vespera.
His net earnings for today alone were staggering...

’This is insane...’ Sky thought, a quiet disbelieving laugh escaping his throat. ’At this rate... the central banking branch back in Valoria City might actually have to temporarily block or audit my corporate account because of how much money is pouring in!’

Vespera didn’t know the exact financial figures scrolling across Sky’s private HUD, but seeing the masked Lord standing there quietly chuckling to himself while staring into empty air gave Silas a deeply suspicious uneasy feeling.

’What the hell is this guy laughing about to himself in the dark...?’ Silas thought dryly behind his female disguise with a chill running down his neck. ’There is zero chance whatever he’s thinking about is anything wholesome.’
Vespera cleared her throat softly, breaking Sky out of his financial trance.
"In any case," Vespera spoke, her raspy female voice drawing his attention, "thank you again for the trade goods and the real chicken, Lord Sky."
Sky snapped out of his thoughts, waving his hands cheerfully. "Oh, think nothing of it! You earned every bit of it tonight!"
Sky looked at her with his masked face tilting slightly as he asked with genuine interest.
"So... are you busy tomorrow, Lord Vespera? If you’re free, you’re more than welcome to visit my mobile fortress again. I’d be happy to make it well worth your time."
Vespera looked at him with a slightly strange and deadpan expression with her purple eyes flickering.
"I will be quite busy as of tomorrow, Lord Sky," Vespera answered plainly. "I have to begin immediate, intensive preparations for our upcoming war."
Sky paused, then nodded his head in understanding. "Ah... right. The Lord War in six days. Of course."
Sky offered a warm, polite bow. "Well, if you happen to find any free time between your preparations, the offer stands. Have a safe ride back."
"Sure," Vespera replied neutrally.

With her single-armed lightweight agility and her Gold Core wind magic, Vespera easily possessed the reaction speed required to step forward, draw her sword, and deflect the poison stinger before it could touch Hiro’s armor.
Her hand twitched slightly on her sword hilt... but she didn’t move an inch.
’Why the hell would I intervene?’ Silas thought coldly behind his female disguise with cold logic dictating his inaction. ’We aren’t friends...
In six days, Hiro is going to be standing on the opposite side of a battlefield trying to cut down my commanders.
If he gets stabbed by a high-tier toxic stinger right now and spends the next week bedridden with a corroded mana core... that is a massive, free advantage for the Blessed Land.’
Silas watched the black stinger close the distance, fully prepared to enjoy the sight of an enemy champion getting incapacitated by his own arrogance.
However—
CLANG!
Hiro cursed softly under his breath.
Without even turning his head, his spatial vibration perception picked up the displacement of air behind his spine.
He executed an impossibly tight, blind turn, drawing his broadsword just two inches to slap the incoming stinger away with the flat of his blade.
The toxic stinger hit the stone wall, shattering into harmless fragments as the black poison hissed against the rock.
"Tch... persistent bug," Hiro grumbled, sheathing his sword again.
Vespera let out a long quiet exhale through her nose.
To Lord Sky and the live stream viewers watching on camera, it looked like Vespera was letting out a soft sigh of relief, relieved that her ally had survived a sneaky trap.
In reality... it was a long, deeply disappointed sigh over a missed tactical opportunity.
’Dammit,’ Silas grumbled internally. ’Fucker actually blocked it.
Would’ve saved me a lot of trouble next week if that poison hit him.’
Lord Sky walked over, sheathing his broadsword with a satisfied smile beneath his alloy mask.
He looked around at the destroyed cavern, raising his hand toward the group.
"Outstanding work, team!" Sky congratulated cheerfully.
"We’ve successfully wiped out the spider nest and eliminated the scouting threat to our camp!"
Vespera offered him a polite, charming smile, her raspy voice returning to its pleasant hospitable tone.
"A clean execution, Lord Sky."
Sky looked down at the massive, severed halves of the Spider Queen, stepping forward while opening his Lord Inventory interface.
"Let me gather the monster meat so my logistics staff can process it—"
Before Sky could touch the carcass, Vespera’s face subtly scrunched up into a look of genuine disgust.
She raised her single right hand, stopping him with an urgent gesture.
"Don’t bother, Lord Sky," Vespera warned him flatly, her voice filled with experienced conviction.
"I’ve already had my own cooks attempt to prepare spider meat back at my territory.
Trust me... no amount of boiling, roasting, or Valorian spices can fix it.
It tastes like bitter, rubbery sulfur, and it’s a complete waste of your inventory space."
Sky paused, his hand hovering inches away from the black carapace.
He looked at her serious disgusted expression, blinking behind his mask.
"O-Ooh..." Sky mumbled sheepishly, pulling his hand back.
"Right... good to know.
Thanks for the heads up."
An hour later, back at the western border clearing...
The late night air was cool and crisp, lit by the glowing campfires of ’The Unmovable Wall.’
Near the base of the colossal three-story mobile war-rig, Lord Sky finished setting down the final wooden supply crate from his private vaults.
"And that’s the last of it!" Sky announced proudly, dusting off his gauntlets.
True to his word, Sky had provided an extraordinary trade package in exchange for the four tons of game Vespera had delivered earlier.

Neatly stacked in front of Vespera were ten additional ingots of rare Central City True-Silver Tungsten alloy, three wooden variation boxes filled with exotic Valorian spices... and resting right on top of the stack were several vacuum-sealed, frozen packages of pure, authentic Earth food.
Real, genuine, high-grade chicken!
Vespera’s deep purple eyes fixed onto the frozen poultry packages.
Inside her female disguise, Silas felt his mouth literally salivating.
His golden-ringed eyes sparkled with food joy!
’ACTUAL CHICKEN!’ Silas cheered internally, his soul practically weeping with happiness. ’Real, honest-to-god chicken breasts and drumsticks!
No more eating slimy, roasted Basin worms that merely taste like chicken!
I get to eat actual chicken tonight or tomorrow...!’
Vespera quickly reached out her single right hand, touching the trade stack.
FLASH!
With a smooth spatial shimmer, the alloys, spices, and precious frozen chicken vanished cleanly into her Lord Inventory.
She looked at Sky, bowing her black-haired head gracefully.
"Thank you, Lord Sky," Vespera thanked him warmly, her voice filled with deep appreciation.
"Your generosity is unmatched."
Sky smiled warmly behind his silver mask.
He gestured toward his six floating camera drones hovering overhead, which were still actively broadcasting to the global network.
"Before we wrap up for the night," Sky requested politely, "let’s say a formal goodbye to the live stream chat."
Vespera offered the central camera drone a breathtaking, radiant smile, raising her single hand in an elegant wave.
"Goodnight, everyone.
Until next time."
Beside her, Aeli who was still wearing her giant, neon-yellow motorcycle helmet timidly stepped forward.
Clinging tightly to Vespera’s empty left sleeve, the helmeted elven arcanist raised her white-gloved hand and offered a tiny, adorable wave toward the lens.
"G-Goodnight..." Aeli whispered softly from inside her plastic visor.
The live stream chat went into one final explosive meltdown of sweet goodbye messages before Sky tapped his helmet button.
[@GamerGod99: GOODNIGHT MY QUEEN VESPERA! ❤️]
[@SovereignWatcher: GOODNIGHT HELMET JADE BEAUTY! 👋]
[@NoobMaster69: BEST STREAM EVER SKY!]
[@PVP_Legend: See you guys at the Lord War next week! 🛡️]
[@ValoriaFan: Sleep well Lord Vespera! ✨]
[@DarkKnight_00: Peak broadcast!
CLICK!
Sky turned off the stream broadcast.
The six brass camera drones powered down, their glowing blue lenses going dark as they whirred back into their mechanical housing compartments on his armor.
The moment the broadcast went offline, Sky pulled up his private Lord analytics HUD to check his stream metrics for the evening session.
When his eyes landed on the final viewer counter, Sky froze dead in his tracks!
’Fifty million...?’ Sky thought, his jaw dropping beneath his alloy mask in mind-shattering shock. ’Just this short, one-hour late-night stream hit 50,000,000 CONCURRENT VIEWERS?!’
It was an utterly insane record-breaking figure!
Under normal circumstances, Sky considered himself an extraordinarily successful streamer.
On an average broadcast traveling across standard sectors, he usually averaged roughly 8 to 9 million viewers... maybe peaking at 12 million if a major boss battle was taking place.

His primary revenue didn’t even come from direct stream ads... it came from multi-million-dollar corporate sponsorships, ad revenue from his official LordTube highlight channel (which regularly pulled tens of millions of views per video), and recurring monthly subscriptions on his private creator platform, Itraeon.
Subscriber platforms like Itraeon alone netted him millions of Spirit Credits every single month.
But today... simply by collaborating with ’Lord Vespera’ and the Blessed Land for less than twenty-four hours, his numbers had entered an astronomical dimension!
Their brief afternoon meeting stream had topped out at 35 million viewers, and this late-night spider hunt had shattered records with 50 million active concurrent screens.
Not only that, but earlier today on camera, Sky had casually posed for a quick promotional screenshot alongside Vespera.
According to his live Itraeon dashboard, over one hundred thousand new paid members had signed up for his premium tier in the past six hours just to download those high-definition photos of Vespera.
His net earnings for today alone were staggering...

’This is insane...’ Sky thought, a quiet disbelieving laugh escaping his throat. ’At this rate... the central banking branch back in Valoria City might actually have to temporarily block or audit my corporate account because of how much money is pouring in!’

Vespera didn’t know the exact financial figures scrolling across Sky’s private HUD, but seeing the masked Lord standing there quietly chuckling to himself while staring into empty air gave Silas a deeply suspicious uneasy feeling.

’What the hell is this guy laughing about to himself in the dark...?’ Silas thought dryly behind his female disguise with a chill running down his neck. ’There is zero chance whatever he’s thinking about is anything wholesome.’
Vespera cleared her throat softly, breaking Sky out of his financial trance.
"In any case," Vespera spoke, her raspy female voice drawing his attention, "thank you again for the trade goods and the real chicken, Lord Sky."
Sky snapped out of his thoughts, waving his hands cheerfully.
"Oh, think nothing of it!
You earned every bit of it tonight!"
Sky looked at her with his masked face tilting slightly as he asked with genuine interest.
"So... are you busy tomorrow, Lord Vespera?
If you’re free, you’re more than welcome to visit my mobile fortress again.
I’d be happy to make it well worth your time."
Vespera looked at him with a slightly strange and deadpan expression with her purple eyes flickering.
"I will be quite busy as of tomorrow, Lord Sky," Vespera answered plainly.
"I have to begin immediate, intensive preparations for our upcoming war."
Sky paused, then nodded his head in understanding.
"Ah... right.
The Lord War in six days.
Of course."
Sky offered a warm, polite bow.
"Well, if you happen to find any free time between your preparations, the offer stands.
Have a safe ride back."
"Sure," Vespera replied neutrally.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Morwenna’s Lesson [I / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: She turned on her boot, walking over to Valkyrie, while Aeli trotted over to Luna.
Vespera effortlessly swung her single-armed body up onto the silver direwolf’s broad back, while Aeli mounted Luna, holding onto the reins with her giant motorcycle helmet bouncing slightly.
"Goodbye, Lord Sky. Goodbye, Hiro," Vespera called out over her shoulder.
"Safe travels, Lord Vespera!" Sky called back, while Hiro offered a stiff, silent nod.
Vespera pressed her boots against Valkyrie’s flanks. "Let us return!"
HOWL!
GRRR-RUFF!

The two wolves exploded out of the clearing with their heavy paws tearing through the dark mud as they launched themselves into the misty purple forest at high speed, shooting back toward the Territory.
As the trees blurred past their vision and the freezing wind whipped against their faces, Vespera let out a long and deeply exhausted sigh.
Inside her disguise, Silas felt thoroughly drained from playing the charming polite female diplomat for hours on end.
Vespera turned her deep purple eyes toward Aeli, who was riding smoothly beside her on Luna’s saddle.

"So..." Vespera asked softly over the roaring wind, her voice filled with gentle affection. "How did it feel out there tonight, Aeli? Was it too overwhelming handling the stream cameras and those men?"
Inside her giant neon biker helmet, Aeli sat up straight, taking a moment to gather her thoughts before answering honestly.

"It was... remarkably stressful, My Lord," Aeli admitted softly, her muffled voice echoing from inside the visor. "Having millions of strange eyes watching my every movement was terrifying... and that blind swordsman gave me a very strange feeling."
Aeli turned her helmeted face toward Vespera, her silver eyes sparkling behind the dark visor as a sweet rosy flush touched her cheeks.
"...However," Aeli added, her voice dropping into a soft melodic purr, "I loved every single second of it... because I got to spend so much time right beside my Lord."
Vespera stared at the flustered, helmeted elven arcanist, feeling an irresistible wave of pure warmth wash over her heart.
A soft and deeply fond smile curved Vespera’s lips. She reached across the gap between their running mounts, gently patting Aeli’s helmeted head.
"Heh... you really are so cute, Aeli," Vespera praised her softly, stroking the smooth plastic of the helmet.
Aeli let out an adorable, muffled squeak of pure bliss, leaning her helmet deeply into Vespera’s hand as they rode through the night.
Ten minutes later, the two direwolves broke through the thick forest canopy, sliding to a rhythmic stop atop a small grassy ridge overlooking the domain boundary.
Standing directly before them was the towering, breathtaking regional barrier that Eluned had constructed earlier this afternoon... the [Canopy of the World Tree].
From the inside looking out, the barrier was completely invisible but looking at it from the outside world... the scene was utterly bizarre and awe-inspiring!
Spanning the entire two-mile radius of the Blessed Land was a colossal opaque dome of dense, swirling emerald spirit mist and shifting floral light.

The barrier continuously bent the surrounding ambient light and spatial geometry, making the physical landmass behind it appear like a warped undulating green mirage that completely repelled all optical focus, spyglass lenses, and reconnaissance magic.
It looked less like a standard territorial wall, and more like a sacred hidden realm belonging to an ancient nature deity.
Vespera smiled, deeply impressed by Eluned’s divine craftsmanship.
"Let’s go home," Vespera instructed softly.
FWOOSH!
Valkyrie and Luna charged straight into the swirling emerald wall.

The moment their bodies crossed the threshold of the barrier, the strange, light-warping distortion instantly vanished... The cold gloomy twilight of the Umbral Basin was replaced by the warm and energy-rich atmosphere of the Blessed Land!
Standing tall and majestic ahead were the opened Steel Weave Gates.
The guards stationed atop the battlements waved their longbows in greeting, welcoming their Lord back as Valkyrie and Luna trotted smoothly into the Keep’s central courtyard.
THUD!
Vespera and Aeli dismounted their wolves, stepping onto the cobblestones.
Vespera reached out with her single right hand, gently patting Valkyrie and Luna behind their ears.
"Thank you for the hard run, girls. Go get some rest."
GRRR-RUFF!
The two Blessed wolves let out happy rumbling barks, turning and trotting off toward the Beast Pavilion where the wolf pack resided.
Aeli reached up with both hands, unlatching her massive, neon-yellow motorcycle helmet and pulling it off her head.
Her long luxurious silver hair cascaded over her white robes with her pale face flushed with fresh air.
She turned to Vespera, bowing politely.
"I am going to head over to the Foundry immediately, My Lord," Aeli reported eagerly. "Thora and I are going to work on weaving a proper full-body spatial camouflage disguise for me before war day!"
Vespera smiled warmly, nodding her black-haired head. "Good idea, Aeli. Don’t stay up too late."
"Goodnight, My Lord!" Aeli beamed, clutching her helmet under her arm as she turned and sprinted enthusiastically across the moonlit courtyard toward the glowing forge of the Foundry.
With Aeli gone, Vespera was left standing entirely alone in the quiet center of the courtyard.
She let out a long slow breath, stretching her single right arm as her deep purple eyes looked up at the grand stone architecture of the Keep.
’Finally...’ Silas thought inside his female disguise with a wave of relief washing over his mind. ’Finally, I can go inside, take off this disguise ring, get my male body back, and rest...’
Vespera turned, stepping up the wide stone stairs of the Keep’s front porch.
She reached out her single right hand, pushing open the heavy double doors, stepping into the warm, torch-lit entry hall.
However—
WHOOSH!
The second Vespera crossed the threshold into the hall, a sudden high-speed displacement of air whistled straight toward her face.
ZIP!
Vespera’s Gold Core combat instincts flared instantly.
Without even looking, her single right hand shot upward like a striking viper, her fingers snapping shut around a heavy, solid wooden object floating inches away from her nose.
CLACK!
Vespera blinked her violet eyes, looking down at her hand.
She was holding a heavy unsharpened wooden training longsword.
Standing in the center of the grand entry hall, leaning casually against a carved stone pillar with her long, leather-clad legs crossed, was Morwenna.
The feral Pirate Queen wore her Corsair strapped to her hip, her stormy gray eyes burning with a fierce amused light as a wide toothy smirk spread across her gorgeous face.
Morwenna pushed off the stone pillar, taking two slow deliberate steps toward Vespera, her hips swaying with natural grace.
"Come on, Captain," Morwenna spoke, her husky voice echoing through the quiet hall. "Tonight... you’re mine."
She tilted her head, her gray eyes locking onto Vespera’s single-armed female form with absolute, uncompromising determination.

"I promised I’d teach you," Morwenna reminded him, her smirk widening. "I’m going to force you to master the footwork of the Tidal-Blade Sub-Style and the high-velocity redirection of the Tidal-Blade Second Style tonight before I even think about letting you go to sleep."
Vespera stood in the doorway holding the wooden practice sword, staring at the predatory Pirate Queen in deadpan silence.
Inside her mind, Silas let out a long exasperated mental sigh, pinching the bridge of his nose.
’Couldn’t I at least get a thirty-minute rest first...?’ Silas complained in his own internal thoughts, feeling his aching muscles.
And yet... as Silas looked at Morwenna’s fierce confident smirk and felt the wooden sword in his palm, a slow eager smile slowly spread across Vespera’s lips.
He followed Morwenna down the stone corridor toward the lower training vaults.
Because truth be told... Silas wouldn’t have it any other way.
The air inside the training vault was cool and damp, scented with the familiar, earthy musk of granite bedrock.
Torch fire flickered softly along the perimeter wall sconces, casting long, dancing shadows across the expansive stone floor.
Morwenna stood near the center of the training floor with her corsair resting sheathed against her left hip.
Her stormy gray eyes narrowed as she closed them halfway, staring intently at the single-armed black-haired female form that her Lord was currently inhabiting.
A long, thoughtful moment passed before the Dread Queen let out a quiet exhale through her nose.
"Switch back to your original body, Captain," Morwenna instructed, her voice dropping into its natural, husky rasp.
Silas blinked his deep purple eyes, tilting his head slightly. "Oh? You don’t want me practicing the footwork inside Vespera’s vessel first?"
Morwenna shook her head, running a hand through her messy, sea-swept hair.

"It’s better to learn new physical techniques when you are at your absolute full, native strength," Morwenna explained logically with her sharp eyes meeting his. "Your original frame has your true reach, your true muscle density, and your natural center of gravity. If you try to learn the foundational mechanics of a new sword style inside a lightweight single-armed body first, your brain will adapt to a shorter reach and a shifted axis. Learn it in your real form until the muscle memory is burned into your soul... then translating it to the lady’s body will be child’s play."
Silas listened quietly, the sheer pragmatic wisdom behind her words settling instantly in his mind.

’She’s completely right,’ Silas thought, impressed by her natural martial intellect. ’Building the neural pathways in my true body makes way more sense than trying to hack it together inside a disguise.’
Without another word, Silas reached up with his single right hand and pulled the black disguise ring off his left ring finger.
BOOM!
A brief brilliant wave of golden Gold Core mana erupted from his chest, wrapping around his frame in a warm swirling vortex.
In a fraction of a second, the single-armed female Lord dissolved completely.

Standing on the stone training floor was Silas Graves... restored to his imposing six-foot-two height, his broad, muscular shoulders, his short dark hair, his glowing golden-ringed eyes, and both of his powerful calloused hands.
Silas flexed his left fingers, rolling his shoulders with a satisfied grunt. "Alright. Back in the main driver’s seat."
Morwenna folded her arms over her leather-clad chest, a faint, approving smirk touching her lips as she looked up at his true form.
"Now then," Morwenna began, her tone shifting into that of a seasoned swordmaster. "Do you still remember the First Style of the Tidal-Blade Arts?"
Silas let out a short confident laugh, resting his right hand casually on the pommel of his wooden practice sword.
"How could I possibly forget?" Silas answered smoothly. "I literally executed it yesterday during our spar."
Morwenna remembered it clearly.
Not only had Silas executed the First Style but he had managed to weave the directional mana vector while suspended mid-air!
For a man who had only learned this a short time ago, executing advanced water-blade mechanics while airborne was a staggering feat of spatial awareness...
It was one of the primary reasons her pride as a Dread Queen swelled whenever she looked at him.
He wasn’t just some lucky person sitting behind a desk... he was a natural martial sponge who absorbed combat techniques at a terrifying speed.

"Good," Morwenna acknowledged, a rare glint of genuine pride shining in her gray eyes. "Your execution of the First Style proved to me that your core control is ready for the next level. But before I teach you the Second Style... we need to cover the Sub-Style."
Silas paused, his eyebrows pulling together. "The Sub-Style?"
He recalled her words from earlier tonight when they had met in the Keep’s entry hall.
She had explicitly mentioned wanting to teach him the Tidal-Blade Sub-Style alongside the Second Style.
"That’s right," Morwenna nodded, taking a slow step forward.
Her boots made a crisp echoing tap against the granite floor.
She stopped five paces away, looking into his golden eyes. "Tell me, Captain... do you know what makes a blade a blade?"
Silas stared at her, entering deep thought.
He was a guy from Earth who had spent years studying combat theory, physics, and weapon mechanics back at the academy.
He figured she was asking a deep philosophical question about the essence of martial arts.

"Well," Silas began, clearing his throat as he delivered a structured analytical answer, "fundamentally speaking, a blade is an instrument designed for kinetic force concentration. By tapering metal down to a microscopic wedge, you minimize the surface area of impact. When you swing the hilt, the energy produced by your hips, shoulders, and core is concentrated entirely along that razor-thin edge, allowing the shear stress applied to a target’s material structure to exceed its ultimate tensile strength. Combined with proper edge alignment and fluid mass distribution—"
"Stop. Just stop," Morwenna interrupted flatly, raising her hand to cut him off mid-sentence.
She rubbed her forehead with a heavy, exasperated sigh, looking at him like he was an alien speaking gibberish.
"What?" Silas blinked, completely thrown off. "Was my explanation incorrect?"
"You’re saying far too much," Morwenna grumbled, shaking her head.
She held up a single finger, delivering her answer in the most blunt simple terms possible.
"What makes a blade a blade... is its ability to cut."
Silas froze completely.
He stood there in the vault, staring at the Pirate Queen in utter deadpan silence for three solid seconds.
It wasn’t because her words were so profoundly philosophical that they shattered his entire perspective on life...
No. It was the exact opposite.

"Isn’t that literally what I’ve been saying this whole time?!" Silas complained out loud, gesturing with his hands in disbelief. "I just explained the physics of cutting! You just summarized my entire explanation into seven words!"
