She simply dropped into a strange unusual combat stance, her raspy voice filled with an ominous warning.
"Just come at me with everything you’ve got, Captain.
Because... this presentation is going to be quite painful for you.
And while you attack... try your best to perceive what’s happening."
Silas looked at her serious expression, letting out a quiet sigh through his nose.
’As long as she doesn’t go after my ass cheek...’ Silas thought, ’it’s fine.
A little physical pain during sword practice is normal.’
Silas raised his wooden blade, carefully analyzing Morwenna’s new stance.
Morwenna was holding her wooden cutlass unusually high... positioning the blade high above her right shoulder with her elbows flared outward.
To any trained martial artist, this stance was completely absurd.
By holding her sword that high, her lower torso, stomach, and ribs were left completely bare, wide open, and exposed to an immediate thrust or slash.
’It’s really going to hurt for Captain...’ Morwenna thought internally, feeling a brief pang of sympathy for him.
Truth be told, Morwenna actually disliked the Second Style slightly.

Out of all the various techniques in the Tidal-Blade Arts, the Second Style was the one that had taken her the longest time to master... requiring decades of intense atmospheric perception and core refinement back during her ocean days.
In a logical martial progression, a style this complex and painful should have been placed much later in the curriculum... perhaps as the Tenth or Eleventh Style.
But Morwenna loved variety!
In her mind, training should never be boring or predictable.
She preferred a rhythm where the First Style was easy, the Second Style was brutally hard, the Third Style was easy again, and the Fourth Style was a nightmare!
That chaotic unpredictable progression kept her mind sharp and her combat instinct razor-focused.
"Ready when you are, Captain!" Morwenna called out!
Silas didn’t hesitate.
Seeing her stomach left completely wide open and exposed by that bizarre high-sword stance, Silas’s instincts told him to exploit the opening immediately.
BOOM!

Silas exploded forward across the stone floor at high speed, he closed the distance in a fraction of a second, bringing his wooden longsword around in a devastating high-speed horizontal thrust aimed straight into her bare undefended stomach.
However...
That glaring undefended stomach opening was exactly what Morwenna wanted him to target.
The second Silas initiated his forward thrust—
Morwenna activated the technique!
’Tidal-Blade Second Style...’ Morwenna thought.
FWOOSH.
A subtle invisible pulse of high-pressure water mana erupted into the ambient air around Silas’s body.
To Silas, nothing seemed to change but to Morwenna... her entire perception of reality underwent a mind-boggling cosmic shift.
Time visually slowed down to a crawl.
In Morwenna’s hyper-focused perception, Silas’s high-speed forward thrust looked like a snail crawling through thick molasses.
But more importantly... the pressure-sensing water aura surrounding his body instantly highlighted dozens of microscopic flaws, delays, and structural weaknesses in his combat stance.

Lines of glowing blue light current materialized across Silas’s body in her vision... pointing to a slight weight imbalance in his left heel, a microscopic delay in his shoulder rotation, an open gap under his armpit, and an undefended rib alignment!
Naturally, Morwenna targeted the weakest and most vulnerable flaw!
ZIP!
Morwenna didn’t block his sword and she didn’t dodge backward.
Pressurized water mana violently erupted through her legs like a roaring ocean rip-current.
In an instantaneous terrifying burst of velocity that completely bypassed the concept of linear speed, Morwenna vanished from his line of sight.
BANG!
"UGHHH!" Silas let out a sharp painful groan of agony.
Before Silas’s brain could even register that she had moved, a brutal strike from her wooden cutlass slammed flush into his exposed left ribs.
The impact knocked the breath straight out of his lungs, sending him stumbling three paces forward.
Silas spun around, gasping for air, only to find Morwenna standing behind him with her back casually turned to him, her wooden sword resting on her shoulder.
’What the fuck...?!’ Silas thought, his golden eyes wide with utter shock. ’How did she get behind me?!
I didn’t even see her pivot!’
Refusing to yield, Silas grit his teeth, reset his footing, and launched a second attack...
He executed a lighting-fast diagonal slash aimed at her back.
SWISH!
Morwenna’s gray eyes glowed with a bright sapphire-blue light.
ZIP!
Time slowed down for her once more as she saw the new flaw in his wrist alignment instantly.
BANG!
"AGHH!" Silas groaned again as her wooden blade struck his right shoulder joint with pinpoint brutal precision, completely canceling his swing before the wood could even touch her clothes.
"Heh," Morwenna chuckled softly with her voice cool and relaxed.
Silas gritted his teeth, his Gold Core roaring as he launched a third ultra-fast thrust.
ZIP...
BANG!
"URGH!" Silas groaned a third time as her blade struck his hip joint, throwing his balance entirely off.
Silas refused to give up as he gathered every ounce of his Gold Core speed, unleashing a furious four-hit combination slash.
ZIP...
KRA-THOOM!

Morwenna didn’t just counter the fourth attack... she executed an instantaneous explosive rip-current step that brought her wooden cutlass slamming straight into the center of Silas’s solar plexus with catastrophic physical force!
"GHA-HAKK!"
The brutal blow completely knocked every single drop of air out of Silas’s lungs.
His vision flashed white, his knees buckled, and his wooden training sword slipped from his fingers, clattering against the granite floor.
CLATTER!
THUD!
Silas collapsed flat onto his back on the cold stone floor, his chest heaving violently as he desperately wheezed for air with his entire body drained of physical energy.
"W-What... the... fuck... just happened...?" Silas wheezed out, his gravelly voice cracking as he stared up at the vaulted ceiling in total bewilderment.
Morwenna walked over, standing beside his fallen body, looking down at his sharp, wheezing face with a proud, breathtaking, and radiant smile that illuminated the torch-lit room.
"This," Morwenna announced softly.
"is the Tidal-Blade Second Style: Rip-Current Perception."
She leaned down slightly, her stormy gray eyes sparkling with love and pride as she delivered the final truth of the style.
"And as you can tell, Captain... this technique allows me to see the future."
Silas laid in the center of the vault, holding his half-broken wooden practice sword while staring at Morwenna with a deadpan unimpressed expression.
"Future sight?" Silas raised an eyebrow.
"I immediately call bullshit."
Morwenna froze for a fraction of a second, held her breath, and then threw her head back, bursting into a loud unrefined laugh that rattled the torch sconces.
"AHAHAHA!" Morwenna cackled, wiping a tear from her eye as she rested her wooden sword against her shoulder.
"You caught me, Captain!
I can’t actually see the future!"
Silas let out a dry exasperated breath, rolling his broad shoulders.
He was well aware of that.
How on earth could a fundamental manipulation of the water element allow someone to peer into the literal fabric of future time?
Time magic was a legendary near-mythical branch reserved for primordial cosmic entities, not a sword style developed on the high seas.
"I knew you were full of it," Silas muttered, crossing his arms over his broad chest.
"So what were you actually doing just now?
How did you dodge my thrust and hit my ribs four times in a row before my eyes could even track your boots?"
Morwenna’s laughter died down into a satisfied sharp smirk.
She took a step forward, tapping the tip of her wooden sword against the stone floor to emphasize her words.
"What you experienced wasn’t future sight, Captain," Morwenna explained.
"It was pure swordsmanship...
When I activate the Second Style, I release a dense microscopic field of water mana into the air surrounding us.
Water naturally seeks out the lowest point which is the path of least resistance."
She gestured toward Silas’s torso with her blade.
"The second you shift your weight to initiate an attack, your muscles tense, your breathing pauses, and your internal mana flow experiences a microscopic lag," Morwenna continued clearly.
"The water field around you senses that sudden drop in atmospheric pressure...
To my eyes, your body lights up with clear, flowing current lines pointing directly into your exposed weaknesses before your sword even moves an inch."
Silas listened intently, his golden-ringed eyes narrowing as his sharp mind processed the mechanics.
"So you aren’t seeing what I will do ten seconds from now," Silas analyzed smoothly.
"You’re reading the physical telegraphs my body makes before I even realize I’m making them."
"Precisely," Morwenna nodded with a proud glint shining in her stormy gray eyes.
"Your brain sends the nervous signal to your arm, but before your muscle can contract, the water current has already delivered the answer to my blade.
Combined with an explosive burst of rip-current footwork, I can slip into your flaw and strike before your guard can close."
Silas looked down at his calloused palms, shifting his grip on the wooden longsword.
"How do I learn it?" Silas asked directly, looking back up into her eyes.
"How do I train my core to sense those fluid pressure drops?"
Morwenna let out a quiet sigh, looking at him with a complex, almost sympathetic expression.

"The ability to create openings, or to use water to view and exploit an opponent’s flaws in real-time... isn’t as easy as everything you’ve faced up until this moment, Captain," Morwenna warned him honestly.
She wasn’t exaggerating in the slightest.
The First Style of the Tidal-Blade Arts was simple momentum manipulation... a basic wave slash that required decent footwork and mana flow.
The Sub-Style was merely high-frequency rotation... a technical trick to eliminate surface friction.
To a natural monster like Silas, who possessed Gold Core and an insane comprehension speed, those two were mere child’s play.

"If you manage to learn the Second Style in less than a single day," Morwenna grumbled, crossing her arms defensively over her chest, "I swear on the seven seas, I will officially quit being a swordmaster.
It took me decades of bloody combat on the ocean just to perfect this single style."
Silas chuckled dryly, but didn’t argue.
He could respect the sheer, painstaking effort it took to invent a style from scratch.
Morwenna looked away, her gray eyes staring blankly at the stone wall as old dusty memories from her past resurfaced in her mind.
Truth be told, Morwenna had never considered herself a true master of the blade.
Back during her early years before she awakened her power, she had met countless prodigies, martial geniuses, and legendary swordsmen who possessed far superior innate talent than her.
Naturals who could master sword styles in their sleep.
...But talent didn’t mean a damn thing if you ended up dead in a ditch.
And almost every single one of those talented prodigies she had known in her youth was long dead, buried beneath the ocean bed or turned to dust by the passage of centuries.
Except for one.
Morwenna’s jaw tightened with her fingers clenching into a tight fist as a sudden, intense spike of cold irritation flared in her chest.
’That fucking bastard...’ Morwenna cursed silently in her mind. ’The Sword God.’
Centuries ago, before the ocean claimed her, Morwenna and that insufferable man had been fellow disciples under the exact same legendary master.

While Morwenna had relied on gritty survival instincts and relentless repetition to build her Tidal-Blade Arts, he had been a natural terrifying monster who could cut down mountains with a flick of his wrist.
She wondered... if fate ever brought them face-to-face again in this modern era, and her ocean sword style went head-to-head against his absolute cutting path... who would walk away victorious?
’Meh, it’ll probably be me.’

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Morwenna’s Lesson [VI]
paragraphs: Morwenna shook her head, forcefully clearing the ancient memories from her mind, and refocused her gray eyes on Silas.

"You can’t learn this style through simple book reading or verbal instructions, Captain," Morwenna spoke up. "This is something you have to physically feel and experience yourself to get a proper handle on the technique. I can only show you the fundamental structure."
She held up three fingers on her left hand.
"The Second Style: Rip-Current Perception is broken down into three distinct phases," Morwenna explained clearly. "Phase One: Preparation. Phase Two: Detection. And Phase Three: Exploitation."
She pointed to her first finger.

"Preparation is the stage where you release the specialized, pressure-sensing water aura into the air around your target but getting the exact volume and density of water right doesn’t guarantee success... as you are about to learn the hard way."
Morwenna lowered her hand, taking a step back and dropping into her wide fluid dueling stance.
"Let’s begin with Phase One," Morwenna commanded. "Initialize the Preparation phase, Captain. Release the water aura."
Silas closed his eyes, taking a deep, steady breath.
Inside his chest, his Gold Core hummed softly.
He recalled the exact atmospheric humidity Morwenna had released earlier, manipulating his internal water mana to match the exact density, volume, and ambient temperature she had demonstrated.
FWOOSH...
A subtle nearly invisible mist of clear water mana erupted from Silas’s body, expanding outward in a five-meter radius around Morwenna’s stance.
Morwenna looked at the floating mist surrounding her boots, her eyes widening slightly in genuine surprise.
"Perfect," Morwenna admitted grumpily, inwardly cursing his absurd elemental talent. "The water volume is flawless. Now... keep your eyes open. Feel the current."
Morwenna didn’t wait for him to settle. She gripped her wooden practice cutlass with both hands and shot forward across the stone floor.
STOMP!

Silas focused every ounce of his mental perception on the floating water mist, staring intensely at Morwenna’s advancing frame, desperately waiting for those glowing blue current lines or physical weakness indicators to materialize in his vision.
...Nothing happened.
His vision remained completely normal. There were no glowing lines, no atmospheric pressure maps, and no magical indicators showing him where she was going to strike.
’Shit!’ Silas thought, his eyes widening.
Because he was so focused on trying to force the visual detection to trigger, his physical guard lagged by a fraction of a second.
Morwenna capitalized on his hesitation instantly, bringing her wooden sword around in a sharp horizontal strike aimed straight for his left temple.
CLANG!
Silas’s Gold Core combat instincts saved him. At the last second, he brought his wooden longsword up in a desperate, reactionary parry, deflecting her blade upward.
Without pausing, Silas drove his boot into the ground and thrust his sword straight into her exposed chest.
SWISH!
His wooden blade passed cleanly through her chest... but there was no physical resistance.
It was a lingering water afterimage.
ZIP!
Morwenna had already executed an instantaneous rip-current step, vanishing from his front and reappearing directly behind his exposed back.
Silas felt the sudden terrifying displacement of air behind his neck. As he spun his body around to face her, a sudden realization flashed through his mind.

’Wait a minute...’ Silas thought mid-turn. ’The way she moved just now... the afterimage, the sudden step to my blind spot... she’s deliberately demonstrating the exact rhythm I should have used if I had successfully triggered the technique on her initially!’
Morwenna was actively using herself as a living violent textbook... forcing his body to experience both sides of the style so his subconscious muscle memory could record the feedback.
However... understanding her intent didn’t make seeing the weak spots any easier!
As Silas completed his turn, his eyes scanned her incoming overhead strike, desperately trying to feel the fluid pressure drops in the air.
Still, nothing appeared.
’Fuck!’ Silas cursed violently in his internal thoughts.
While Silas was struggling in pitch-black blindness, the exact same could not be said for Morwenna.
As Silas turned, his awkward weight distribution caused his right shoulder alignment to lag by a fraction of a degree.
To Morwenna’s water-sensing vision, that tiny lag lit up like a blinding beacon of pure vulnerability.
Her toothy grin widened to a predatory line.
"Found it, Captain!" Morwenna declared.
BOOM!
Morwenna bypassed his raised wooden guard entirely... She launched an explosive rip-current thrust straight into his exposed right hip joint.
KRA-THOOM!
The physical force of her impact blew through his defensive stance like a cannonball.
Silas’s boots were completely lifted off the granite floor with his six-foot-two frame flying fifty feet straight across the vault.
BANG!
Silas hit the far granite wall hard, cracking the stone masonry before sliding down the wall and landing squarely on his rear on the cold floor with his wooden sword clattering beside his boots.
CRRRR!
Silas sat against the wall, rubbing his bruised hip with a heavy pained groan, letting out a long exhausted breath.
"Alright..." Silas wheezed out, raising his calloused right hand to stop her from stepping forward again. "That’s... that’s enough for today. I need time to comprehend the technique."
Morwenna came to a smooth halt in the center of the vault as she looked at him with a warm and thoroughly satisfied smile.

"Comprehend it some more, Captain," Morwenna encouraged smoothly, her raspy voice soft. "Take your time. Once you master this style... it’s going to be extraordinarily useful during the war next week."
Silas let out a quiet sigh, resting his head back against the cold granite wall.
Of course he knew that.
Being able to read an enemy’s physical flaws a second before they attacked would make him virtually invincible in close-quarters duels.
...But what could he do right now? Force the skill into his brain by sheer willpower?
This wasn’t a spell scroll that he could simply click to instantly gain 100% operational proficiency.
These were physical martial techniques that had to be felt, understood, and burned into his muscle memory through trial, error, and painful experience.
STEP! STEP!
Morwenna walked over, stopping in front of his seated form.
She extended her long muscular arm, offering him her calloused hand to pull him up off the floor.
Silas looked at her offered hand, let out a fond chuckle, and reached up, gripping her fingers firmly as she hauled his heavy six-foot-two frame back onto his feet.
Silas straightened his posture, dusting off his dark trousers.
The moment he was back on his feet, Morwenna didn’t step back.

Instead, she stood right in front of his chest, standing on her tiptoes, and gently tapped her own soft plump lips with her index finger, offering him a sweet, expectant, and thoroughly demanding look in her stormy gray eyes.
She was explicitly asking for her promised kiss reward.

Silas looked at her expectant face, remembered the brutal, tongue-ripping mauling her "kisses" had inflicted on his mouth ten minutes ago, and casually turned his head to the side, blatantly ignoring her lips.
Morwenna’s gray eyes narrowed into sharp dangerous slits.
WHOOSH!

Without a single second of warning, Morwenna’s hand shot downward like an iron vise, reaching between his legs and wrapping her long calloused fingers firmly around his private shaft through his trousers.
SQUEEZE!
"Hmph!" Silas let out a choked gasp of eye-widening shock with his entire body going completely rigid as his Gold Core almost detonated from pure panic.
Morwenna leaned her flushed face in close, her stormy eyes burning with a fierce mischievous glare as she tightened her grip by a millimeter.

"If you don’t kiss me properly right now, Captain..." Morwenna purred with a low dangerously playful threat in her raspy voice, "I will personally crush all of your future generations right here and now."
Silas stared at the terrifying gorgeous pirate goddess holding his family lineage hostage in her palm, his brain making an instantaneous high-stakes decision.
’I value my lineage,’ Silas decided immediately in his thoughts.
SWOOP.
Silas didn’t hesitate for another second.

He reached out his broad arms, wrapping them tightly around Morwenna’s waist, pulling her flush against his chest, and lowered his head to capture her lips in a deep, passionate, and compromising tongue kiss.
"Mmmph~!" Morwenna let out a soft surprised gasp into his mouth as his masculine warmth completely enveloped her senses.
This time, Silas didn’t let her initiate her chaotic tongue-ripping pirate wrestling.
He took commanding control of the kiss from the start... wrapping his tongue around hers with smooth sensual movements that made her head spin in a dizzying cloud of pure bliss.
"Mmm~ Mmh~ Mngh~"
Feeling him dominate her mouth so expertly, Morwenna’s terrifying grip on his groin completely slackened.
She eased her fingers, gently patting his shaft through his trousers in a soft, praise-filled gesture that practically screamed... ’Good boy.’
’What a dangerous woman.’
Completely melting into his kiss, the fierce Dread Queen cutely leaped up into the air, wrapping her long leather-clad legs tightly around Silas’s waist.

Silas caught her under her thighs, holding her curvaceous body securely against his chest as they continued to passionately make out in the middle of the quiet vault with their breathing mingling in the cool air.
CREAK... BANG!
Suddenly, the heavy oak doors of the subterranean training vault swung open with a slow echoing creak.
Silas felt the sudden draft of air and tried to pull his face back to see who had entered the room—
WHOOSH!
Morwenna refused to let him look away.
She cupped both of her hands tightly around his cheeks, pulling his lips straight back down to hers, continuing to kiss him with wild enthusiasm while clinging to his waist like a clingy koala.
"Ahem..."
A soft and melodic female voice echoed from the vault threshold.
The kiss instantly broke.
Morwenna slowly slid down Silas’s body, her boots touching the stone floor as both of them turned their heads toward the doorway.
Standing in the vault entrance, holding a large, beautifully polished wooden baking tray in her pale hands, was Eluned.
The divine deity was wearing a surprisingly adorable frilly white-and-green cooking apron over her flowing emerald dress.
She carried a pristine and breathtakingly sweet smile on her flawless face...
Yet, as Morwenna’s stormy gray eyes landed on the Nature Goddess, an immediate, unexplainable, and terrifying chill ran straight down the Dread Queen’s spine.
The hair on Morwenna’s arms stood up on end.

Her ancient ocean-honed survival instincts... the same instincts that warned her of sea krakens and apocalyptic storms were screaming at maximum volume that something was terrifyingly wrong with the woman standing in the doorway.
Silas, on the other hand, was completely oblivious to Morwenna’s internal horror. He blinked his golden eyes in genuine pleasant surprise, stepping forward.
"Eluned?" Silas greeted her warmly. "What are you doing down here in the training vault?"
Morwenna stepped down beside him, her posture stiff as she offered a cautious, grumping greeting.
"Hey... weed."
Surprisingly, Eluned didn’t hurl a single sarcastic insult back at Morwenna.
She didn’t call her a "trench-rat," nor did she glare at the Dread Queen for clinging to Silas’s waist seconds ago.
Instead, Eluned maintained her serene angelic smile, her bright green eyes sparkling with an unusually innocent shy light as her delicate hands trembled slightly while holding the heavy wooden tray.
"Good evening, My Lord... Morwenna," Eluned greeted them in a soft, melodic voice. "I... I am glad to see the two of you have rounded up your sword training for the night."
She stepped into the vault, extending the wooden tray toward them.
Resting on the polished wood were two large, freshly baked, golden-brown cupcakes dusted with shimmering spirit-sugar, alongside two tall, crystal glasses filled with thick creamy white milk.

"I... I have been learning a bit of culinary baking from Kaelia today..." Eluned admitted shyly, a delicate adorable pink flush touching her cheeks as she twirled her toes under her dress. "I was reading through one of the territory’s recipe books... and I made these special treats myself. If... if the two of you wouldn’t mind... could you please help me taste-test them?"
Silas looked at the blushing shy Nature Goddess holding the tray, his heart completely melting inside his chest.
’Oh...’ Silas thought, a warm genuine smile spreading across his face. ’She’s shy. She actually spent her evening learning how to bake cupcakes just to surprise me.’
"Of course we’ll help you taste them, Elu," Silas agreed warmly, stepping right up to the tray.
Beside him, Morwenna looked at the cupcakes with deep suspicion, her gray eyes narrowing.
But seeing how eager Eluned looked, and not wanting to appear rude or petty in front of Silas, the Pirate Queen let out a short grumble.
"Fine," Morwenna grunted, stepping up beside him. "I’ll help you taste your weed-bread, Goddess. But if it tastes like dirt, I’m throwing it at your head."
"Please, enjoy," Eluned smiled angelically, stepping back.
Silas reached out, picking up one of the large golden cupcakes. He took a generous bite out of the soft pastry.
The second the cupcake touched his tongue, Silas’s golden-ringed eyes widened to the size of saucers.
The pastry was insanely delicious.
The texture was unbelievably light and fluffy, bursting with a rich heavenly vanilla-and-honey spirit flavor that literally melted across his tastebuds like sweet cloud cream.
"Holy shit, Eluned!" Silas gasped out, his eyes shining with pure delight. "This is incredible! You’re a natural at baking!"
Without waiting another second, Silas devoured the rest of the cupcake in two bites, reaching down to grab one of the crystal glasses of cold white milk to wash it down!
GULP... GULP... GULP!
He drained the entire glass of thick white milk in one continuous refreshing gulp.

Silas wiped his mouth with the back of his hand, a blissful thoroughly satisfied look on his face as he wondered internally where Kaelia had sourced such unbelievably rich creamy milk from inside the Basin... but the flavor was so divine he didn’t care to ask.
Beside him, Morwenna had been watching Silas’s ecstatic reaction with deep skepticism.
’Is it really that good...?’ Morwenna thought, her mouth watering slightly despite her pride.

Silas looked at her offered hand, let out a fond chuckle, and reached up, gripping her fingers firmly as she hauled his heavy six-foot-two frame back onto his feet.
Silas straightened his posture, dusting off his dark trousers.
The moment he was back on his feet, Morwenna didn’t step back.

Instead, she stood right in front of his chest, standing on her tiptoes, and gently tapped her own soft plump lips with her index finger, offering him a sweet, expectant, and thoroughly demanding look in her stormy gray eyes.
She was explicitly asking for her promised kiss reward.

Silas looked at her expectant face, remembered the brutal, tongue-ripping mauling her "kisses" had inflicted on his mouth ten minutes ago, and casually turned his head to the side, blatantly ignoring her lips.
Morwenna’s gray eyes narrowed into sharp dangerous slits.
WHOOSH!

Without a single second of warning, Morwenna’s hand shot downward like an iron vise, reaching between his legs and wrapping her long calloused fingers firmly around his private shaft through his trousers.
SQUEEZE!
"Hmph!" Silas let out a choked gasp of eye-widening shock with his entire body going completely rigid as his Gold Core almost detonated from pure panic.
Morwenna leaned her flushed face in close, her stormy eyes burning with a fierce mischievous glare as she tightened her grip by a millimeter.

"If you don’t kiss me properly right now, Captain..." Morwenna purred with a low dangerously playful threat in her raspy voice, "I will personally crush all of your future generations right here and now."
Silas stared at the terrifying gorgeous pirate goddess holding his family lineage hostage in her palm, his brain making an instantaneous high-stakes decision.
’I value my lineage,’ Silas decided immediately in his thoughts.
SWOOP.
Silas didn’t hesitate for another second.

He reached out his broad arms, wrapping them tightly around Morwenna’s waist, pulling her flush against his chest, and lowered his head to capture her lips in a deep, passionate, and compromising tongue kiss.
"Mmmph~!" Morwenna let out a soft surprised gasp into his mouth as his masculine warmth completely enveloped her senses.
This time, Silas didn’t let her initiate her chaotic tongue-ripping pirate wrestling.
He took commanding control of the kiss from the start... wrapping his tongue around hers with smooth sensual movements that made her head spin in a dizzying cloud of pure bliss.
"Mmm~ Mmh~ Mngh~"
Feeling him dominate her mouth so expertly, Morwenna’s terrifying grip on his groin completely slackened.
She eased her fingers, gently patting his shaft through his trousers in a soft, praise-filled gesture that practically screamed... ’Good boy.’
’What a dangerous woman.’
Completely melting into his kiss, the fierce Dread Queen cutely leaped up into the air, wrapping her long leather-clad legs tightly around Silas’s waist.

Silas caught her under her thighs, holding her curvaceous body securely against his chest as they continued to passionately make out in the middle of the quiet vault with their breathing mingling in the cool air.
CREAK...
BANG!
Suddenly, the heavy oak doors of the subterranean training vault swung open with a slow echoing creak.
Silas felt the sudden draft of air and tried to pull his face back to see who had entered the room—
WHOOSH!
Morwenna refused to let him look away.
She cupped both of her hands tightly around his cheeks, pulling his lips straight back down to hers, continuing to kiss him with wild enthusiasm while clinging to his waist like a clingy koala.
"Ahem..."
A soft and melodic female voice echoed from the vault threshold.
The kiss instantly broke.
Morwenna slowly slid down Silas’s body, her boots touching the stone floor as both of them turned their heads toward the doorway.
Standing in the vault entrance, holding a large, beautifully polished wooden baking tray in her pale hands, was Eluned.
The divine deity was wearing a surprisingly adorable frilly white-and-green cooking apron over her flowing emerald dress.
She carried a pristine and breathtakingly sweet smile on her flawless face...
Yet, as Morwenna’s stormy gray eyes landed on the Nature Goddess, an immediate, unexplainable, and terrifying chill ran straight down the Dread Queen’s spine.
The hair on Morwenna’s arms stood up on end.

Her ancient ocean-honed survival instincts... the same instincts that warned her of sea krakens and apocalyptic storms were screaming at maximum volume that something was terrifyingly wrong with the woman standing in the doorway.
Silas, on the other hand, was completely oblivious to Morwenna’s internal horror.
He blinked his golden eyes in genuine pleasant surprise, stepping forward.
"Eluned?" Silas greeted her warmly.
"What are you doing down here in the training vault?"
Morwenna stepped down beside him, her posture stiff as she offered a cautious, grumping greeting.
"Hey... weed."
Surprisingly, Eluned didn’t hurl a single sarcastic insult back at Morwenna.
She didn’t call her a "trench-rat," nor did she glare at the Dread Queen for clinging to Silas’s waist seconds ago.
Instead, Eluned maintained her serene angelic smile, her bright green eyes sparkling with an unusually innocent shy light as her delicate hands trembled slightly while holding the heavy wooden tray.
"Good evening, My Lord...
Morwenna," Eluned greeted them in a soft, melodic voice.
I am glad to see the two of you have rounded up your sword training for the night."
She stepped into the vault, extending the wooden tray toward them.
Resting on the polished wood were two large, freshly baked, golden-brown cupcakes dusted with shimmering spirit-sugar, alongside two tall, crystal glasses filled with thick creamy white milk.
I have been learning a bit of culinary baking from Kaelia today..." Eluned admitted shyly, a delicate adorable pink flush touching her cheeks as she twirled her toes under her dress.
"I was reading through one of the territory’s recipe books... and I made these special treats myself.
If... if the two of you wouldn’t mind... could you please help me taste-test them?"
Silas looked at the blushing shy Nature Goddess holding the tray, his heart completely melting inside his chest.
’Oh...’ Silas thought, a warm genuine smile spreading across his face. ’She’s shy.
She actually spent her evening learning how to bake cupcakes just to surprise me.’
"Of course we’ll help you taste them, Elu," Silas agreed warmly, stepping right up to the tray.
Beside him, Morwenna looked at the cupcakes with deep suspicion, her gray eyes narrowing.
But seeing how eager Eluned looked, and not wanting to appear rude or petty in front of Silas, the Pirate Queen let out a short grumble.
"Fine," Morwenna grunted, stepping up beside him.
"I’ll help you taste your weed-bread, Goddess.
But if it tastes like dirt, I’m throwing it at your head."
"Please, enjoy," Eluned smiled angelically, stepping back.
Silas reached out, picking up one of the large golden cupcakes.
He took a generous bite out of the soft pastry.
The second the cupcake touched his tongue, Silas’s golden-ringed eyes widened to the size of saucers.
The pastry was insanely delicious.
The texture was unbelievably light and fluffy, bursting with a rich heavenly vanilla-and-honey spirit flavor that literally melted across his tastebuds like sweet cloud cream.
"Holy shit, Eluned!" Silas gasped out, his eyes shining with pure delight.
"This is incredible!
You’re a natural at baking!"
Without waiting another second, Silas devoured the rest of the cupcake in two bites, reaching down to grab one of the crystal glasses of cold white milk to wash it down!
GULP...
GULP...
GULP!
He drained the entire glass of thick white milk in one continuous refreshing gulp.

Silas wiped his mouth with the back of his hand, a blissful thoroughly satisfied look on his face as he wondered internally where Kaelia had sourced such unbelievably rich creamy milk from inside the Basin... but the flavor was so divine he didn’t care to ask.
Beside him, Morwenna had been watching Silas’s ecstatic reaction with deep skepticism.
’Is it really that good...?’ Morwenna thought, her mouth watering slightly despite her pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Preparing For The Perfect Night
paragraphs: Hesitantly, the Pirate Queen reached out, picking up the second cupcake and taking a small tentative bite.
She chewed...
"Mmm~"
Morwenna froze dead in her tracks.
Her stormy gray eyes stretched wide in utter mind-shattering shock as the heavenly flavor profile exploded across her palate like a divine firework.
’BY THE ANCIENT SEAS!’ Morwenna screamed in her own mind with her pride instantly crumbling into dust. ’THIS IS THE GREATEST THING I HAVE EVER TASTED IN MY ENTIRE LIFE!’
Forget being suspicious of the Nature Goddess... Morwenna completely abandoned her pirate dignity.
She shoved the rest of the cupcake into her mouth, chewing greedily, before grabbing the second crystal glass of white milk and chugging it down at light speed!
GULP... GULP... SPLASH!
Morwenna slammed the empty crystal glass back onto the wooden tray, wiping her lips with a loud satisfied huff.
She would never admit it out loud to Eluned’s face... but that baking was perfection.
"Hmph... it was... acceptable, I suppose," Morwenna lied grumpily, crossing her arms.
However... the second those words left Morwenna’s mouth—
THUMP!
A sudden violent and unnatural heavy thud echoed directly inside Morwenna’s brain.
Morwenna froze.
In a fraction of a second, her entire world completely paused.
The cool air in the vault went dead silent as the flickering torch flames along the walls froze in mid-burn.
Suddenly, the subterranean vault, the stone pillars, and the ceiling began to violently spin and distort in wild dizzying circles before Morwenna’s eyes.
’What... what is this...?!’ Morwenna thought, her mind going into an immediate panic.
Her vision blurred into dark swirling halos of green and purple light.
Her knees buckled with her heavy muscular legs feeling as light and useless as wet paper!
This food... the milk... IT HAD BEEN DRUGGED!
Morwenna was an SSS-Ranked being.

Over her centuries of life on the high seas, she had ingested lethal ocean poisons, assassin toxins, and heavy dwarven moonshines that could melt iron... and her body had easily neutralized every single one of them.
If this had been a normal high-tier sleeping drug... Morwenna’s core would have burned it out of her bloodstream in a second.
...But this was NOT a normal drug.

The substance infused into those treats was a god-tier divine paralytic... specially refined by an ancient Nature Goddess using primordial spirit-herbs, synthesized at a dosage several hundred times higher than any living entity in the Sovereign Realm could ever hope to process.
Morwenna frantically tried to ignite her internal SSS-Rank water core to forcefully burn the toxin out of her veins.
’Burn... BURN!’ Morwenna screamed internally, trying to channel her mana.
Nothing happened.
Her divine mana channels were completely locked down... paralyzed by the overwhelming, suffocating weight of the divine natural sedative.
Morwenna staggered backward with her boots slipping on the granite floor as she desperately tried to maintain her balance.
SWIRL...
She forced her blurry, spinning eyes to look forward toward the vault entrance... toward Eluned.
Through her wild triple-layer blurry vision, Morwenna didn’t see one Eluned.
She saw three overlapping spectral visions of the Nature Goddess standing in the doorway.
And all three of those spectral visions carried the exact same... terrifying... unnatural... wide smile.
Eluned’s mouth was stretched open in a wide, Cheshire-cat grin that reached almost from ear to ear.
Her bright green eyes were no longer innocent or shy... they were glowing with an intense and psychotic divine light that illuminated the dark vault.
It was a smile of madness!
Morwenna’s soul shivered in pure horror as a cold suffocating terror gripped her chest.
’T-This...’ Morwenna thought, her mind screaming in dazed panic, ’THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE A GODDESS OF NATURE?! THIS IS A MONSTER!’
Morwenna frantically turned her blurry head to look for her Captain... to warn Silas, to get him to draw his sword!
"C-Captain..." Morwenna slurred out weakly.
She looked down at the stone floor beside her.
Silas was already lying flat on his back on the cold granite.
His eyes were completely rolled back into his head with his muscular limbs limply sprawled out, and a thick frothy trail of white milk was slowly trickling out from the corner of his mouth.
He was thoroughly knocked out cold... drugged into slumber by Eluned.
’CAPTAIN!’ Morwenna screamed in her mind.
Morwenna’s legs completely gave out beneath her.
THUD!
The Dread Queen collapsed heavily onto her back on the stone floor with her Corsair falling out of her reach.
Yet, through stubborn pirate willpower, Morwenna desperately began crawling backward across the cold granite, using her elbows to drag her paralyzed body toward her fallen sword.
Eluned stood in the doorway, holding the empty wooden tray.
She looked down at the crawling paralyzed Pirate Queen with her unnaturally wide smile twitching slightly as she let out a soft and deeply disappointed sigh.

"Strange..." Eluned murmured smoothly, her voice echoing with a chilling double-toned divine resonance through the vault. "I was sure I spiked those treats with a dosage much higher than even an immortal like you could handle... yet you’re still conscious."
STEP! STEP!
Eluned casually tossed the wooden tray to the side.
CLATTER!
She took two slow deliberate steps forward with her delicate bare feet making soft, echoing sounds against the cold floor.
Morwenna desperately reached her trembling hand out with her fingers inches away from the hilt of her sword—
Through her fading dizzy haze, a single final word echoed repeatedly in Morwenna’s ears, sounding like a death knell.
"Checkmate..."
BOOM!
Eluned raised her delicate apron-clad foot... and slammed her heel down directly onto Morwenna’s face.
BANG!
Morwenna’s head slammed hard against the granite floor.
The last thing the Dread Queen saw before her consciousness was dragged into pitch-black oblivion... was the glowing green eyes of the Nature Goddess looking down at her...
Then there was nothing...
Eluned stood in the center of the training vault with her bare feet resting lightly on the cold granite floor.
She looked down at the two bodies lying limply at her feet... Morwenna, the Pirate and Silas, her beloved Gold Core Lord.
Both of them were completely knocked out cold.
Eluned looked down at Morwenna’s face.
The Pirate Queen was lying flat on her back with her sharp features relaxed in a deep drug-induced slumber.
A small dark smudge from Eluned’s heel rested right on her cheek.
THUD!
Eluned raised her delicate right foot and brought her heel slamming down directly onto Morwenna’s nose.
THUD! THUD! THUD! THUD! THUD!
She stomped five more times in rapid succession with her frilly white-and-green apron fluttering with every aggressive downward kick.
"Huuu..." Eluned let out a long deeply satisfied breath, resting her hands on her hips as her cheeks flushed with an exhilarated pink.
Truth be told... it felt extraordinarily thrilling to stomp directly on this arrogant Pirate’s face.
So much so that the ancient Nature Goddess genuinely wanted to keep kicking her for another ten minutes just for the joy of it.
However, after solid stomps that would have pulverized a steel fortress, Eluned drew her leg back and inspected the results.
There wasn’t a single scratch on Morwenna’s face.
Not a bruise, not a cut, and not even a single drop of blood. The SSS-Rank Pirate’s skin possessed such an absurd physical density that Eluned’s stomps merely wiped away the dirt on her cheek.
It was almost as if the unconscious woman was actively teasing her from inside her slumber.
Eluned pouted slightly, pulling her leg back.
’Tch... washed-up trench-rat,’ Eluned thought, shaking her head. ’I think those stomps are enough for now.’
As a former Spirit of the World Tree, there were ancient sacred divine laws woven into her very soul... lines of conduct that a higher spirit was never supposed to cross.
Using sneaky underhanded sedatives to poison her allies and abuse her companions was technically a massive violation of her original nature realm code.
...But as of tonight, Eluned wasn’t just a Spirit of the World Tree. Tonight, she was going to become her Lord’s official devoted wife.
And so, regarding those ancient outdated divine rules...
FLICK!
Eluned raised her right hand into the air, holding up her middle finger directly toward the vaulted ceiling of the room with an unbothered smirk.
"Fuck you, motherfucker," Eluned whispered softly to the ancient sky laws.

The second those profane words left her lips, Eluned felt a strange, subtle vibration in the air... almost as if the lingering unconscious soul of her Lord was staring at her in bewildered shock from inside his dazed slumber.
Eluned tilted her head, looking down at Silas’s knocked-out frame, her green eyes narrowing defensively as she pouted her soft lips.
"What?" Eluned argued back to his unconscious soul, crossing her arms over her chest. "Morwenna uses bad words all the time so I can’t? That’s completely unfair, My Lord."
She looked down at his handsome sleeping face, her heart swelling with an overwhelming obsessive warmth.
The drug she had used on them wasn’t some cheap commercial sleeping potion gotten from just anywhere.
Back during her ancient days residing at the roots of Yggdrasil, Eluned had spent thousands of years studying the sacred forbidden botany of the Sovereign Realm.
She knew the secret recipes for several ancient god-slaying flora... herbs so terrifyingly potent that a single crushed leaf could force even an immortal cosmic deity into a catatonic slumber.
When she had first summoned her divine garden inside the Blessed Land, she had quietly cultivated a small hidden patch of those exact same slumber-roots near the greenhouse.
And after Thora had previously knocked her out cold using the Blessed Drink... Eluned had resolved never to let herself be out-maneuvered again.
She had harvested the rare slumber-herbs, carefully refined their liquid essence, and infused it directly into the evening treats she had baked today.
Silas had promised her earlier at the Keep gates that tonight... he would do anything she wanted.
He was going to make her a proper woman.

And in Eluned’s sharp mind, her Lord couldn’t possibly fulfill his promise properly if all these other aggressive lingering women in the territory kept interrupting them, barging into his bedroom, or trying to drag him down to the training vaults for late-night sword practice.
Therefore, Eluned had devised a simple flawless master plan...
She was going to drug the entire territory.
Every single woman and every mount living under Silas’s territory would be put to sleep for the night... leaving her completely alone with her Lord until sunrise.
"It’s time to clean up," Eluned whispered cutely.
SNAP!
Eluned snapped her slender fingers!
RUMBLE... FWOOSH!
The stone floor of the vault violently cracked open.
Two massive thick emerald-green tree roots... each as wide as a man’s torso and soft as velvet erupted out of the earth beneath the granite floorboards.
The divine roots writhed through the air like intelligent obedient serpents, hovering before their Goddess waiting for commands.
A deep rosy blush covered Eluned’s pale face as she pointed her finger toward the floor.
"You," Eluned instructed the left root softly, "pick up this washed-up pirate woman and carry her to a random guest room in the lower wing. Seal the door behind her."
She then turned her green eyes toward the right root, her tone softening into a sweet, reverent purr. "And you... gently pick up my Lord, and carry him up to our master suite."
The two divine roots bowed their tips in immediate obedience.
SWOOSH.
The left root wrapped itself around Morwenna’s waist, lifting the unconscious Pirate off the floor like a sack of grain.
The right root slid gently beneath Silas’s broad back and legs, cradling his six-foot-two muscular frame with extreme cushioned care.
As the root lifted Silas into the air, Eluned stepped forward, raising her hands to pause the vine.
She stood on her tiptoes, leaning her face up to plant a soft sweet and lingering kiss right on Silas’s closed lips.
SMOOCH!
Eluned pulled back slightly with her cheeks burning a bright lovely shade of pink as she gently patted his warm cheek with her hand.

"Don’t worry, My Lord," Eluned whispered lovingly into his ear, her voice dripping with devoted affection. "I will eliminate all of the annoying disturbances first beforehand... then we can have our special night."
The root holding Silas bobbed its tip, slowly carrying him out of the vault and floating him up the grand stone staircase toward the second-floor master suite.

"And you... gently pick up my Lord, and carry him up to our master suite."
The two divine roots bowed their tips in immediate obedience.
SWOOSH.
The left root wrapped itself around Morwenna’s waist, lifting the unconscious Pirate off the floor like a sack of grain.
The right root slid gently beneath Silas’s broad back and legs, cradling his six-foot-two muscular frame with extreme cushioned care.
As the root lifted Silas into the air, Eluned stepped forward, raising her hands to pause the vine.
She stood on her tiptoes, leaning her face up to plant a soft sweet and lingering kiss right on Silas’s closed lips.
SMOOCH!
Eluned pulled back slightly with her cheeks burning a bright lovely shade of pink as she gently patted his warm cheek with her hand.
"Don’t worry, My Lord," Eluned whispered lovingly into his ear, her voice dripping with devoted affection.
"I will eliminate all of the annoying disturbances first beforehand... then we can have our special night."
The root holding Silas bobbed its tip, slowly carrying him out of the vault and floating him up the grand stone staircase toward the second-floor master suite.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Preparing For The Perfect Night [II]
paragraphs: Meanwhile, the left root carrying Morwenna slithered down the lower guest corridor.
It reached an empty random guest bedroom at the end of the hall, used its wooden tip to push the heavy oak door open, and unceremoniously tossed the unconscious Dread Queen flat onto the mattress.
PLOP!

Without waiting for Morwenna to settle, the thick root expanded outward, weaving a dense impenetrable lattice of wooden vines that completely sealed the bedroom door from the outside, locking the Dread Queen inside until morning.
Eluned walked past the sealed guest room, looking at the root’s work.
She offered the wooden vine a sweet charming smile, blowing it a playful kiss through the air.
"Good boy."
Hearing its Goddess praise it, the divine tree root literally throbbed and vibrated with ecstatic energy, pulsing happily before settling into the woodwork.

Upstairs in the master suite, the right root gently set Silas down on the large, comfortable king-sized bed, arranging his broad limbs neatly against the silk pillows before quietly retracting back into the floorboards.
Eluned, meanwhile, didn’t head straight to the bedroom just yet. She had business to finish.
She walked down the quiet, torch-lit corridor, returning to the Keep’s primary kitchen hold.
She picked up two fresh clean crystal glasses from the counter and filled them with a thick creamy white liquid.
To anyone else, it looked identical to fresh high-grade farm milk.
But in truth, it wasn’t dairy milk at all. Eluned had cultivated a rare, magical plant called the Lactis-Vine... a plant that produced a sweet protein-rich white sap.
The plant tried its best to emulate the exact taste and texture of real milk... and while it wasn’t 100% identical, it was so remarkably close that anyone drinking it would never suspect a thing.
And of course... Eluned had infused both glasses with a massive double-dose of her god-slaying slumber-herb.
Holding the wooden tray with two fresh glasses of spiked "milk" Eluned glided silently up the stairs toward the administrative wing.
She stopped in front of Silas’s private office door.
The heavy door was slightly ajar.
Eluned peeked through the gap... and froze.
Inside the dimly lit office, sitting behind Silas’s large mahogany desk, was Aeliana... the silver-haired elven arcanist.
Aeli was currently completely entangled with Silas’s heavy leather desk chair.

The voluptuous elf had her arms wrapped tightly around the wooden backrest with her pale face completely buried into the leather cushion where Silas usually sat, sniffing deeply with a dazed degenerate expression on her face!
"Mmm~ Lord Silas’s scent..." Aeli was whispering to herself in a dazed, dreamy trance with her long elven ears twitching wildly.
CREAK.
Eluned pushed the office door wide open, stepping into the room.
"E-EEK!"
Aeli violently flinched with her entire body going rock-rigid.
She practically leaped three feet off the chair with her face exploding into a burning crimson flush as she frantically tried to smooth down her white robes.

"L-Lady Eluned!" Aeli stammered out frantically, her silver eyes darting around the room in panicked desperation. "I... I was not doing anything inappropriate! I... I was merely inspecting the structural integrity of Lord Silas’s leather upholstery! Yes! Checking for wear and tear!"
Eluned stood in the doorway holding her wooden tray.
She didn’t scold her and she didn’t glare at her.
Instead, Eluned offered the flustered elven arcanist a bright angelic and breathtakingly sweet smile that radiated pure innocence.
"It is completely fine, Aeli," Eluned spoke softly, her melodic voice soothing.
She stepped forward, presenting the tray. "Lord Silas asked me to bring this glass of fresh, warm milk to you. He said you’ve been working very hard today and wanted you to rest."
Aeli’s eyes instantly lit up with overwhelming tearful joy.
"My Lord... sent this specifically for me?!" Aeli squeaked out happily, her heart practically soaring to the heavens.
Without a single shred of suspicion, doubt, or hesitation, Aeli reached out, grabbed the crystal glass, and chugged the entire spiked white liquid down her throat in one continuous eager gulp.
GULP... GULP... GULP!
"Ah... thank you so much, My Lord..." Aeli sighed happily, setting the empty glass down.
THUD!
The second the glass hit the wooden desk... Aeli’s eyes rolled completely back into her head!
Her voluptuous curvaceous body instantly went limp, and the elven arcanist collapsed flat onto her face across Silas’s desk, completely knocked out cold.
Eluned stood over the fallen elf, looking down at her sleeping body.
Eluned remembered Aeli from a few hundred years ago... back when Aeli was just a tiny shy elven baby whose father, the Elf King, used to bring her to play among the lower roots of Yggdrasil.

Over the centuries, that tiny elven girl had grown into an extraordinarily beautiful, voluptuous woman featuring a hourglass waist, a dangerously plump rear, and a massive chest that filled out her white robes to the brim.
Eluned’s green eyes narrowed slightly into a thin critical line as she looked at Aeli’s impressive curves.

’If Aeliana were just a little bit more aggressive with her feelings...’ Eluned evaluated internally. ’with a seductive, voluptuous body like that, she probably would have already succeeded in bedding our Lord weeks ago.’
Eluned didn’t stomp on Aeli’s face like she had done with Morwenna. After all, Aeli was a fellow elf and had always been polite.
Instead, Eluned looked down at her own petite chest beneath her apron, letting out a long quiet sigh.
’Why are my breasts not big...?’ Eluned pondered deeply in her own mind.
She had the divine power to alter her physical vessel if she truly wished to.
But in her heart, Eluned knew that her current petite graceful stature was the pinnacle of aesthetic proportion for her divine spirit identity.
Making her chest any larger would completely disrupt her natural balance and make her look clumsy and imperfect.
...Still, seeing how well-endowed Aeli and Morwenna were made her feel a subtle, rare wave of envy.
Then, a sudden memory flashed through Eluned’s mind.
She remembered a specific human philosophy book she had casually flipped through inside Silas’s newly constructed Library two days ago.
A slow wicked smile returned to the Nature Goddess’s face as she recalled the exact quote written on page forty-two.
"...Girls with smaller chests are always significantly tighter."
’Ah!’ Eluned cheered internally, her green eyes sparkling with pure joy.
That single sentence from the Library book was divine gospel to her.

If her petite body allowed her to grip her Lord’s male member significantly tighter than any other woman in the entire territory whenever he was inside her... then Silas would naturally become utterly addicted to her body and keep coming back to her bed every single night.
"Smaller is better," Eluned concluded proudly, nodding her head with confidence.
SNAP!

Eluned snapped her fingers, summoning a small tree root that slithered into the office, wrapped gently around Aeli’s waist, carried the sleeping elf back to her private bedroom, and sealed her door shut with thick wooden vines.
Two down.
...One major target left.
Eluned walked down the guest wing corridor, stopping outside the heavy timber door belonging to Talira... the Primordial Crimson Dragon.
Eluned didn’t bother knocking.
She gently pushed the door open, stepping inside.
Sitting cross-legged in the center of a massive woven mat was Talira.
The red-haired dragoness was currently meditating with her human body surrounded by a shimmering haze of volcanic red heat mana.
Hearing the door open, Talira slowly opened her glowing crimson eyes.
Seeing the Nature Goddess standing in her doorway, Talira immediately extinguished her fire aura, bowing her head politely.
"Good evening, Lady Eluned," Talira greeted her respectfully, acknowledging the deity’s superior divine standing.

"Good evening, Talira," Eluned smiled sweetly, stepping forward with the wooden tray. "You fought a very long exhausting battle against our Lord today from what I heard. I brought you a special nutrient-rich spirit drink to help restore your depleted core reserves."
Talira looked at the glass of thick white liquid.
Normally, an adult dragon’s hyper-adaptive biology was extremely cautious regarding unknown liquids.
But because the drink was presented directly by Lady Eluned... a divine Goddess bound to the same Lord, Talira felt zero reason to doubt her hospitality.
"Thank you, Lady Eluned," Talira said politely.
She took the glass and drained the entire contents in one long gulp!
GULP... GULP!
Talira set the empty glass down, wiping her mouth.
"That was remarkably rich..."
THUMP!
Suddenly, Talira’s vertical dragon pupils dilated in utter shock.
Her ancient hyper-adaptive dragon biology instantly recognized the presence of the slumber toxin entering her bloodstream.
Her dragon core violently ignited, attempting to adapt, mutate, and neutralize the poison at light speed.
’A... poison...?!’ Talira thought in dazed horror.
However... while her dragon biology was formidable, it was currently at its weakest point after getting thoroughly exhausted during her brutal duel with Vespera earlier.
The divine Yggdrasil toxin overwhelmed her adapting dragon cells in less than three seconds.
PLOP!
Talira’s eyes went wide, her body lost all physical strength, and the dragoness face-planted flat onto her plush bed pillows, falling into an instant deep slumber.
Eluned stepped forward, gently pulling the soft blankets over Talira’s shoulders and tucking the sleeping dragoness in cutely.
"Sleep well, little dragon," Eluned whispered.
She picked up the empty glass, stepped out of the room, and closed the heavy oak door.
RUMBLE!
A dense weave of World Tree roots erupted out of the hallway floorboards, completely sealing Talira’s bedroom door from the outside, locking her safely within.
With every major Hero and soldier officially neutralized, Eluned walked back downstairs to the kitchen, setting the empty wooden tray and glasses into the sink.
She then walked over to the Keep’s grand front doors, pushing the heavy timber double doors open, and stepped out onto the moonlit porch.
Eluned stood on the stone steps, closing her divine eyes, taking a deep breath of the night air, and expanding her nature perception across the entire territory of the Blessed Land.
Silence...
It was peaceful, and unbroken silence.

Out on the eastern lawn, Valkyrie, Luna, and the three direwolf pups were sprawled out across the soft grass, snoring softly under the influence of the slumber-spores Eluned had released into the wind hours ago.
Along the high stone battlements and the central Watchtower, Fenna, Brida, and the Vanguard archers were resting comfortably against the ramparts, fast asleep.
In the barracks, the rest of the girls were tucked into their beds, sleeping peacefully.
The entire Blessed Land had been completely put to sleep.
A breathtaking radiant smile spread across Eluned’s divine face.
"Perfect," Eluned whispered happily.
She stepped back inside the Keep, pulling the heavy timber double doors shut, and locked them using three thick iron-hard roots that wove across the handles.
FWOOSH...
As she walked up the grand stone staircase toward the second floor, a soft shimmer of emerald-and-gold nature mana wrapped around her petite body.
Her frilly white-and-green cooking apron and simple dress completely dissolved.
In its place, a breathtaking sheer emerald-and-silver silk nightdress materialized around her curves.
The fabric was extraordinarily soft, semi-translucent, and tailored to cling perfectly to her delicate waist, highlighting every single soft curve of her petite flawless figure.
Eluned reached the master suite door at the end of the second-floor corridor.
She turned the brass handle, pushing the door open, and stepped into Silas’s private bedroom, closing the door softly behind her.
CLICK!
A weave of wooden vines sealed the bedroom door from the inside, ensuring uninterrupted privacy.
Eluned looked over at the large king-sized bed in the center of the room.

Silas was lying flat on his back across the soft white sheets with his broad six-foot-two muscular frame spread out, his dark hair messy against the pillows, fast asleep under the lingering effects of the slumber-herb.
Eluned’s green eyes sparkled with pure adoration.
She walked over on silent feet, climbing onto the edge of the mattress, kneeling beside his resting upper body.
Elune reached out her delicate pale hand, gently caressing his sharp jawline, stroking his cheek with infinite tenderness.
"You look so remarkably cute when you’re sleeping, My Lord..." Eluned whispered softly, her melodic voice filled with deep affection.
Then, her eyes flickered with a sudden, serious divine realization.
"...But you still need my markings."
Eluned had spent hours reading through human romance literature in the Library.
In the modern human world, lovers gave each other hickeys and marks to signal ownership to the rest of the world.
And back in the land of elves... engaging in physical union with a partner meant entering an eternal life-bond.
Eluned leaned her body over his broad chest, her silver-green hair cascading over his shoulders like living vines.
She parted her soft lips, leaning down low, and bit down firmly into the warm skin on the right side of Silas’s neck.
"Mmm..." Silas let out an unconscious grumble in his sleep, but the sedative kept him from waking up.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Eluned’s Wish
paragraphs: Eluned’s sharp teeth pierced his skin, drawing a tiny bead of rich golden-tinted Gold Core blood.
The moment she tasted his blood, Eluned’s green eyes darkened with dizzying pleasure.
She extended her soft, pink tongue, eagerly licking up the droplets of blood, nibbling gently around the wound, and applying a microscopic drop of her divine nature saliva into the mark.
"Mm~ Mm~"

Her divine saliva reacted with his Gold Core blood, ensuring that no matter how much he tried to heal his body... this permanent dark-red love bite mark would remain clearly etched on his neck forever.
It was her eternal mark.
Her sacred seal of ownership.
"There..." Eluned purred happily, licking his neck clean until his skin glistened. "Now everyone will know you belong to me."
Eluned shifted her body, swinging her slender legs over his hips and sat directly atop Silas’s lap with her petite rear resting firmly against his crotch.
She raised her right hand, placing her delicate index finger directly against the center of Silas’s forehead.
FLASH!
A gentle soothing beam of emerald-green spirit light erupted from her finger, penetrating straight into his brain.
The divine green light instantly targeted the lingering slumber-herb molecules in his bloodstream, completely purging and neutralizing the toxin in a fraction of a millisecond.
FLUTTER...
Silas’s dark eyelashes twitched.
His Gold Core rebooted instantly as the heavy fog in his mind cleared away like smoke in the wind, and Silas’s golden-ringed eyes slowly fluttered open.
"Ugh..." Silas let out a low groggy groan with his vision slowly adjusting to the dim torchlight of his bedroom.
The first thing Silas saw as his consciousness returned... was the breathtaking, radiant face of Eluned looking down at him from inches away.
The Nature Goddess was wearing a sheer semi-translucent emerald nightdress that left very little to the imagination.
She was straddling his waist, sitting directly atop his lap with her soft thighs hugging his hips.
As Silas’s golden eyes met hers, Eluned’s face flushed a deep and extraordinarily lovely shade of pink.

She gently swayed her hips, rocking her petite rear rhythmically against his crotch with her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird as she looked down at her Lord with eyes filled with unshakeable love.
"Wake up, My Lord..." Eluned whispered softly, her melodic voice trembling with sweet breathless excitement.
She leaned her face down low, resting her forehead against his with her warm breath mingling with his as she delivered her heart-felt desire.
"I am ready to tell you what I want..."
Eluned looked into his golden-ringed eyes.
"I want to become a woman tonight, My Lord... I want to become your woman. I want to be your first... your first everything... your first official wife."
’Cute...’
Silas would have really considered it but...
THUMP!
His head was throbbing with a dull persistent ache, and for very good reason.

The last thing Silas remembered before his consciousness had completely shut down was sitting in the subterranean training vault with Morwenna, eating those soft golden cupcakes and chugging down that thick, creamy white liquid Eluned had presented on her wooden baking tray.
And then... total blackout.
Silas blinked, his vision adjusting to the dim moonlight streaming through the grand stained-glass windows of his room.
He looked out toward the horizon, noticing the deep pitch-black sky hanging over the Keep.
"Ugh..." Silas muttered, his gravelly voice raspy. "How late is it...?"
He tried to shift his legs under the heavy blankets but Eluned didn’t let him, she sure was sexy
...But as a Lord, Silas needed to clarify a few extremely important logistical facts first.
Silas raised an eyebrow, looking straight into Eluned’s bright green eyes.
"Elu..." Silas asked directly, his voice dropping into a flat deadpan register. "Did you add something to that food? Or that milk I drank down in the vault?"
The moment those words left his mouth, Eluned’s entire body went rigid.
Her pale cheeks instantly flushed a bright burning shade of pink.
She cutely averted her face, looking away toward the wooden wardrobe in the corner while twirling her thumbs together in her lap.
"I... I don’t know what you’re talking about, My Lord..." Eluned mumbled innocently, her soft voice trembling with a hilariously unconvincing guilty pitch.
Silas stared at her guilty, blushing face in total speechless silence.
Before Silas could grill his divine nature deity any further, a sharp dull sting flickered along the right side of his neck.
Silas raised his calloused right hand, pressing his fingers against the sensitive skin right above his collarbone.
His fingertips brushed against a distinct indented mark carved into his flesh.
It felt like a deep deliberate bite mark... except the skin wasn’t bleeding.
It felt smooth and permanently sealed... almost like a raised scar or a deeply embedded tattoo.

She had been completely out-maneuvered, out-schemed, and left behind in the absolute dust by this terrifying yandere deity.
’I want to have sex too...!’
Meanwhile, on the top floor of the Keep...
CREAK!
Aeli gently pushed open the heavy oak door to Silas’s private executive office.
Sitting behind his broad mahogany desk, bathed in the warm golden sunlight pouring through the floor-to-ceiling windows, was Silas.
He was wearing a crisp, long-sleeved dark shirt buttoned neat at his wrists, paired with tailored black trousers.
His short dark hair was combed back, his posture upright, and his sharp handsome features radiated an effortless commanding intelligence.
Seeing his silver-haired arcanist step into the room, Silas looked up from his desk, a warm, confident smile touching his lips.
"Good morning, Lord Silas," Aeli greeted him warmly, bowing her head politely as she held a glass pitcher filled with fresh golden fruit juice.
"Good morning, Aeli," Silas greeted her back.
In truth, Silas was feeling like an entirely new man today.
And technically... he was.

Inside his chest, his newly evolved Royal Gold Core was pulsing with liquid gold energy, having officially broken through to Stage 2 of Core Advancement, permanently expanding his maximum mana pool to a staggering 30,000 points.
And on top of that physical breakthrough... he had officially taken Eluned as his wife, spending the entire night engaged in wild passionate lovemaking until the break of dawn.
’Hehe...’ Silas chuckled internally, a wave of satisfaction washing over his mind.
He almost let out an audible laugh, but caught himself in time, maintaining his cool professional composure behind his desk.
’If Elu doesn’t mind having kids eventually...’ Silas reflected in his thoughts. ’I certainly don’t mind either. A family sounds nice.’
However... a sudden concern flickered in the back of Silas’s mind.
He remembered the fundamental laws of the Blessed Land territory.
The territory had strictly enforced a female-only rule for all resident units.

’Wait a minute...’ Silas thought with his dark eyebrows pulling together slightly. ’If Elu eventually gives birth to a child... and that child turns out to be a boy... would the territory’s system laws try to forcibly eradicate or banish my own son from the domain?’
That would be a nightmare.
Silas didn’t hesitate.
He silently invoked his system interface, submitting an immediate direct query to his Upgrade system.
’System,’ Silas queried in his mind. ’Clarify territory population laws regarding direct lineage. If a male child is born to the Lord, how does the domain aura react?’
A sleek translucent blue holographic tab instantly materialized in his field of vision:
[System Query Processing...]

[Territory Rule Clarification: While external male entities are strictly prohibited from establishing residency within the Blessed Land (excluding non-human mounts and beast assets), an exemption exists for the Lord’s direct biological bloodline.]
[Notice: Any biological children or direct blood relatives produced by the Lord inherit the Sovereign’s Authority, granting them unrestricted residency and full immunity to territorial rejection.]
Reading the blue text, Silas let out a long quiet breath of genuine relief.
"Phew..." Silas exhaled softly.
Aeli, who was walking up to his desk with a glass of fresh juice, paused. She looked at him with curious silver eyes, tilting her head.
"What was that sigh for, My Lord?" Aeli asked gently. "Are you feeling unwell?"
Silas looked up at her, offering a warm genuine smile that made her heart skip three beats.
"Nothing at all, Aeli," Silas answered smoothly. "I’m just really glad to see you this morning."
Aeli’s pale cheeks instantly flushed a bright, lovely shade of pink.
Her silver ears twitched shyly as she hurriedly set the glass of fresh golden fruit juice onto his desk.
"I... I brought you some fresh Basin fruit juice, My Lord!" Aeli reported quickly, her voice trembling with sweet flustered excitement. "I prepared it myself using Kaelia’s special recipe!"
Silas looked at the glass of golden juice sitting on his desk.
He looked at the liquid, then looked back up at Aeli’s blushing face, an eyebrow twitching slightly as a wave of post-traumatic caution washed over his mind.
After getting drugged into oblivion by Eluned last night, Silas was taking zero chances with unknown drinks.
Silas squinted his golden eyes playfully, asking in a deadpan voice.
"Aeli... you didn’t happen to spike or drug this drink, did you?"
Aeli went completely rigid.
Her eyes widened in shock and her face exploded into a burning red flush as she frantically waved her hands in front of her chest.
"N-NO! OF COURSE NOT!" Aeli squeaked out frantically, her voice reaching a high-pitched adorable squeak. "I WOULD NEVER DRUG YOU, MY LORD! WHY... WHY WOULD YOU ASK SUCH A HORRIBLE QUESTION?!"
Silas looked at her innocent reaction, let out a soft chuckle, and picked up the glass.
"Just making sure," Silas smiled. "You can never be too careful in this Keep nowadays."
Silas brought the glass to his lips, taking a long refreshing gulp of the sweet, chilled fruit juice.
It tasted light and completely free of any divine slumber-herbs.
GULP!
Silas set the empty glass back down, letting out a satisfied breath.
"That was delicious, Aeli. Thank you."
Aeli beamed proudly, clutching her hands behind her back. "I’m glad you liked it, My Lord!"
Silas leaned back in his leather chair, crossing his hands over his desk, his tone shifting into business mode.
"So, Aeli," Silas began, "what is our official schedule for the territory today?"
Aeli instantly straightened her posture, taking on her role as his primary secretary.
’Speaking of Secretary... Kadi should be coming soon.’

"As you instructed yesterday, My Lord," Aeli reported clearly, "today is dedicated entirely to territory renovation and structural expansion. We need to prepare our living facilities for the incoming recruits and upgrade our internal infrastructure before war day."
"Right," Silas nodded.
Silas swiped his right hand through the air, summoning his Sovereign Realm territory interface.
He navigated directly to the Architectural Blueprint Menu... the construction tab he had unlocked when the Blessed Land officially reached Level 10.
A sleek glowing blue holographic tab materialized directly over his desk, displaying dozens of available civic, military, and residential blueprints.
Silas scrolled past the automated ballista arrays and basic stone walls, stopping at the residential section.
His eyes locked onto a specific blueprint.
[Tier 2 Multi-Floor Living Quarters]
[Type: Residential Infrastructure]

[Structure Overview: A three-story, reinforced multi-unit residential building featuring forty individual private suites, soundproofed living quarters, private washrooms, and climate-control rune arrays.]
[Materials Required: 600 Units of Ironwood Beams, 300 Units of Obsidian-Slate Stone.]
[Description: Upgrades the territory’s living standards from communal group barracks to private individual suites. Drastically boosts resident morale, physical recovery rates, and privacy.]
Silas scanned the detailed requirements, nodding his head in deep satisfaction.
"This is perfect," Silas muttered aloud, his golden eyes analyzing the wireframe diagram.

While the Barracks were fantastic for military drills, group briefings, and housing new recruits during their initial orientation... Silas knew that long-term, his elite female soldiers deserved proper, private living spaces where they could rest without sleeping in a crowded sixty-person room.
"Six hundred units of Ironwood Beams and three hundred units of Obsidian-Slate Stone..." Silas calculated in his mind.
He checked his current inventory reserves.

Thanks to Eluned’s massive timber harvests from the Umbral Basin treeline, Silas possessed over eight hundred units of raw Ironwood stored in his spatial inventory. The wood requirement was completely covered.
...However, he had zero units of Obsidian-Slate Stone.

Obsidian-Slate was a dense, fire-resistant, and highly magic-conductive stone quarried primarily from deep volcanic ridges... a material that wasn’t naturally abundant in the immediate vicinity of his Territory.
Silas leaned his chin on his palm, a thoughtful sly smirk spreading across his face.
"I don’t have the stone..." Silas mused drily to himself, "...but that doesn’t mean Lord Sky doesn’t have a massive mountain of it sitting inside the lower holds of his rolling war-rig."
Sky ran a massive multi-million-credit streaming empire.
A Classic Lord like him undoubtedly carried heavy construction bundles, refined stone crates, and raw building materials in his mobile fortress’s supply holds.
Silas looked up from his blueprint screen with his golden eyes fixing onto Aeli.
A slow and meaningful smile spread across Silas’s features... a smile that made Aeli’s heart flutter wildly against her ribs.
"Aeli..." Silas asked softly. "...would you like to grow stronger?"
Aeli’s silver eyes widened to the size of dinner plates.
Her breath caught in her throat.

She instantly remembered what Silas had done for Tasmin and Brida not too long ago... how he had placed his hand on them, ignited his golden aura, and forcefully mutated their baseline abilities, transforming them into terrifying S-Rank combatants.
Aeli took a step forward, her silver eyes glowing with fierce unshakeable determination as she nodded her head vigorously.
"Yes, My Lord!" Aeli answered passionately, her voice ringing clearly through the office. "I want to get stronger! I want to get so much stronger so I can protect you and serve you better!"
Silas chuckled warmly, nodding his head.
"Good. Then let’s do this properly."
Silas reached into his inventory, checking his Upgrade Point balance...
PING!
[Current UP Balance: 1,240 UP]
He had more than enough points saved up from yesterday’s massive monster raids to execute two full S-Rank evolutionary ascensions.
"Aeli," Silas instructed, "go fetch Rowenna. I’m going to upgrade the two of you together before—"
Before Silas could even finish his sentence—
"YES, MY LORD!" Aeli shouted happily.
Without waiting for him to complete his words, the silver-haired elven arcanist spun on her heel, sprinted out of the office door, and the second her boots crossed the threshold—
FLASH!
Aeli triggered her short-range spatial teleportation, vanishing from the hallway in a brilliant burst of silver light.
Silas sat behind his desk, his hand still extended in mid-air, staring at the empty doorway where Aeli had been standing a second ago.
Silas let out a short amused laugh, resting his hand back on the mahogany wood, tapping his fingers rhythmically against the desk.
"Man..." Silas chuckled softly to himself, his golden eyes glinting with genuine pride. "I really love how excited they get about gaining power."
Upgrading Aeli and Rowenna to full S-Rank status was a critical tactical move.

Elevating both of his primary casters to S-Rank would give the Blessed Land an god-tier magical backline... further guaranteeing that next week’s official Lord War against "The Unmovable Wall" would end in a complete overwhelming landslide victory.
Silas leaned his head back against his leather chair, staring up at the ceiling rafters with a thoughtful smirk.
"Now then..." Silas mused, his mind shifting to his next objective. "...how exactly should I approach Lord Sky to trade for those three hundred units of Obsidian-Slate stone...?"
[Author’s Note]
Happy new month in advance and I’m grateful for the support heh, let me go plan my mass release. See you guys tomorrow.
