chapters.title: Chapter 281: Kadi [I]
paragraphs: The second Silas’s golden-ringed eyes landed on the SSS-Rank Dread Queen, his dark eyebrows pulled together in immediate genuine concern.
Morwenna looked terrible.
Her pale face was so utterly devoid of color that she barely looked alive.
It looked as though every single drop of blood had been forcefully boiled out of her veins, leaving her looking sick drained and deeply traumatized by some unseen cosmic horror.
Silas immediately stood up from the window sill, walking across the office toward her.
"Morwenna?" Silas called out, his voice filled with immediate worry.
The moment Silas reached her, Morwenna’s knees seemed to buckle slightly.
She let out a weak exhausted breath and completely slumped forward with her heavy leather-clad body leaning against his broad shoulder.
Silas caught her securely, wrapping his arm around her waist to support her weight.

Given that both of them had been drugged by Eluned’s slumber-herbs last night, Silas’s first instinct was to assume that Morwenna was suffering from some lingering delayed magical backlash from the divine sedative.
He wouldn’t put it past Eluned to do something like that.
"What’s wrong, Morwenna?" Silas asked softly, looking down at her messy hair. "Are you feeling sick? Is your core lagging?"
Morwenna rested her cheek against his chest, her stormy gray eyes staring blankly at the floorboards.
She opened her mouth, wanting to immediately spill everything that had just happened down in the bathhouse.
She wanted to yell at him about how insufferably arrogant Eluned was being.

She wanted to tell him how the Nature Goddess had stood in the bathtub, smugly showing off her red spank marks, boasting about how Silas had manhandled her, and listing off every single sexual position they had engaged in throughout the night... Missionary, Doggystyle, Cowgirl, Reverse Cowgirl, Mating Press, and Standing Carry.
’I don’t even know what most of those mean.’
Morwenna had wanted to scream at him for letting that weed get a head start...
...But as she leaned against his warm, broad chest, feeling the steady beat of his Gold Core heart, Morwenna forcefully calmed her churning pirate pride down.

’Wait a minute...’ Morwenna thought, her sharp mind working through her embarrassment. ’What if that weed was completely lying to me just to mess with my head? What if she made all of those vulgar details up just to make me feel insecure?’
Morwenna lifted her head slightly from his chest, her stormy gray eyes looking up into his sharp, golden-ringed eyes with a rare, hesitant vulnerability.
"Captain..." Morwenna asked quietly, her raspy voice unusually small, "...did you... did you and that weed really do all of those things last night while I was sleeping?"
Silas froze.
His golden eyes blinked once in total surprise.
A sudden slight flush touched Silas’s cheek, and he let out a shy, mildly embarrassed chuckle, rubbing the back of his neck as he answered truthfully.
"Ah... well... yeah. We... we kind of did."
Hearing his honest admission, Morwenna’s face paled even further, reaching a level of ghost-white that defied modern medicine.
It wasn’t a lie.

The weed hadn’t made it up... Silas had genuinely spent the entire night claiming the Nature Goddess, manhandling her, spanking her, and leaving permanent marks all over her body while Morwenna had been lying unconscious on a guest room mattress.
’It should’ve been me...!’
Deep inside Morwenna’s soul, an intense burning wave of envy and raw physical desire flared to life.
She wanted to have sex with him too.

She wanted to feel his broad hands gripping her waist, she wanted to feel his heat, and she wanted him to claim her just as thoroughly... but her fierce pirate pride completely prevented her from blurting those words out loud to his face.
’Does this mean...’ Morwenna pondered in silent horror, ’...does this mean I actually have to go to that weed for romantic guidance?’
The mere thought of asking Eluned for advice on how to seduce her Captain made Morwenna want to dive headfirst off the Watchtower into a volcano.
Morwenna cleared her throat loudly, forcing her pale cheeks to flush with a sudden stubborn heat.
"O-Ok..." Morwenna stammered out awkwardly.
She pushed herself off his broad chest, stepping back two paces and straightening her spine, standing at rigid military attention in the center of his office.
"Captain," Morwenna requested firmly, her raspy voice returning to its sharp, commanding tone, "I request permission to take the Abyss Corsairs outside the territory walls today."
Silas raised an eyebrow, looking at her sudden shift in demeanor. "Outside the walls? For what?"
"You need UP, don’t you?" Morwenna pointed out directly.
Silas nodded his head. "Yeah. I actually need a lot of it for the new living quarters and unit upgrades."
Morwenna offered him a sharp and thoroughly vicious smirk, her stormy gray eyes flashing with ocean authority.

"Then I will go get it for you," Morwenna declared smoothly. "My Corsairs and I will raid the upper monster ridges in the Basin. We’ll slaughter every elite beast we find and bring you a mountain of points."
Before Silas could respond, the immortal Dread Queen hesitated for a fraction of a second.
She cutely puckered her plump, soft lips forward, looking at him with an expectant demanding glare.
"Give me a good luck charm before I go, Captain," Morwenna demanded softly.
Silas looked at her pouty expectant face, letting out a long fond sigh through his nose.
Much like Eluned, Morwenna was extraordinarily cute whenever she dropped her fierce combat persona and showed her soft side.
"Alright," Silas smiled warmly.
Silas stepped forward, closing the distance between them. He leaned his head down, offering her a simple, sweet peck on her lips.
...However, the moment their lips touched, neither of them pulled back.
The simple peck instantly evolved into a deep passionate kiss.
Silas wrapped his broad arm around her waist, pulling her leather-clad body flush against his chest as their lips parted, their tongues tangling together in a warm hungry rhythm.
SMACK... SMACK!
As they made out in the middle of the office, Silas’s broad right hand slowly glided downward, slipping over her dark trousers and resting firmly against her right butt cheek.
Silas didn’t hold back. He tightened his fingers, groping her firm, curvaceous rear, sinking his broad palm straight into her soft flesh with a heavy, deliberate squeeze.
"Mmm~!" Morwenna let out a soft, breathless moan directly into his mouth with her toes curling inside her boots.
During their sword training spars in the vault, Morwenna had made a habit of aggressively grabbing and squeezing his rear whenever she caught him off-guard.
Now, Silas was taking full advantage of the moment to touch her wonderful firm rear as much as he damn well pleased.
SQUEEZE... SQUEEZE!
Morwenna’s hips twitched against his waist with her hands clutching his shoulders as she melted into his grip and her heart hammering against her ribs.
After a long, passionate minute, they slowly separated their lips.
A thin glistening strand of saliva connected their mouths before breaking in the morning air.
Silas leaned down, planting a gentle kiss onto the top of her head, and offered her a warm confident smile.
"Good luck out there, Morwenna," Silas wished her softly. "Stay safe."
Morwenna stood there in the office, her face glowing a bright and thoroughly flustered crimson.
She bowed her head deeply toward him, her stormy eyes sparkling with pure affection.
"Thank you, Captain," Morwenna whispered softly.
She turned on her heel, sprinting out of his office door to head downstairs at record speed.

"Oh, Morwenna, wait," Silas called out down the hallway as she reached the stairs. "If you see Kadi on your way out, tell her to come up to my office. She’s my new secondary secretary, and I should help her get settled into the Keep."
"Understood, Captain!" Morwenna’s voice echoed back from the staircase.
Silas stood near his desk, watching her departure with a calm, thoughtful smirk.
’Helping Kadi transition into her new administrative role will make things much smoother around here,’ Silas reflected in his mind.
As for allowing Morwenna and her Abyss Corsair team to venture outside the territory walls... Silas felt zero tactical concern regarding Lord Sky’s surveillance.
Morwenna was an SSS-Rank Pirate whose raw power transcended the standard mechanics of the Sovereign Realm.
It didn’t matter how much footage Sky gathered on her, nor did it matter what kind of counter-measures he prepared in his mobile fortress.
It was fundamentally impossible for a Classic Lord like Sky to defeat an SSS-Rank ocean legend in direct combat.
And as for any high-tier mages or artillery Sky might deploy... Silas could easily afford that minor intel leak if it meant Morwenna was bringing back thousands of raw UP for the Territory.
A few minutes later, near the Barracks...
CREAK!
The grand, iron-reinforced main gates of the Blessed Land slowly swung open.
Morwenna stepped through the threshold, leading her specialized squad of thirteen girls... the Abyss Corsairs out into the misty, overgrown expanse of the Umbral Basin.
The women were clad in lightened leather armor, carrying their staffs and marching behind their Dread Queen with enthusiastic discipline.
Up on the second floor of the barracks, standing near an open glass window, was Kadi.
The young woman rested her hands on the wooden sill, watching the Abyss Corsairs march out into the wilderness with a long envious sigh.
"Well, damn..." Kadi muttered out loud to herself, pouting slightly. "...I couldn’t join them today."
Kadi had been desperately hoping to go out on field raids today.
She wanted to practice her elemental spell channeling, and under Morwenna’s expert guidance was by far the best way to improve.

Even though Morwenna was a primary water specialist, the Dread Queen possessed such a vast ancient reservoir of martial and magical knowledge regarding all elemental branches that Kadi wouldn’t have minded in the slightest becoming her personal, full-time student.
...But Kadi had a far more important assignment today.
Kadi turned away from the window, walking over to her cot.
Resting on her bed was a large tightly packed canvas travel bag.
Kadi reached down, checking the leather straps and buckles, ensuring that all of her personal belongings, extra tunics, notebooks, and private items were securely sealed inside.
She lifted the heavy canvas bag, slinging the strap securely over her shoulder.
Starting today, Kadi was officially vacating her cot in the barracks and moving her residence directly into the Lord’s Keep to serve as Silas’s secondary administrative secretary.
Kadi stood in the center of the quiet room with her heart suddenly pounding against her ribs as a deep, burning blush spread across her cheeks.
She wouldn’t lie to herself or deny the truth. She wasn’t just excited about the administrative promotion.
’I have a massive crush on my Lord after all...’ Kadi admitted to herself in her internal thoughts, her face burning hot.
Ever since Silas had brought her into the Blessed Land, and provided her with food, shelter, and purpose, Kadi’s heart had belonged entirely to him.
The thought of living under the exact same roof as him, working beside his desk every single day, made her stomach do nervous ecstatic somersaults.
Kadi hoisted her bag higher on her shoulder, turned on her heel, and walked out of the residential wing.
She headed downstairs, entering the sprawling Mess Hall.
The main exit doors leading to the central courtyard were situated directly past the dining area.
Inside the Mess Hall, dozens of girls were sitting at the long oak tables, eating their morning breakfast rations.
Seeing Kadi walk through the hall carrying her packed travel bag, several of her fellow recruits stood up, waving their mugs in the air with loud boisterous grins.
"Hey! Look at Kadi!" one of the archers teased loudly. "Moving into the big Keep today!"
"Good luck, girl!" another recruit cheered with a laugh. "If you get a chance to fuck the Lord tonight, make sure you spread your legs wide!"
A chorus of wild, playful laughter erupted across the Mess Hall.
Kadi froze, her entire face exploding into a red flush.
But instead of shrinking back in embarrassment, Kadi raised her hand, waving cheekily at her companions with a confident mischievous smirk.
"That’s the plan!" Kadi called back cheerfully. "And don’t worry, once I’m his secretary, I’ll make sure to recommend all of you for good promotion positions too!"
"YEAH!"
"THAT’S OUR GIRL!"
The girls cheered wildly, raising their wooden mugs and drinking a hearty morning toast directly in her name.
Kadi giggled softly, passing by the cheering tables, and pushed open the heavy double doors of the Mess Hall, stepping out into the crisp morning air of the central courtyard.
She walked across the stone pathway leading toward the Keep with her boots making light tapping sounds against the cobblestones.

sentences.text: The second Silas’s golden-ringed eyes landed on the SSS-Rank Dread Queen, his dark eyebrows pulled together in immediate genuine concern.
Morwenna looked terrible.
Her pale face was so utterly devoid of color that she barely looked alive.
It looked as though every single drop of blood had been forcefully boiled out of her veins, leaving her looking sick drained and deeply traumatized by some unseen cosmic horror.
Silas immediately stood up from the window sill, walking across the office toward her.
"Morwenna?" Silas called out, his voice filled with immediate worry.
The moment Silas reached her, Morwenna’s knees seemed to buckle slightly.
She let out a weak exhausted breath and completely slumped forward with her heavy leather-clad body leaning against his broad shoulder.
Silas caught her securely, wrapping his arm around her waist to support her weight.

Given that both of them had been drugged by Eluned’s slumber-herbs last night, Silas’s first instinct was to assume that Morwenna was suffering from some lingering delayed magical backlash from the divine sedative.
He wouldn’t put it past Eluned to do something like that.
"What’s wrong, Morwenna?" Silas asked softly, looking down at her messy hair.
"Are you feeling sick?
Is your core lagging?"
Morwenna rested her cheek against his chest, her stormy gray eyes staring blankly at the floorboards.
She opened her mouth, wanting to immediately spill everything that had just happened down in the bathhouse.
She wanted to yell at him about how insufferably arrogant Eluned was being.

She wanted to tell him how the Nature Goddess had stood in the bathtub, smugly showing off her red spank marks, boasting about how Silas had manhandled her, and listing off every single sexual position they had engaged in throughout the night...
Missionary, Doggystyle, Cowgirl, Reverse Cowgirl, Mating Press, and Standing Carry.
’I don’t even know what most of those mean.’
Morwenna had wanted to scream at him for letting that weed get a head start...
...But as she leaned against his warm, broad chest, feeling the steady beat of his Gold Core heart, Morwenna forcefully calmed her churning pirate pride down.
’Wait a minute...’ Morwenna thought, her sharp mind working through her embarrassment. ’What if that weed was completely lying to me just to mess with my head?
What if she made all of those vulgar details up just to make me feel insecure?’
Morwenna lifted her head slightly from his chest, her stormy gray eyes looking up into his sharp, golden-ringed eyes with a rare, hesitant vulnerability.
"Captain..." Morwenna asked quietly, her raspy voice unusually small, "...did you... did you and that weed really do all of those things last night while I was sleeping?"
Silas froze.
His golden eyes blinked once in total surprise.
A sudden slight flush touched Silas’s cheek, and he let out a shy, mildly embarrassed chuckle, rubbing the back of his neck as he answered truthfully.
"Ah... well... yeah.
We... we kind of did."
Hearing his honest admission, Morwenna’s face paled even further, reaching a level of ghost-white that defied modern medicine.
It wasn’t a lie.
The weed hadn’t made it up...

Silas had genuinely spent the entire night claiming the Nature Goddess, manhandling her, spanking her, and leaving permanent marks all over her body while Morwenna had been lying unconscious on a guest room mattress.
’It should’ve been me...!’
Deep inside Morwenna’s soul, an intense burning wave of envy and raw physical desire flared to life.
She wanted to have sex with him too.

She wanted to feel his broad hands gripping her waist, she wanted to feel his heat, and she wanted him to claim her just as thoroughly... but her fierce pirate pride completely prevented her from blurting those words out loud to his face.
’Does this mean...’ Morwenna pondered in silent horror, ’...does this mean I actually have to go to that weed for romantic guidance?’
The mere thought of asking Eluned for advice on how to seduce her Captain made Morwenna want to dive headfirst off the Watchtower into a volcano.
Morwenna cleared her throat loudly, forcing her pale cheeks to flush with a sudden stubborn heat.
"O-Ok..." Morwenna stammered out awkwardly.
She pushed herself off his broad chest, stepping back two paces and straightening her spine, standing at rigid military attention in the center of his office.
"Captain," Morwenna requested firmly, her raspy voice returning to its sharp, commanding tone, "I request permission to take the Abyss Corsairs outside the territory walls today."
Silas raised an eyebrow, looking at her sudden shift in demeanor.
"Outside the walls?
For what?"
"You need UP, don’t you?" Morwenna pointed out directly.
Silas nodded his head.
"Yeah.
I actually need a lot of it for the new living quarters and unit upgrades."
Morwenna offered him a sharp and thoroughly vicious smirk, her stormy gray eyes flashing with ocean authority.
"Then I will go get it for you," Morwenna declared smoothly.
"My Corsairs and I will raid the upper monster ridges in the Basin.
We’ll slaughter every elite beast we find and bring you a mountain of points."
Before Silas could respond, the immortal Dread Queen hesitated for a fraction of a second.
She cutely puckered her plump, soft lips forward, looking at him with an expectant demanding glare.
"Give me a good luck charm before I go, Captain," Morwenna demanded softly.
Silas looked at her pouty expectant face, letting out a long fond sigh through his nose.
Much like Eluned, Morwenna was extraordinarily cute whenever she dropped her fierce combat persona and showed her soft side.
"Alright," Silas smiled warmly.
Silas stepped forward, closing the distance between them.
He leaned his head down, offering her a simple, sweet peck on her lips.
...However, the moment their lips touched, neither of them pulled back.
The simple peck instantly evolved into a deep passionate kiss.
Silas wrapped his broad arm around her waist, pulling her leather-clad body flush against his chest as their lips parted, their tongues tangling together in a warm hungry rhythm.
SMACK...
SMACK!
As they made out in the middle of the office, Silas’s broad right hand slowly glided downward, slipping over her dark trousers and resting firmly against her right butt cheek.
Silas didn’t hold back.
He tightened his fingers, groping her firm, curvaceous rear, sinking his broad palm straight into her soft flesh with a heavy, deliberate squeeze.
"Mmm~!" Morwenna let out a soft, breathless moan directly into his mouth with her toes curling inside her boots.
During their sword training spars in the vault, Morwenna had made a habit of aggressively grabbing and squeezing his rear whenever she caught him off-guard.
Now, Silas was taking full advantage of the moment to touch her wonderful firm rear as much as he damn well pleased.
SQUEEZE...
SQUEEZE!
Morwenna’s hips twitched against his waist with her hands clutching his shoulders as she melted into his grip and her heart hammering against her ribs.
After a long, passionate minute, they slowly separated their lips.
A thin glistening strand of saliva connected their mouths before breaking in the morning air.
Silas leaned down, planting a gentle kiss onto the top of her head, and offered her a warm confident smile.
"Good luck out there, Morwenna," Silas wished her softly.
"Stay safe."
Morwenna stood there in the office, her face glowing a bright and thoroughly flustered crimson.
She bowed her head deeply toward him, her stormy eyes sparkling with pure affection.
"Thank you, Captain," Morwenna whispered softly.
She turned on her heel, sprinting out of his office door to head downstairs at record speed.
"Oh, Morwenna, wait," Silas called out down the hallway as she reached the stairs.
"If you see Kadi on your way out, tell her to come up to my office.
She’s my new secondary secretary, and I should help her get settled into the Keep."
"Understood, Captain!" Morwenna’s voice echoed back from the staircase.
Silas stood near his desk, watching her departure with a calm, thoughtful smirk.
’Helping Kadi transition into her new administrative role will make things much smoother around here,’ Silas reflected in his mind.
As for allowing Morwenna and her Abyss Corsair team to venture outside the territory walls...
Silas felt zero tactical concern regarding Lord Sky’s surveillance.
Morwenna was an SSS-Rank Pirate whose raw power transcended the standard mechanics of the Sovereign Realm.
It didn’t matter how much footage Sky gathered on her, nor did it matter what kind of counter-measures he prepared in his mobile fortress.
It was fundamentally impossible for a Classic Lord like Sky to defeat an SSS-Rank ocean legend in direct combat.
And as for any high-tier mages or artillery Sky might deploy...
Silas could easily afford that minor intel leak if it meant Morwenna was bringing back thousands of raw UP for the Territory.
A few minutes later, near the Barracks...
CREAK!
The grand, iron-reinforced main gates of the Blessed Land slowly swung open.
Morwenna stepped through the threshold, leading her specialized squad of thirteen girls... the Abyss Corsairs out into the misty, overgrown expanse of the Umbral Basin.
The women were clad in lightened leather armor, carrying their staffs and marching behind their Dread Queen with enthusiastic discipline.
Up on the second floor of the barracks, standing near an open glass window, was Kadi.
The young woman rested her hands on the wooden sill, watching the Abyss Corsairs march out into the wilderness with a long envious sigh.
"Well, damn..." Kadi muttered out loud to herself, pouting slightly.
"...I couldn’t join them today."
Kadi had been desperately hoping to go out on field raids today.
She wanted to practice her elemental spell channeling, and under Morwenna’s expert guidance was by far the best way to improve.

Even though Morwenna was a primary water specialist, the Dread Queen possessed such a vast ancient reservoir of martial and magical knowledge regarding all elemental branches that Kadi wouldn’t have minded in the slightest becoming her personal, full-time student.
...But Kadi had a far more important assignment today.
Kadi turned away from the window, walking over to her cot.
Resting on her bed was a large tightly packed canvas travel bag.
Kadi reached down, checking the leather straps and buckles, ensuring that all of her personal belongings, extra tunics, notebooks, and private items were securely sealed inside.
She lifted the heavy canvas bag, slinging the strap securely over her shoulder.
Starting today, Kadi was officially vacating her cot in the barracks and moving her residence directly into the Lord’s Keep to serve as Silas’s secondary administrative secretary.
Kadi stood in the center of the quiet room with her heart suddenly pounding against her ribs as a deep, burning blush spread across her cheeks.
She wouldn’t lie to herself or deny the truth.
She wasn’t just excited about the administrative promotion.
’I have a massive crush on my Lord after all...’ Kadi admitted to herself in her internal thoughts, her face burning hot.
Ever since Silas had brought her into the Blessed Land, and provided her with food, shelter, and purpose, Kadi’s heart had belonged entirely to him.
The thought of living under the exact same roof as him, working beside his desk every single day, made her stomach do nervous ecstatic somersaults.
Kadi hoisted her bag higher on her shoulder, turned on her heel, and walked out of the residential wing.
She headed downstairs, entering the sprawling Mess Hall.
The main exit doors leading to the central courtyard were situated directly past the dining area.
Inside the Mess Hall, dozens of girls were sitting at the long oak tables, eating their morning breakfast rations.
Seeing Kadi walk through the hall carrying her packed travel bag, several of her fellow recruits stood up, waving their mugs in the air with loud boisterous grins.
"Hey!
Look at Kadi!" one of the archers teased loudly.
"Moving into the big Keep today!"
"Good luck, girl!" another recruit cheered with a laugh.
"If you get a chance to fuck the Lord tonight, make sure you spread your legs wide!"
A chorus of wild, playful laughter erupted across the Mess Hall.
Kadi froze, her entire face exploding into a red flush.
But instead of shrinking back in embarrassment, Kadi raised her hand, waving cheekily at her companions with a confident mischievous smirk.
"That’s the plan!" Kadi called back cheerfully.
"And don’t worry, once I’m his secretary, I’ll make sure to recommend all of you for good promotion positions too!"
"YEAH!"
"THAT’S OUR GIRL!"
The girls cheered wildly, raising their wooden mugs and drinking a hearty morning toast directly in her name.
Kadi giggled softly, passing by the cheering tables, and pushed open the heavy double doors of the Mess Hall, stepping out into the crisp morning air of the central courtyard.
She walked across the stone pathway leading toward the Keep with her boots making light tapping sounds against the cobblestones.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Kadi [II]
paragraphs: As she approached the grand front entrance of the Keep, Kadi took a deep steadying breath with her hands trembling slightly as she clutched the strap of her travel bag.
’I need to be on my absolute best behavior...’ Kadi reminded herself sternly in her thoughts.
As much as her heart desperately wanted to throw her arms around her Lord, jump onto his lap, and confess her feelings right away... she knew she had to maintain professional discipline.
Silas was a brilliant Warlord.
If she acted too wild, clumsy, or incompetent during her secretarial duties, he might decide she wasn’t fit for the job and send her back to the barracks.
She needed to prove her worth first.
Kadi stepped onto the Keep’s front porch, stopping directly before the massive timber double doors.
She held her breath with her heart doing wild frantic somersaults inside her chest.
She raised her right hand, curling her fingers into a small fist, and gave the heavy wooden door two gentle polite knocks.
KNOCK! KNOCK!
Kadi stepped back, nervously adjusting her tunic collar.
In her mind, she fully expected Aeliana, Rowenna, or even Talira, the dragon to open the door and greet her.
...But a second later, the heavy timber door slowly swung inward.
Standing in the doorway, bathed in the warm morning sunlight, was Silas himself.
He was wearing his crisp long-sleeved dark shirt and black trousers, looking effortlessly handsome and commanding.
Seeing the blushing young woman standing on his porch carrying a heavy travel bag, a warm welcoming smile spread across Silas’s sharp features.
"Welcome to the Keep, Kadi," Silas greeted her smoothly, his deep voice echoing warmly. "I’m glad you came today. Want to come in?"
Kadi lowered her upper body into a deep respectful bow on the stone porch, her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird.
"Good morning, My Lord!" Kadi greeted him warmly, her voice trembling slightly with sweet uncontrollable excitement. "I... I would love to come in!"
Silas offered her a gentle, welcoming smile, stepping back from the threshold to make way.
"Come on in."
The moment Kadi set foot across the heavy oak doorway carrying her heavy canvas travel bag, Silas reached out with his broad hand and smoothly pulled the grand timber double doors shut behind her.
CREAK... BANG!
The heavy latch clicked into place, sealing the quiet, cool interior of the Keep from the morning breeze outside.
Silas turned around, crossing his arms over his broad chest as he looked at the blushing young woman.

"Welcome to the Keep, Kadi," Silas announced smoothly, his deep voice echoing warmly off the high stone arches. "This is where you’ll officially be residing from now on as my secondary administrative secretary."
Hearing his deep voice, Kadi felt a wave of dizzying happiness flood her chest.
She bowed her head once more, her cheeks burning bright crimson.
"Thank you so much for this incredible opportunity, Lord Silas! I promise I won’t disappoint you!"
Silas chuckled warmly, stepping forward. He reached out with his broad, calloused right hand and gently patted her head, stroking her soft hair with a fond approving touch.
"I know you won’t," Silas murmured.
An explosion of bright red blood rushed straight to Kadi’s ears.
Her toes curled inside her leather boots, her breath catching in her throat as she let out a tiny breathless squeak.
Silas looked down at her blushing face, his golden-ringed eyes analyzing her frame for a brief microsecond.
Kadi had previously ingested the [Seed of Miracles] that he had gotten from the secret Realm.
’And she has high mastery over Sand right now...’
However that sand-attribute magic meant she shared a direct elemental lineage with Ititius since he had stored himself within the seed before he was destroyed by the territory.
If guided and trained properly, Kadi possessed the latent potential to one day reach an S-Rank or even SSS-Rank standing, developing a combat prowess that could rival the Sand God himself.
And Silas wanted to make sure he kept a close protective eye on her growth.
’Just because male entities can’t exist inside the Blessed Land...’ Silas reflected pragmatically in his internal thoughts, ’...doesn’t mean Ititius isn’t still lurking out there in her soul.’
That slippery bastard of a Sand God was an ancient unpredictable cosmic entity who had survived centuries of inter-realm conflicts.
Silas had zero intentions of letting Ititius or any other rogue deity interfere with the women under his protection.
Silas smoothed down his dark long-sleeved shirt, adjusting his collar as he looked back at Kadi.
"Before we get you settled into your room," Silas offered smoothly, "would you like a quick tour of the Keep first?"
Kadi immediately bowed her head, her silver-brown hair spilling over her shoulders.
"I would be honored, My Lord! Please lead the way!"
Silas smiled, turning around. He extended his broad right hand backward toward her, leaving his palm open.
Kadi froze mid-bow.
Her wide eyes locked onto his open calloused hand hovering in the air before her. Her mind completely short-circuited for two long seconds.
’W-Wait...!’ Kadi panicked internally with her heart doing wild somersaults against her ribs. ’Does... does my Lord want to hold my hand?! Right now?! On my very first day?!’
Her breathing turned shallow, her cheeks burning ten times redder than a ripe tomato.
Hesitantly, trembling with shy electric excitement, Kadi extended her delicate, pale fingers and lightly rested her hand inside his broad palm.
The moment their skin touched, Kadi felt a wave of intense liquid warmth radiate from his Gold Core, wrapping around her fingers like a cozy blanket.
Silas gently closed his calloused fingers around hers, giving her hand a firm reassuring squeeze, and pulled her forward alongside his broad frame.
"This is the primary ground floor hold," Silas explained smoothly, gesturing with his free hand toward the sprawling, polished stone hall ahead of them. "The main living room."
Kadi walked beside him with her boots tapping lightly against the stone floor as her eyes scanned the room in awe.

The living area was massive and impeccably furnished... featuring plush dark leather couches arranged around a grand granite fireplace, low mahogany tables, hand-woven wool rugs, and tall arched stained-glass windows that flooded the room with warm morning sunlight.
"There are plenty of couches to lounge on whenever you’re taking a break from work," Silas noted, continuing down the hall. "Though... we don’t have a Television like a normal Earth living room."
Kadi blinked her eyes, tilting her head in total bewildered confusion.
"A... TV? What is a TV, My Lord?"
Silas paused, catching himself mid-sentence, and let out a short, amused chuckle.
"Ah," Silas chuckled, shaking his head. "Television. It’s a technology from my world."

In truth, televisions and digital entertainment systems didn’t exist in the primitive starter zones of the Sovereign Realm... though, given high-tier spatial technology, it was technically completely possible to construct broadcast receivers.
Lord Sky, for example, had established a massive, multi-channel streaming array that broadcast his mobile fortress’s combat feeds straight back to Earth’s network servers.
However, Silas had zero interest in introducing modern distractions or social media entertainment to his territory right now.

He was building an elite disciplined army of warriors. Introducing mindless television, social media doom-scrolling, or brain-rot entertainment to the Keep would merely erode his soldiers’ combat focus and slow down their physical conditioning.
Of course, Silas didn’t explain all of that complex reasoning to Kadi.
"Don’t mind it," Silas smiled, dismissing the topic casually. "Just a slip of the tongue from Earth."
"Oh," Kadi nodded innocently, squeezing his warm hand back as they walked.
Silas led her down the right corridor, stopping before a set of wide, double-hinged timber doors.
He pushed them open, stepping into the Keep’s state-of-the-art primary kitchen.
"And this is the main kitchen," Silas introduced.
Sitting at the central marble island counter, wearing a simple soft green tunic that draped comfortably over her delicate frame, was Eluned.
The ancient Nature Goddess was sipping a cup of warm herbal tea, her long silver-green hair cascading over her shoulders like liquid silk.
Hearing the heavy doors push open, Eluned turned her head, her bright green eyes instantly locking onto Silas.
A breathtaking radiant smile spread across her divine face.
"Good morning, Hubby~!" Eluned purred softly, her melodic voice filled with sweet affection as she blew him a playful, delicate kiss through the air.
MWAH!
Silas offered her a warm fond smile...
...However, the second Eluned’s green eyes drifted downward and spotted Silas holding Kadi’s hand firmly in his palm...
The Nature Goddess’s divine expression twitched violently.
Her radiant angelic smile instantly froze in place as her bright green eyes narrowed into dangerously dark slits that sent a literal atmospheric freeze drifting across the room!
Deep inside Eluned’s possessesive Yandere soul, a sudden chaotic series of dark, silent calculations began rapidly firing at light speed.

’In what precise, ecologically silent way could I possibly murder her right now...?’ Eluned pondered deeply in her own mind, her fingers tightening around her teacup until the porcelain creaked. ’A sudden underground root strangulation? A lethal odorless floral neurotoxin in her morning tea? Or perhaps a simple burial beneath three hundred feet of damp soil...?’
Eluned genuinely despised the idea of a second secretary invading her Lord’s private space.
She wanted Silas entirely to herself.
...But as Eluned looked at Silas’s calm handsome face, she forcefully suppressed her dark murderous impulses.
She knew in her heart that appointing Kadi as a secondary administrative officer was her Lord’s direct decision.
As his devoted, loving wife, Eluned refused to undermine his authority or cause him unnecessary administrative stress over petty jealousy.
Silas walked up to the marble island, completely oblivious to Eluned’s internal murder equations, and introduced Kadi.
"Elu, this is Kadi. She’s officially moving into the Keep today to assist Aeli and me with territorial paperwork."
Eluned set her teacup down onto the saucer with a crisp clink as she adjusted her posture, offering a cool polite nod.
"I am already well aware of who Kadi is, My Lord," Eluned spoke up softly, her voice taking on a remarkably proud and superior pitch.
Without saying a single word about her nocturnal activities, Eluned casually reached up with her delicate left hand, brushing her long silver-green hair over her shoulder.
She deliberately exposed the right side of her pale neck... revealing the deep dark red, and permanently un-healable bite mark and hickey that Silas had aggressively carved into her flesh last night.
Kadi’s wide eyes instantly locked onto the dark red territorial brand etched into the Nature Goddess’s neck.
Then, Kadi’s gaze slowly drifted over to Silas’s neck... spotting the exact matching, permanent love bite mark resting right above his shirt collar.
Kadi’s sharp clever mind processed the visual evidence in less than half a second.
’HOLY SHIT!’ Kadi screamed in her own mind with her throat going completely dry. ’LADY ELUNED AND THE LORD ACTUALLY HAD FULL-BLOWN SEX LAST NIGHT?!’
A nuclear shockwave of gossip-fuel exploded inside Kadi’s brain.
She realized instantly that she needed to spread this legendary news to every single girl in the barracks the very second she got a chance...
Up until this morning, most of the female recruits in the territory had quietly worried that Silas was a stoic monk-like Lord who had zero interest in physical intimacy with women.

But seeing that passionate mark on Eluned’s neck proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that Silas was a real man which meant that every single girl in the territory had a genuine, realistic chance of eventually getting bedded by him too.
Silas, completely unaware of the mental chaos occurring in Kadi’s head, walked her over to the kitchen appliances.

"Over here we have the primary cooking station," Silas pointed out, gesturing to the polished steel counters, the large sink, and the mana-infused stone cooktop. "If you ever want to prepare meals or bake anything, just make sure to consult with Aeli or Kaelia first."
Silas paused, his golden-ringed eyes narrowing into a stern, deadpan stare as he added a serious, firm warning.

"And Kadi... I am warning you right now. Do not ever, under any circumstances, attempt to spike or drug anyone’s food or drinks in this Keep. If you do, you will immediately lose your secretarial position and be sent back to the barracks."
Hearing his sudden out-of-nowhere warning, Kadi tilted her head in genuine confusion.

"Spike your drink, My Lord?" Kadi asked naively, her voice filled with innocent bewilderment. "Why would I ever do that? Who on earth would be stupid or unhinged enough to drug your food in your own Keep?!"
Sitting at the marble counter behind them, Eluned’s pale face instantly exploded into a burning red flush.
’I’m not stupid...’

Lord Sky, for example, had established a massive, multi-channel streaming array that broadcast his mobile fortress’s combat feeds straight back to Earth’s network servers.
However, Silas had zero interest in introducing modern distractions or social media entertainment to his territory right now.
He was building an elite disciplined army of warriors.
Introducing mindless television, social media doom-scrolling, or brain-rot entertainment to the Keep would merely erode his soldiers’ combat focus and slow down their physical conditioning.
Of course, Silas didn’t explain all of that complex reasoning to Kadi.
"Don’t mind it," Silas smiled, dismissing the topic casually.
"Just a slip of the tongue from Earth."
"Oh," Kadi nodded innocently, squeezing his warm hand back as they walked.
Silas led her down the right corridor, stopping before a set of wide, double-hinged timber doors.
He pushed them open, stepping into the Keep’s state-of-the-art primary kitchen.
"And this is the main kitchen," Silas introduced.
Sitting at the central marble island counter, wearing a simple soft green tunic that draped comfortably over her delicate frame, was Eluned.
The ancient Nature Goddess was sipping a cup of warm herbal tea, her long silver-green hair cascading over her shoulders like liquid silk.
Hearing the heavy doors push open, Eluned turned her head, her bright green eyes instantly locking onto Silas.
A breathtaking radiant smile spread across her divine face.
"Good morning, Hubby~!" Eluned purred softly, her melodic voice filled with sweet affection as she blew him a playful, delicate kiss through the air.
MWAH!
Silas offered her a warm fond smile...
...However, the second Eluned’s green eyes drifted downward and spotted Silas holding Kadi’s hand firmly in his palm...
The Nature Goddess’s divine expression twitched violently.
Her radiant angelic smile instantly froze in place as her bright green eyes narrowed into dangerously dark slits that sent a literal atmospheric freeze drifting across the room!
Deep inside Eluned’s possessesive Yandere soul, a sudden chaotic series of dark, silent calculations began rapidly firing at light speed.

’In what precise, ecologically silent way could I possibly murder her right now...?’ Eluned pondered deeply in her own mind, her fingers tightening around her teacup until the porcelain creaked. ’A sudden underground root strangulation?
A lethal odorless floral neurotoxin in her morning tea?
Or perhaps a simple burial beneath three hundred feet of damp soil...?’
Eluned genuinely despised the idea of a second secretary invading her Lord’s private space.
She wanted Silas entirely to herself.
...But as Eluned looked at Silas’s calm handsome face, she forcefully suppressed her dark murderous impulses.
She knew in her heart that appointing Kadi as a secondary administrative officer was her Lord’s direct decision.
As his devoted, loving wife, Eluned refused to undermine his authority or cause him unnecessary administrative stress over petty jealousy.
Silas walked up to the marble island, completely oblivious to Eluned’s internal murder equations, and introduced Kadi.
"Elu, this is Kadi.
She’s officially moving into the Keep today to assist Aeli and me with territorial paperwork."
Eluned set her teacup down onto the saucer with a crisp clink as she adjusted her posture, offering a cool polite nod.
"I am already well aware of who Kadi is, My Lord," Eluned spoke up softly, her voice taking on a remarkably proud and superior pitch.
Without saying a single word about her nocturnal activities, Eluned casually reached up with her delicate left hand, brushing her long silver-green hair over her shoulder.
She deliberately exposed the right side of her pale neck... revealing the deep dark red, and permanently un-healable bite mark and hickey that Silas had aggressively carved into her flesh last night.
Kadi’s wide eyes instantly locked onto the dark red territorial brand etched into the Nature Goddess’s neck.
Then, Kadi’s gaze slowly drifted over to Silas’s neck... spotting the exact matching, permanent love bite mark resting right above his shirt collar.
Kadi’s sharp clever mind processed the visual evidence in less than half a second.
’HOLY SHIT!’ Kadi screamed in her own mind with her throat going completely dry. ’LADY ELUNED AND THE LORD ACTUALLY HAD FULL-BLOWN SEX LAST NIGHT?!’
A nuclear shockwave of gossip-fuel exploded inside Kadi’s brain.
She realized instantly that she needed to spread this legendary news to every single girl in the barracks the very second she got a chance...
Up until this morning, most of the female recruits in the territory had quietly worried that Silas was a stoic monk-like Lord who had zero interest in physical intimacy with women.

But seeing that passionate mark on Eluned’s neck proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that Silas was a real man which meant that every single girl in the territory had a genuine, realistic chance of eventually getting bedded by him too.
Silas, completely unaware of the mental chaos occurring in Kadi’s head, walked her over to the kitchen appliances.
"Over here we have the primary cooking station," Silas pointed out, gesturing to the polished steel counters, the large sink, and the mana-infused stone cooktop.
"If you ever want to prepare meals or bake anything, just make sure to consult with Aeli or Kaelia first."
Silas paused, his golden-ringed eyes narrowing into a stern, deadpan stare as he added a serious, firm warning.
"And Kadi...
I am warning you right now.
Do not ever, under any circumstances, attempt to spike or drug anyone’s food or drinks in this Keep.
If you do, you will immediately lose your secretarial position and be sent back to the barracks."
Hearing his sudden out-of-nowhere warning, Kadi tilted her head in genuine confusion.
"Spike your drink, My Lord?" Kadi asked naively, her voice filled with innocent bewilderment.
"Why would I ever do that?
Who on earth would be stupid or unhinged enough to drug your food in your own Keep?!"
Sitting at the marble counter behind them, Eluned’s pale face instantly exploded into a burning red flush.
’I’m not stupid...’

chapters.title: Chapter 283: End Of Tour
paragraphs: The Nature Goddess violently choked on her breath, cutely averting her face toward the kitchen window, desperately pretending to be deeply fascinated by a passing cloud while her ears burned bright crimson.
Before Kadi could notice the Goddess’s mortified reaction, Silas let out a loud hearty laugh, shaking his head.
"Aha... right. Nobody would be that dumb," Silas chuckled drily, giving Kadi’s hand a gentle tug. "Let me show you upstairs."
Silas led Kadi out of the kitchen, taking her toward the grand stone staircase in the central foyer.

"The Keep has five full floors," Silas explained as their boots tapped against the stone steps. "The ground floor holds the main halls, the kitchen, and the primary administrative office. The second and third floors contain the private residential suites for our primary heroes and officers. The fourth floor is the same, and the top floor is my private office."
They reached the second-floor landing, stepping into a wide carpeted corridor lined with heavy oak doors.
"Aeli and Talira’s private rooms are located along this wing," Silas noted, walking her down the hall.
He stopped in front of a wide set of frosted-glass double doors situated near the center of the corridor.

"Before I take you to your personal bedroom," Silas continued, "I should point out that while your private room comes equipped with its own personal washroom... if you ever want the luxury benefits of a high-tier spa bath, the floor’s main bathhouse is located right here."
Silas reached out, casually turning the brass handle, and pushed the double doors open to demonstrate the facility.
"It features a wide magically heated stone tub with continuous steam—"
SWISH... SPLASH!
The double doors swung open wide... revealing a sprawling, luxurious marble bathhouse filled with thick, swirling clouds of warm white steam.
Sitting together inside the wide, sunken stone bathtub, completely submerged in the crystal-clear heated water, were Aeliana and Rowenna.
Both newly evolved S-Rank casters had finished washing off their black physical impurities and were currently laughing happily, playfully splashing warm water at each other’s bare shoulders.
The sudden opening of the doors caused all four people in the room to freeze completely dead in their tracks.
Silas stood in the doorway holding Kadi’s hand.
Inside the steaming bathtub, Aeli and Rowenna froze mid-splash with their wet bare shoulders exposed and their newly expanded curves glistening under the water!
Aeli and Rowenna’s wide eyes locked onto Silas, their pale faces instantly turning ten times redder than a boiling lobster.
"M-MY LOR—" Aeli and Rowenna gasped out in synchronized panicked horror...
SLAM!
Before they could even finish the sentence, Silas’s lightning-fast reflexes kicked in.
He violently slammed the frosted-glass double doors shut with a loud resounding bang, sealing the bathhouse once more.
Silas cleared his throat loudly, adjusting his collar with a remarkably calm unbothered expression on his sharp face.

"Ahem..." Silas coughed smoothly, looking down at the wide-eyed Kadi. "...as I was saying. That is the main bathhouse. If you ever want a proper hot bath with steam, you can use that facility whenever it’s unoccupied."
Kadi stood beside him, her mouth slightly agape, nodding her head repeatedly in speechless shock.
"N-Noted, My Lord..."
Silas turned, walking three paces down the carpeted corridor, stopping before a pristine polished oak door.
He pulled out a brass key, unlocked the latch, and pushed the door open.
"And this..." Silas announced, "...is your room."
Kadi stepped past the threshold with her boots sinking into a soft plush wool rug.

The private suite was beautiful, clean and spacious... featuring a large comfortable double bed with crisp white linen sheets, a dark mahogany writing desk with an leather chair, a tall wardrobe, and a private attached washroom.

On the far wall, a large arched glass window let in brilliant morning sunlight, offering a breathtaking elevated view that overlooked the Keep’s courtyard and the towering magnificent stone structure of the newly built Library.
Kadi stood in the center of the room, her hands clutching her travel bag as she looked around in awe-struck silence.
’My... my own room...?’ Kadi thought, her heart swelling with overwhelming emotion.

She genuinely loved her time sleeping alongside her fellow girls in the barracks... but having a clean, private, and luxurious room all to herself inside the Lord’s Keep was a level of comfort she had never dreamed of possessing.
She appreciated the privacy and respect immensely.
Kadi set her heavy canvas travel bag onto the edge of the mattress, turning around to face Silas with a bright radiant smile.
"I love it, My Lord!" Kadi declared passionately. "I love it so much! I’ll settle my things in right away and prepare myself to serve you as your secretary!"
Silas stepped over to the open window, adjusting the brass latch to let the fresh morning breeze circulate through the room, before turning back to offer her a warm gentle smile.
"How is the view?" Silas asked smoothly.
"It’s breathtaking, My Lord!" Kadi beamed, her cheeks flushing a sweet pink.
Silas walked over, reaching out his broad hand to gently pat her head once more.
"Take as much time as you need to settle in, Kadi. There’s no need to rush yourself. We’ll start your secretarial orientation whenever you’re ready."
Kadi’s face exploded into a bright crimson blush as his calloused hand stroked her soft hair.
’Ahhhh~! My Lord really loves giving headpats...!’ Kadi squealed internally, her toes curling inside her boots.
...However, deep inside her degenerate perverted little mind, a far wilder uninhibited thought immediately reeled to life.

’Though... I’d honestly like it even more if he forcefully pushed my head down to his crotch and thrusted his massive shaft right into my face...!’ Kadi fantasized silently with a dazed smile spreading across her blushing cheeks.
So what if she was a little bit perverted?
She was a young woman in her prime, and her Lord was an impossibly handsome, muscular powerhouse.
Having degenerate fantasies about him was a completely natural reaction!
Silas, completely unaware of the wild explicit scenario playing out in his new secretary’s head, withdrew his hand and stepped toward the doorway.
"I’m going to be stepping out for a little bit to handle some territory errands," Silas informed her warmly. "I’ll see you when I get back."
"Yes, My Lord! Safe travels!" Kadi bowed happily.
Silas stepped out into the carpeted corridor, gently closing her bedroom door behind him.
CLICK!
As Silas walked back down the hallway past the frosted-glass double doors of the main bathhouse, he raised his knuckles and gave the wood two firm polite knocks.
KNOCK! KNOCK!
"Rowenna! Aeli!" Silas called out through the door, his voice echoing clearly. "Hurry up in there! Rowenna, you and I need to head out to meet Lord Sky soon!"
Inside the bathhouse, Rowenna’s flustered voice quickly responded through the door.
"Y-Yes, My Lord! I’ll be out in just a few minutes! I am so sorry for delaying you!"
Silas let out a long quiet sigh with a fond smile touching his lips as he continued walking down the grand staircase toward the Keep’s ground floor.
"Well..." Silas mused softly to himself. "...I have a little bit of time to burn before Rowenna is ready. And I haven’t even had a proper breakfast yet."
Silas adjusted his dark shirt sleeves, his golden-ringed eyes glinting with purpose.
It was time to pay a visit to Kaelia at the Culinary Haven.

Not only did he need a heavy nutrient-rich meal to fuel his Stage 2 Royal Gold Core... but he also needed to drop off the massive crate of rare Central City Spices and high-tier poultry meat he had successfully procured from Lord Sky during their previous trade negotiation.

’Breakfast can wait perhaps, after delivering those spices...’ Silas thought, shaking his head with a quiet chuckle, ’...I need to deliver those rare elemental ores over to Thora at the Warlord Foundry.’
There was far too much work to get done in the Blessed Land today... but Silas was going to execute every single task with uncompromising perfection.
Starting with delivering those legendary Central City spices to his head chef!
Kaelia ran a delicate pale hand through her soft wavy hair, leaning her upper body over the central marble island of the Culinary Haven.
The morning air inside the Keep’s primary kitchen was filled with the comforting scent of roasted grains, dried herbs, and warm spirit-water.

Resting flat on the polished marble counter before her was a thick, leather-bound cookbook... a specialized compilation of authentic Earth recipes and culinary manuals that Silas had gifted her during their early days in the territory.
Kaelia’s bright expressive eyes scanned down page sixty-four, her slender finger tracing the printed text as her dark eyelashes fluttered in deep concentration.
"Hmm..." Kaelia murmured out loud to herself, her soft melodious voice echoing in the quiet kitchen. "What is this ’chicken’ thing actually all about anyway...?"
Ever since Silas had introduced her to the concepts of modern Earth food, Kaelia’s entire world as a chef had been completely turned upside down.

Before coming here, her understanding of cooking had been strictly limited to basic high-tier fantasy rations... roasting wild monster meat, boiling vegetable broths, or seasoning venison with sea salt.
She could make much more amazing dishes of course.
...But the Earth cookbook had revealed a vast mind-boggling ocean of culinary science.
She had learned about the delicate art of seasoning combinations.

Her Lord had previously purchased a small preliminary bundle of refined spices for her, and those handful of imported seasonings had elevated her dishes to such an astronomical standard that the girls literally fought each other in the Mess Hall over seconds.
If she could just get her hands on a larger more diverse variety of authentic Earth spices... her cooking could reach god-tier perfection.
Kaelia turned the page of the cookbook, her thoughts drifting to the current political situation hanging over the Blessed Land.

According to the reports Aeliana and Tasmin had brought back from the buffer zone, the territory was currently gearing up for an official full-scale Lord War against a rival Lord stationed right outside their border.
Kaelia let out a quiet thoughtful breath, leaning her chin on her palm.
’If only...’
She wasn’t a combat unit.
She didn’t possess Morwenna’s terrifying ocean sword styles, Tasmin’s lethal shadow assassination techniques, or Brida’s physical defense.
She was a non-combatant chef.
In a brutal high-stakes military clash involving siege cannons and magic bombardment, Kaelia knew she couldn’t offer any direct physical assistance on the frontlines.
...However, she knew with unshakeable certainty what her role was going to be once the dust settled.
She had to start immediate large-scale preparations for a massive victory feast!
A tiny proud smirk touched Kaelia’s lips as she flipped to the banquet section of her manual.
How was she so impossibly confident that the Blessed Land would emerge victorious?
Why was she already planning a victory celebration before a single arrow had even been fired?
Simple.
Because this was the Blessed Land.
And the Blessed Land had never lost a single battle... Not once...
Some external observer might look at her confidence and claim she was being foolishly arrogant or overly proud.
But Kaelia didn’t care.
She simply possessed an unshakeable faith in the women residing in this territory... and above all, in her Lord, Silas Graves.
Silas and his commanders were far too competent, far too terrifyingly brilliant, and far too powerful to ever be brought down by some random rival Lord who had rolled up out of God knows where.
PAH!
Kaelia raised both of her hands and cutely slapped her own pale cheeks, leaving tiny pink marks on her skin as she snapped herself out of her gloomy thoughts.
"Be confident, Kaelia~!" she cheered softly to herself in an encouraging purr.

The division of labor in this Keep was crystal clear... her Lord and the warriors had to fight and crush their enemies... while her job was to cook the most heavenly food in existence to fuel their bodies and celebrate their triumphs.
Still... a small curious desire flickered deep inside Kaelia’s heart.
’Could I... Could I ask Lord Graves for permission to watch the war from the Watchtower?’ Kaelia thought, she simply wanted to see how they looked.
She immediately shook her head, a soft self-deprecating chuckle escaping her lips as she dismissed the thought.

’No, no, that’s such a stupid thing to ask...’ Kaelia thought, pouting slightly. ’The Watchtower is going to be heavily occupied by Fenna and the archers during active combat. I’d just be standing in the way and getting in their line of fire.’

chapters.title: Chapter 284: A Promise To Kaelia
paragraphs: CREAK!
Just as Kaelia was lost in the middle of her internal debate, the heavy timber double doors of the Culinary Haven smoothly swung open.
Silas stepped into the kitchen.
He was wearing his tailored black trousers and a crisp long-sleeved dark shirt that fit his broad, six-foot-two frame to perfection.
His Gold Core aura radiated a calm effortless authority that immediately filled the room.
Hearing the doors open, Kaelia turned around, her bright eyes lighting up as she immediately bowed her head in a sweet respectful greeting.
"Good morning, Lord Graves!" Kaelia purred softly.
Silas offered her a casual wave of his broad hand as he walked up to the central marble island.
"Morning, Kaelia. You’re looking remarkably cute today."
Kaelia’s breath caught in her throat. Before she could even form a response—
STEP!
Silas closed the remaining distance between them, standing directly in front of her.
He reached out with his broad, calloused right hand, extending his index finger to gently wipe away a small powdery smudge of white baking flour resting against her pale cheek.
His warm skin brushed against hers for two lingering seconds.
An explosion of bright burning red blood rushed straight to Kaelia’s ears.
Her pale cheeks turned as red as a ripe strawberry with her heart hammering against her ribs like a runaway engine.
’W-Wait...!’ Kaelia panicked silently, her hands clutching the edge of the marble island behind her! ’Is... is my Lord being extra flirty with me today?!’
Her body’s reaction was embarrassingly immediate.
Just from the simple, gentle sensation of his warm finger brushing against her cheek, a sudden wave of intense embarrassing heat flooded her lower stomach, making her inner thighs tremble slightly.
’S-Stop...’ Kaelia whimpered in her own mind, her toes curling inside her shoes. ’I’m... I’m already getting wet just from him touching my cheek...’
Silas, completely unaware of the intense reaction occurring inside his head chef, withdrew his hand and turned toward one of the empty stainless steel preparation counters along the wall.
"I managed to secure a shipment of imported trade goods from Lord Sky earlier," Silas explained smoothly. "I remembered you mentioning wanting more seasoning options, so I brought them over for you."
FWOOSH... BOOM!
Silas swiped his hand through the air, activating his spatial inventory!

Two massive heavy wooden crates... bound in reinforced iron straps and stamped with high-tier commercial trade seals materialized out of thin air, landing squarely on top of the stainless steel counter with a heavy, resounding thud!
Kaelia blinked her wide eyes, stepping over to the counter.
"Trade goods...?"
She reached out, carefully lifting the heavy wooden lid of the first crate.
The second the seal broke, an overwhelming intoxicating explosion of rich, complex and heavenly aromas erupted into the kitchen air!

Kaelia’s eyes widened to the size of saucers. Inside the crate were dozens of neatly organized vacuum-sealed glass jars and linen pouches... each clearly labeled with precise names: Paprika, Garlic Powder, Cayenne, Smoked Cumin, Dried Oregano, Rosemary, White Pepper, Black Peppercorns, and Pure Sea Flakes.
She reached down, pulling out the Earth recipe manual from her pocket, and cross-referenced the names on the jars with the formulas in the book.
They were identical...

They were the exact, authentic Earth spices listed throughout every high-tier recipe in the manual... though, thanks to the Sovereign Realm’s mana, these specific variants possessed a slightly elevated aromatic profile that made them ten times more potent than standard Earth seasonings.
"By the stars..." Kaelia gasped out, her voice trembling with pure ecstasy. "Hehehe~"
The volume of possibilities exploded inside her chef’s mind.
With these authentic spices in her kitchen, she could execute proper dry rubs, rich marinade infusions, savory glazes, and complex sauce bases.
She wouldn’t just be feeding the territory... she would be creating food that could physically elevate their morale, restore their core reserves, and drive them into bliss.
In a sudden uncontrollable burst of overwhelming joy and gratitude, Kaelia completely lost her usual timid restraint.
She lunged forward, grabbed Silas’s broad dark shirt collar with both hands, stood on her tiptoes, and slammed her soft plump lips directly onto his cheek.
SMOOCH!
Silas flinched slightly in pleasant surprise, but didn’t pull back.
Kaelia pulled her face back a fraction of an inch with her pale cheeks burning a deep crimson as she realized what she had just done.
Silas let out a low amused male chuckle, looking down at her flustered face with a warm glint in his golden-ringed eyes.
"I take it you like what you see, huh?" Silas teased smoothly, resting his hand casually on his hip.
Kaelia hurriedly let go of his collar, cutely averting her face toward the spice jars while twirling her fingers together in her apron.
"I... I love them, My Lord..." Kaelia stammered out softly, her voice trembling with sweet breathless embarrassment. "Thank you... thank you so much..."
Silas smiled, swiping his hand through the air a second time.
FWOOSH... THUD!
A third significantly larger wooden crate materialized out of his inventory, landing beside the spice boxes with a heavy impact.
Unlike the dry spice crates, this one was lined with magical cooling runes, emitting a faint frosty mist as Silas unlatched the front iron hook.

"Here’s the second part of the delivery," Silas noted, gesturing to the cold crate. "Fresh poultry meat. I brought it over so you could process it. Make sure you cook it properly though... I really don’t want to deal with chicken worms in this Keep."
Kaelia tilted her head, her dark eyebrows pulling together in utter adorable confusion.
"Chicken... worms...?" Kaelia repeated, her mind trying to parse the phrase.
Then, a sudden memory flashed in her mind... she remembered the strange slippery cave worms that Morwenna had brought back from the Basin yesterday.
When roasted over Thora’s forge embers, those cave worms had actually possessed a surprisingly rich savory flavor.
’Is... is that how chicken actually tastes like?’ Kaelia wondered deeply in her own mind, thoroughly fascinated. ’Is chicken just a surface-world version of a cave worm...?’
She looked into the crate, seeing rows of pristine, high-grade, chilled poultry breasts, thighs, and drumsticks.

Regardless of whether it was related to cave worms or not, Kaelia had spent days reading through dozens of legendary chicken recipes in her Earth manual... Fried Chicken, Roasted Herb Chicken, Garlic Butter Glaze, Curry Chicken, and Teriyaki Wings.
She had been dying for an opportunity to test those dishes!
Kaelia instantly straightened her posture, raising her right hand to her forehead in a sharp comical military salute.
"Understood, My Lord!" Kaelia declared enthusiastically, her eyes sparkling with pure fire. "I will immediately begin testing different preparation variations of chicken today!"
Silas chuckled warmly, reaching out to pat her head. "Good. I definitely need some proper chicken in my life right now."
Silas turned, preparing to head toward the kitchen exit...
"Wait... My Lord!" Kaelia called out softly.
Silas paused, turning his head back around. "Yeah? Something else?"
Kaelia stood near the marble island, her hands nervously clutching her apron, her cheeks flushing pink as she summoned every ounce of her courage to voice her quiet request.
"I... I was wondering... when the Lord War officially starts six days from now... would it be possible for me to watch the battle from the territory walls...?"
Silas raised an eyebrow, looking at her in surprise.

"I... I know I’m just a non-combatant chef..." Kaelia mumbled hesitantly, looking down at her shoes. "...and I know I shouldn’t be standing in the Vanguard’s way... but I’m getting a little bit tired of just sitting inside the kitchen while all the other girls go out and fight for you. I want to see you command... I want to watch our territory win with my own eyes..."
Silas looked at her nervous blushing face... and a warm genuine smile spread across his sharp features.
"Is that all?" Silas asked smoothly.
Kaelia blinked, raising her head.

"Sure, you can watch," Silas agreed without a second of hesitation. "I’ll assign one of the archers to stand guard beside you on the ramparts, and I’ll have Thora forge you a set of lightened high-tier defensive armor so you stay completely safe. It’s not a problem at all."
Kaelia’s bright eyes widened in joy.
"R-Really, My Lord?!"
Silas walked back over, leaning down slightly, and placed his broad palm flat against her head, gently stroking her hair with deep genuine appreciation.

"Of course, really," Silas murmured, his voice filled with warmth. "You work ridiculously hard to keep everyone fed and happy around here, Kaelia. Asking to watch a battle from the walls is a tiny request. You’re amazing, you know that?"
The overwhelming impact of his sincere praise, combined with his broad palm gently stroking her hair, caused Kaelia’s brain to completely melt into mush.
"Th-Thank you, My Lord!" Kaelia squeaked out, her face burning redder than a hot forge iron.
Silas offered her one final, warm smile, turned on his heel, and walked out of the Culinary Haven, closing the heavy timber doors behind him.
CLICK!
The moment the kitchen doors clicked shut—
PLOP!
Kaelia’s legs completely gave out beneath her.
The head chef fell flat onto her knees on the soft rug with her hands covering her burning face and her heart hammering so violently against her ribs that she felt dizzy.
"Ahhhhh... I regret it so much..." Kaelia whimpered out loud to the empty kitchen.
She replayed a specific, mortifying memory in her mind... the day Silas had accidentally caught her in his private bedroom, touching herself while fantasizing about him.
On that day, Silas had offered her a choice, but Kaelia had been far too timid, panicked, and embarrassed to accept his touch, fleeing the opportunity like a terrified rabbit.
"I regret it so much..." Kaelia cried out silently in her thoughts with her face burning hot against her palms. "I should have just agreed on that day... I should have let him take me right there..."
Kaelia took three deep ragged breaths, forcefully slapping her cheeks again to compose herself, and pushed herself back up onto her feet.
She looked at the crates of Earth spices and fresh chicken resting on her preparation counter, a fierce devoted determination burning in her bright eyes.
She was going to make sure she became a worthy, indispensable woman for her Lord.
And what was the undisputed shortest path to a man’s heart?
Through his stomach!
Kaelia snatched her leather-bound Earth manual off the marble island, opening the chicken section with a bright and thoroughly passionate smile.
"Hehe~" Kaelia purred happily, her eyes sparkling. "Let’s make some legendary chicken!"
A few minutes later, on the eastern side of the Keep’s inner plaza...
Silas pushed open the heavy, reinforced iron-bound doors leading into the Warlord Foundry.
CREAK... BANG!
The interior of the foundry was hot and filled with the deep rhythmic hum of magical forge fires.
Thick, soot-stained stone pillars held up the vaulted ceiling, and rack after rack of newly forged swords, iron shields, and enchanted armor plating lined the granite walls.
And standing over the primary anvil in the center of the room, hammering away at a glowing slab of raw iron, was Thora.
The Master Dwarf Smith was wearing her leather blacksmith apron, her dark hair tied back in a messy bun and her muscular arms glistening with sweat under the fiery red glow of the hearth.
And as she hammered away, Thora was shamelessly humming a crude degenerate song at the top of her lungs.
"~Oh, two girls in the bed, one Lord in the middle...~" Thora sang out, her deep dwarven voice echoing loudly off the stone rafters. "~One taking his length, while the other plays his fiddle...~"
"~Spank my rear hard, till the forge embers glow...~" Thora continued humming with a cheerful rhythm. "~And fill up my womb till his Gold Core overflows~!"
Silas stood in the doorway, staring at the singing dwarf with a flat thoroughly deadpan expression on his face for three solid seconds.
Silas cleared his throat, his deep male voice echoing over the sound of her hammer.
"Thora. I’m here to deliver your alloy crates."
CLANG!
Thora flinched mid-swing, coming to an immediate halt.
She wiped a bead of sweat from her forehead with her arm, turning her head around to look at him.
Seeing Silas standing in the doorway dressed in his sharp clothes, the dwarf’s dark eyes instantly lit up with a mischievous glint.

"Well, well, look at you, Lord!" Thora cackled boisterously, resting her heavy forge hammer against the anvil. "Looking all sharp and handsome in those high-class trousers! I can clearly see that thick impressive bulge outline pressing against your pants from all the way over here!"
