chapters.title: Chapter 289: Vespera On Stream [III]
paragraphs: On the left video tab, Lohan Sterling adjusted his white silk cuffs, his face twisting into a look of disgust-filled contempt as he stared at Etilga’s feed.

"Have you no shame whatsoever, woman?" Lohan reprimanded sharply, his voice dripping with arrogance. "You are broadcasting your distasteful domestic degeneracy to over one hundred million citizens... You allow yourself to act like a unrefined savage, turning a formal diplomatic conference into a circus!"
Etilga slowly lowered her cigar, her fiery crimson eyes narrowing into razor-sharp slits as she glared at Lohan through the screen.

"Decorum?" Etilga sneered, letting out a sharp venomous laugh. "Coming from a spineless corporate parasite who spends his entire life hiding behind white marble walls? Look at you, Lohan! Calling me a savage while your entire company survives on predatory loans and blood-money mining operations in the outer zones!"
’Huh? Aren’t they supposed to be more chill?’

"I run a legitimate multi-sector financial empire!" Lohan shot back furiously, slamming his manicured fist onto his marble desk! "The Sterling Financial Conglomerate keeps the entire economy of Lord Society running! You are nothing more than a glorified matriarch leading a family of violent, short-fused maniacs..."

"A financial empire?" Etilga scoffed, flicking cigar ash directly onto her husband’s neck. "You’re a glorified loan shark in a white suit! The Bloom Clan’s armaments division single-handedly forged the elemental catalysts that defend the walls! Without our weapons, your precious banks would have been torn apart by monster swarms decades ago!"

"And you charge astronomical extortionate prices for every single blade you forge!" Lohan barked out a harsh mocking laugh. "You squeeze the Council dry with inflated defense contracts! You’re a leech on society, Etilga!"

"And what are you, Lohan?!" Etilga’s voice rose to a terrifying superheated screech, her crimson mana flaring so violently around her chair that the velvet curtains behind her caught fire. "You sit there in your pristine white suit, lecturing me about dignity, while you let your corporate foot soldiers burn down entire outer villages just to clear land for your mining rigs! You hypocritical gold-worshiping bastard!"

"At least my operations generate net infrastructure!" Lohan barked back, leaning close to his camera with his green eyes blazing. "At least I don’t let my spouse crawl around on the floor like a beaten dog... Look at that man beneath your boots! He is a Magistrate of the World Council, and you treat him like dirt! It is a disgrace to the entire male gender!"

"He is MY husband, and he will serve as my chair whenever I damn well please!" Etilga snarled, stomping her heel onto the Magistrate’s back again for emphasis. "If he had a spine, maybe he’d stand up, but he doesn’t! Just like you don’t have the spine to step into a real Unknown Zone without ten thousand mercenary guards protecting your pathetic skin!"

"I don’t need to fight in the dirt because my mind controls trillions of credits." Lohan shouted back, his face flushing red with rage. "You think brute physical force makes you superior? You are an ape holding a glowing sword..."

"I will take my glowing sword and personally shove it down your throat, Lohan!" Etilga shrieked back, her red hair floating in the air as heatwaves distorted her camera feed. "Say one more word about my family, and I will mobilize the entire Bloom Clan fleet to flatten your corporate headquarters into a pile of ash!"

"Try it, you crazy bitch! My automated orbital strike grid will vaporize your fleet before your ships even clear the atmosphere!" Lohan screamed, standing completely up from his leather chair and pointing a finger at her screen!
Beside Vespera, Sky and his streaming drones were completely frozen in place.

Sky took a long, ridiculously nervous sip of his iced juice through his straw with a massive drop of sweat visibly forming on the side of his neck behind his mask as he watched the two titan family heads tear each other apart live on air.
’I thought nobles like this usually had training in this aspect...’

Vespera sat in her leather chair, sweatdropping hard as she watched the two trillion-credit family heads scream at each other live on stream, listing astronomical financial figures, corporate crimes, and ancient grudges just to flex their corporate dicks in front of a hundred million viewers.

The bickering between Lohan Sterling and Etilga Bloom raged on continuously, escalating into a wild unfiltered flurry of personal insults, family grudges, and corporate flexing that left the entire live chat box completely paralyzed with shock.
[User_X99]: WHAT THE ACTUAL FUCK IS HAPPENING RIGHT NOW?!
[Rune_Fanatic]: THEY ARE LITERALLY THREATENING ORBITAL STRIKES ON LIVE STREAM!
[Sovereign_Watcher]: LMAO THE MAGISTRATE IS GETTING STOMPED ON AGAIN!
[Gamer_Tag_44]: THIS IS THE GREATEST STREAM IN HUMAN HISTORY!
[No_Life_Lord]: VESPERA AND SKY ARE JUST SITTING THERE SWEATDROPPING LMAOOO!
After three straight minutes of non-stop blood-curdling screaming, Lohan Sterling finally took a deep ragged breath, smoothing down his white silk jacket with trembling hands.
He offered a sneering arrogant smirk toward Etilga’s feed.

"Say whatever you want about my business, Etilga!" Lohan declared loudly, puffing out his chest with supreme aristocratic pride. "At the end of the day, my legacy is completely secured... At least I have a son! A brilliant, high-tier heir who commands respect across the entire Lord faction."
Etilga stopped puffing her cigar.
She slowly lifted a delicate silk-embroidered fan to the lower half of her face, her crimson eyes narrowing into cold razor-sharp slits as she looked at Lohan through her screen.
"A son?" Etilga sneered softly, her voice dripping with pure icy contempt. "Your son Valerius is nothing more than a fragile gold-plated mistake... no different from the others who walk this Earth."
Etilga lowered her fan slightly, exhaling a long plume of grey smoke as her red eyes gleamed with terrifying maternal pride.
"Unlike my daughter..." Etilga stated with absolute, ringing authority, "...who became a Lord from the moment she was born."
Vespera on the other hand blinked beneath her traveler’s hood, her eyes widening in genuine shock.
’Seraphina awakened from the moment she was born?!’
Beneath her traveler’s hood, Silas’s mind slammed into a wall of pure shock as Etilga Bloom’s ringing declaration echoed through the communication channels.
’...who became a Lord from the moment she was born.’
Silas already knew Seraphina was a remarkably talented woman.
During the time in the Sovereign Realm... from her fiery displays of high-tier pyromancy to her arrogant domineering attitude... she had proven herself to be a powerhouse among the new generation.
’Haah... This is more complicated than I thought.’

She certainly had her own share of glaring personality issues, and Silas honestly hoped that she wasn’t holding some deep vengeful grudge against him for accidentally seeing her completely naked during the Secret Realm expedition...
He had resolved to handle all of that delicate drama through Valerius, as he hoped but hearing her mother speak those words right now still caught him completely off guard.
In the modern era of the Sovereign Realm, there were essentially two recognized types of individuals who awakened Cores.

The vast majority of citizens belonged to the standard awakening system. Silas vividly remembered his own awakening back at the Awakening Pantheon in Valoria City... that colossal structure built of polished white marble and dark obsidian where thousands of nervous eighteen-year-old academy students gathered every year.

Standard Lords had to wait until their bodies reached maturity at eighteen before stepping onto the glowing central altar, allowing the ambient spatial energy of the Sovereign Realm to channel through the stone pillars, stimulate their latent mana pathways, and force a Core... whether Red or any higher core to coalesce within their chests.

However, Silas had never personally met anyone who had awakened a Core at the exact moment of their birth, completely bypassing the need for an altar ritual or the physical maturity required to process the Realm’s raw energy.

To awaken as a full Lord from the second she drew her first breath... that meant Seraphina’s soul and physical vessel had possessed such an absurdly dense mana affinity that the Sovereign Realm’s laws had recognized her instantly upon her entry into the world.
’If that’s true...’ Silas mused in astonishment beneath his hood, ’...then that crazy fire girl isn’t just an arrogant noble prodigy. She’s a monster of nature.’
On the left video feed, Lohan Sterling sat in his pristine white silk suit, his manicured fingers twitching against the armrests of his plush chair.
For the first time since the broadcast had begun, the arrogant head of the Sterling Financial Conglomerate seemed genuinely speechless.
His green eyes flickered with a mixture of annoyance and suppressed humiliation.
He opened his mouth, closed it, and then dismissively waved a gold-cased hand toward the camera feed.

"Hmph," Lohan snorted, forcefully clearing his throat and adjusting his silk cuffs. "I shall ignore that ridiculous, unverified claim for now. We are here to conduct a professional inquiry, not indulge in maternal fantasy."
On the right feed, Etilga Bloom let out a triumphant predatory grin.
She took a slow drag from her slender cigarillo, exhaling a thin stream of blue-grey smoke into her luxurious red-velvet room.
That was the divine beauty of having a peerlessly talented daughter.
Being able to rub her child’s superiority directly into the faces of arrogant, money-obsessed rivals like Lohan Sterling was a feeling sweeter than the finest wine.
Etilga’s crimson eyes shifted away from Lohan’s window and locked directly onto the central stream display... focusing squarely on Vespera sitting in her tailored double-breasted suit beside Sky.
Across the network, millions of viewers were already spamming messages calling Vespera a Hero and a mysterious icon of the New Category.
Etilga wasn’t tuning into this broadcast to verify internet rumors or disprove foolish doubts about the Blessed Land.
She was a master politician and a matriarchal conqueror.
She was here to evaluate this mysterious single-armed Lord, measure her value, and secure an advantage for the Bloom Clan.
Suddenly, Vespera felt a genuine ice-cold chill ripple down her spine.
Beneath her hood, Silas’s Golden Core flickered as his senses flared.
Whatever twisted, scheming thoughts were currently brewing inside that crimson-haired woman’s head... Silas didn’t like it at all.
It felt like being stared down by a hungry apex predator lurking in the tall grass.
Beside Vespera, Lord Sky cleared his throat behind his full-face streaming mask, adjusting his designer sunglasses as he looked at the timer running on his stream interface.

"Alright, folks!" Sky announced, waving his hands cheerfully toward the central floating camera drone. "That brings us right to the five-minute mark for our scheduled co-host segment! I know the chat is going wild, but Warlord Vespera is a very busy sovereign ruler, so we’re going to wrap up this Q-and-A right here—"
"Wait," Lohan Sterling immediately interrupted, his authoritative voice cutting through the broadcast speakers.
The billionaire noble adjusted his posture in his marble office, raising a single finger toward his camera feed.
Though his tone was outwardly polite, it carried the rigid weight of a man accustomed to buying whatever time he desired.

"Lord Sky, the stream has barely commenced," Lohan stated smoothly. "The preliminary banter consumed the entirety of the allotted window... I politely request a few extra minutes to conduct a proper, dignified discussion regarding the Blessed Land’s economic standing."

Sky paused, glancing at his interface, then turned his head toward Vespera. With a sly, theatrical shrug of his shoulders, Sky deliberately shifted the entire weight of the decision onto her shoulders.

"Well, Warlord?" Sky asked cheerfully, his voice amplified for the hundred million viewers watching. "The floor is yours. Do we end the stream here, or do you grant our distinguished guests an extension?"
Vespera’s lips thinned into a tight flat line beneath her hood.
Inside her head, Silas grumbled bitterly.
Sky was a master at manipulating media pressure.
On one hand, Vespera could easily decline the extension, stand up, and ride her Blessed Wolf right back into the forest.
However, on the other hand, she didn’t want to ruin her public reputation at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Vespera On Stream [IV]
paragraphs: Lohan Sterling and Etilga Bloom were not members of the World Council itself, but they were unquestionably two of the most terrifyingly influential figures in high-society politics and global commerce.

It wasn’t that Silas couldn’t afford to offend them if it came down to a physical war... the Blessed Land’s hidden S-Rank and SSS-Rank roster could tear their corporate fleets to shreds but starting an unnecessary feud with two multi-trillion-credit family heads over a five-minute interview was completely foolish.
Vespera let out a quiet controlled breath, leaning her head back against her leather chair.
"Very well," Vespera declared. "I will grant an extension. Five additional minutes. Make them count."
On the left feed, Lohan offered a formal satisfied nod.
"You have my thanks, Lord Vespera. A wise and pragmatic choice..."
On the right feed, Etilga chuckled darkly, tapping the ash from her cigarillo onto her husband’s back.
"A composed and gracious decision, my dear. I appreciate a ruler who knows how to manage public decorum."
Meanwhile, right beside Vespera... Lord Sky was practically vibrating in his seat with sheer joy.
’HOLY SHIT! YES!’ Sky screamed internally, his eyes lighting up behind his streaming mask! ’I’M GETTING A WHOLE LOT OF MONEY FROM THIS!’
The live viewer counter on his display was currently sitting at a staggering 112,000,000 CONCURRENT VIEWERS.
The super-chats, high-tier corporate sponsorships, and stream ad donations were flooding into his account at a rate of millions of credits per second...

At this point, with the sheer volume of viewers he was pulling and the astronomical wealth he was generating just from Vespera sitting in a chair beside him, Sky realized it was definitely time to offer her a generous cut of the stream revenue.
If he offered her a fat fifty-percent split of today’s earnings, maybe she would actually agree to do more co-host streams with him later.
With this kind of viral traction, if Vespera ever decided to open an official social media account in the real world, it was going to completely break the global network.
Offering her a cut right now was like securing a massive, early-stage investment in the most valuable media asset in the Sovereign Realm...
Clearing his throat to maintain his professional host persona, Sky gestured toward the left video feed.
"Alright! Since Lord Sterling requested the extension first, the floor is yours for the first inquiry!"
Lohan Sterling sat up straight in his white silk suit, resting his manicured hands flat on his pristine marble desk.
He cleared his throat, adopting the rehearsed pompous tone of a corporate titan addressing a shareholder meeting.

"Allow me to formally introduce myself to you and your audience, Lord Vespera," Lohan began, puffing out his chest with supreme pride. "I am Lohan Sterling, CEO and Chairman of the Sterling Financial Conglomerate. Under my direct leadership, our family oversees four major global enterprises."
Lohan raised his hand, ticking off his fingers one by one with an insufferable smirk.

"First, Sterling Banking & Capital, which manages over six hundred trillion credits in global assets and provides liquidity for fifty-eight sovereign territories... Second, Sterling Deep-Core Mining & Metallurgy, the primary supplier of refined star-iron and titanium-alloy plates for the World Council’s border ramparts... Third, Sterling Interstellar Logistics & Transport, operating a fleet of forty thousand heavy cargo freighters across the trade routes and fourth, Sterling Energy Matrix, which controls thirty percent of the country’s mana-grid generators."
On the right video window, Etilga Bloom violently rolled her eyes, taking a long exaggerated drag from her cigarillo before blowing a thick cloud of smoke directly toward Lohan’s video tile.
"Nobody asked for your corporate resume, you pompous windbag," Etilga sneered loudly. "Get to the damn question before I fall asleep on my footstool."
Lohan’s jaw twitched with rage, but he forced himself to ignore her, turning his piercing green eyes back toward Vespera.

"Setting financial metrics aside..." Lohan continued, his gaze narrowing as he inspected Vespera’s tailored suit, her dark hood, and her single silver-and-gold gauntlet. "...I must ask for official clarification. Are you truly the Lord of the Blessed Land? Or are you perhaps a female Hero masquerading as a male ruler in exchange for your Lord’s protection?"
Vespera’s golden-ringed eyes narrowed beneath her hood, her lips twitching in sheer disbelief.
Lohan tilted his head, his tone carrying a subtle condescending edge.

"You must understand my skepticism. The rumors surrounding the Blessed Land describe a territory capable of completely obliterating high-tier monster swarms and possibly capable of pushing back regional raiding fleets. Naturally, one would expect the sovereign Lord of such a powerful, aggressive territory to be... significantly manlier."
Vespera almost rolled her eyes right out of her skull beneath her hood.
Inside Silas’s mind, a wave of realization washed over him.
’Fucking hell man... Is he serious?’
It turned out that, unsurprisingly, Lohan Sterling was a backward, arrogant, self-important noble elitist who believed that true power could only belong to pompous men in white suits.

The fact that Lohan was this insufferable made the fact that his son, Valerius Sterling, was actually a relatively chill and easygoing guy who just wanted to hunt treasure in Secret Realms exceedingly surprising.
Valerius must have developed his chill personality specifically as a coping mechanism to avoid becoming like his terrible father...
’And that makes me like the fucker even more.’
Vespera leaned back in her high-backed leather chair, resting her gauntleted right hand over her knee, and replied in a calm steady voice.
"I am a woman," Vespera stated flatly. "And I am indeed the Lord of the Blessed Land, not a proxy Hero standing in for anyone else."
Lohan blinked, his green eyes scanning her composed posture.
"Hmm. Fair enough. I shall accept your word for the public record."
Lohan adjusted his gold cufflinks, leaning forward against his marble desk as his tone dropped into a probing one.

"Then let us address the rumors regarding your Core grade, Lord Vespera. The network chat and regional intelligence boards claim that you possess either a high-grade Purple Core or... a legendary Mythical Gold Core. However, observing your territory from this stream angle, I must express my doubts."
Lohan gestured vaguely toward the Ironwood forest behind Sky’s mobile fortress, offering a patronizing smirk.

"A territory governed by a true Mythical Gold Core Lord typically displays a far more radiant spatial atmosphere... overflowing with dense ambient mana, glowing celestial flora, and access to elite high-tier mythical beasts. Your surroundings appear to be nothing more than a standard damp Ironwood Basin. So tell us... what is your true Core grade?"
’Standard? The fuck... did he even watch the last stream?’
Vespera sat completely still in her chair.
Beneath her dark traveler’s hood, Vespera’s blood began to boil with pure irritation.
With every passing second, it felt like this arrogant white-suited billionaire was looking down his nose at her.

’I literally went through the entire hassle of dressing up in a tailored suit, putting on a gauntlet, riding a Blessed Wolf through the mud, and sitting under floating camera drones for this stream...’ Silas thought furiously, his jaw clenching hard beneath his hood, ’...just for this pompous corporate bastard to sit in his marble room and look down on me?!’
The more Silas thought about it, the more pissed off he became.

He was holding back his territory’s true visual splendor specifically to keep a low profile from the World Council for now... and now this corporate loan shark was using that intentional stealth as an excuse to mock his territory’s standing live in front of one hundred million viewers.
Vespera folded her single gauntleted arm over her chest, her golden-ringed eyes flashing with a cold terrifying glare from beneath the shadows of her hood.

"My Core grade..." Vespera replied, her voice dropping into an icy dangerous frequency that caused the audio sensors on Sky’s drones to static slightly. "...is classified territory intelligence. I refuse to disclose that information to a civilian corporate executive."
Lohan raised a subtle eyebrow, taken aback by the sudden suffocating pressure radiating through his video feed.
He cleared his throat, quickly leaning back into his leather chair to mask his surprise.
"Hmph. Defensive secrecy..." Lohan muttered, adjusting his collar. "A typical response for a ruler attempting to hide a mediocre co—"
"Oh, shut your pathetic arrogant mouth, Lohan!" Etilga Bloom’s voice exploded through the speakers.
On the right video feed, the crimson-haired matriarch took her lit cigarillo out of her mouth, pointing the glowing tip angrily at Lohan’s video window.

"This is no way to talk to a sovereign woman, you pompous white-suited worm." Etilga snarled, her red eyes burning with disgust. "You sit there in your air-conditioned office, questioning her authority and looking down on her territory just because she doesn’t conform to your pathetic corporate standards..."
Vespera offered a small, subtle nod of agreement in her chair.
’For once, the crazy fire lady is actually making sense.’
Etilga turned her gaze toward the central stream display, waving her hand dismissively at Lohan’s video tile.
"Ignore that uncultured idiot, Lord Vespera. He has no respect for true strength."
On the left feed, Lohan’s face flushed bright red with fury.
He slammed both of his hands onto his marble desk, standing up to shout into his camera.
"Etilga! How dare you insult me once again on a public broadcast! I am the head of the Sterling—"
CLICK!
Suddenly, Lohan’s audio feed cut off completely.

On the stream display, Lohan Sterling was still standing up, waving his arms violently, screaming at the top of his lungs, and slamming his hands on his desk in a blind silent rage... but not a single sound was coming out of his window.
A red muted-microphone icon flashed brightly over his video tile.
Vespera blinked beneath her hood, looking at the silent furious billionaire, then turned her head toward Sky in confusion.
Etilga Bloom let out a loud wicked laugh on her feed, blowing a triumphant cloud of cigar smoke into the air.

"Don’t bother looking at your host, my dear," Etilga revealed smoothly, a smug dark smirk stretching across her red lips. "I just bought a sixty-percent controlling majority stake in the media conglomerate that owns this streaming network roughly forty seconds ago. I had my financial team execute the buyout specifically to shut that insufferable bastard up..."
Etilga flicked her cigar ash onto her husband’s back, leaning her elbow on her knee as she smirked at the camera.
"It doesn’t matter how much he screams. His audio channel will remain permanently muted until I say otherwise."
Sitting in her chair, Vespera felt a massive invisible sweatdrop form on the back of her head.
Inside Silas’s mind, a wave of exasperated disbelief washed over him.

’Are these high-society figures even media trained?!’ Silas screamed internally, staring at the screen in horror. ’This is supposed to be a high-level diplomatic interview broadcast to over one hundred million people! Why are two multi-trillion-credit family heads acting like petty teenagers in a gaming lobby?! Where are the mature, sophisticated, and dignified noble representatives you always read about in political web novels?! Why is everyone in this world so utterly insane?!’
Etilga leaned forward in her velvet chair, her crimson eyes scanning Vespera’s suit with an approvingly intrigued expression.

"You see, Lord Vespera?" Etilga said smoothly, her voice surprisingly conversational now that Lohan was silenced. "That pathetic man was looking down on you simply because you are a woman. That is what he always does. He believes men are superior simply because they sit in tall buildings and count paper money."
Etilga took a slow drag from her cigarillo, adding casually.
"Which, by the way, is the exact reason why his own daughter utterly despises his guts, and why his wife cheated on him with three different guards two years ago. He must be bad in bed too."
Vespera’s lips twitched beneath her hood.
’Ouch...’ Vespera thought dryly. ’That is a brutal amount of personal family damage to air out on a public broadcast.’
On the left video feed, the muted Lohan Sterling heard her words through his earpiece.

His green eyes nearly bulged out of his head with rage, his face turning an unhealthy shade of purple as he screamed silently into his camera with his frantic furious audio filtering out into silence.

sentences.text: Lohan Sterling and Etilga Bloom were not members of the World Council itself, but they were unquestionably two of the most terrifyingly influential figures in high-society politics and global commerce.

It wasn’t that Silas couldn’t afford to offend them if it came down to a physical war... the Blessed Land’s hidden S-Rank and SSS-Rank roster could tear their corporate fleets to shreds but starting an unnecessary feud with two multi-trillion-credit family heads over a five-minute interview was completely foolish.
Vespera let out a quiet controlled breath, leaning her head back against her leather chair.
"Very well," Vespera declared.
"I will grant an extension.
Five additional minutes.
Make them count."
On the left feed, Lohan offered a formal satisfied nod.
"You have my thanks, Lord Vespera.
A wise and pragmatic choice..."
On the right feed, Etilga chuckled darkly, tapping the ash from her cigarillo onto her husband’s back.
"A composed and gracious decision, my dear.
I appreciate a ruler who knows how to manage public decorum."
Meanwhile, right beside Vespera...
Lord Sky was practically vibrating in his seat with sheer joy.
’HOLY SHIT!
YES!’ Sky screamed internally, his eyes lighting up behind his streaming mask! ’I’M GETTING A WHOLE LOT OF MONEY FROM THIS!’
The live viewer counter on his display was currently sitting at a staggering 112,000,000 CONCURRENT VIEWERS.
The super-chats, high-tier corporate sponsorships, and stream ad donations were flooding into his account at a rate of millions of credits per second...

At this point, with the sheer volume of viewers he was pulling and the astronomical wealth he was generating just from Vespera sitting in a chair beside him, Sky realized it was definitely time to offer her a generous cut of the stream revenue.
If he offered her a fat fifty-percent split of today’s earnings, maybe she would actually agree to do more co-host streams with him later.
With this kind of viral traction, if Vespera ever decided to open an official social media account in the real world, it was going to completely break the global network.
Offering her a cut right now was like securing a massive, early-stage investment in the most valuable media asset in the Sovereign Realm...
Clearing his throat to maintain his professional host persona, Sky gestured toward the left video feed.
"Alright!
Since Lord Sterling requested the extension first, the floor is yours for the first inquiry!"
Lohan Sterling sat up straight in his white silk suit, resting his manicured hands flat on his pristine marble desk.
He cleared his throat, adopting the rehearsed pompous tone of a corporate titan addressing a shareholder meeting.
"Allow me to formally introduce myself to you and your audience, Lord Vespera," Lohan began, puffing out his chest with supreme pride.
"I am Lohan Sterling, CEO and Chairman of the Sterling Financial Conglomerate.
Under my direct leadership, our family oversees four major global enterprises."
Lohan raised his hand, ticking off his fingers one by one with an insufferable smirk.
"First, Sterling Banking & Capital, which manages over six hundred trillion credits in global assets and provides liquidity for fifty-eight sovereign territories...
Second, Sterling Deep-Core Mining & Metallurgy, the primary supplier of refined star-iron and titanium-alloy plates for the World Council’s border ramparts...

Third, Sterling Interstellar Logistics & Transport, operating a fleet of forty thousand heavy cargo freighters across the trade routes and fourth, Sterling Energy Matrix, which controls thirty percent of the country’s mana-grid generators."
On the right video window, Etilga Bloom violently rolled her eyes, taking a long exaggerated drag from her cigarillo before blowing a thick cloud of smoke directly toward Lohan’s video tile.
"Nobody asked for your corporate resume, you pompous windbag," Etilga sneered loudly.
"Get to the damn question before I fall asleep on my footstool."
Lohan’s jaw twitched with rage, but he forced himself to ignore her, turning his piercing green eyes back toward Vespera.
"Setting financial metrics aside..." Lohan continued, his gaze narrowing as he inspected Vespera’s tailored suit, her dark hood, and her single silver-and-gold gauntlet.
"...I must ask for official clarification.
Are you truly the Lord of the Blessed Land?
Or are you perhaps a female Hero masquerading as a male ruler in exchange for your Lord’s protection?"
Vespera’s golden-ringed eyes narrowed beneath her hood, her lips twitching in sheer disbelief.
Lohan tilted his head, his tone carrying a subtle condescending edge.
"You must understand my skepticism.
The rumors surrounding the Blessed Land describe a territory capable of completely obliterating high-tier monster swarms and possibly capable of pushing back regional raiding fleets.
Naturally, one would expect the sovereign Lord of such a powerful, aggressive territory to be... significantly manlier."
Vespera almost rolled her eyes right out of her skull beneath her hood.
Inside Silas’s mind, a wave of realization washed over him.
’Fucking hell man...
Is he serious?’
It turned out that, unsurprisingly, Lohan Sterling was a backward, arrogant, self-important noble elitist who believed that true power could only belong to pompous men in white suits.

The fact that Lohan was this insufferable made the fact that his son, Valerius Sterling, was actually a relatively chill and easygoing guy who just wanted to hunt treasure in Secret Realms exceedingly surprising.
Valerius must have developed his chill personality specifically as a coping mechanism to avoid becoming like his terrible father...
’And that makes me like the fucker even more.’
Vespera leaned back in her high-backed leather chair, resting her gauntleted right hand over her knee, and replied in a calm steady voice.
"I am a woman," Vespera stated flatly.
"And I am indeed the Lord of the Blessed Land, not a proxy Hero standing in for anyone else."
Lohan blinked, his green eyes scanning her composed posture.
"Hmm.
Fair enough.
I shall accept your word for the public record."
Lohan adjusted his gold cufflinks, leaning forward against his marble desk as his tone dropped into a probing one.
"Then let us address the rumors regarding your Core grade, Lord Vespera.
The network chat and regional intelligence boards claim that you possess either a high-grade Purple Core or... a legendary Mythical Gold Core.
However, observing your territory from this stream angle, I must express my doubts."
Lohan gestured vaguely toward the Ironwood forest behind Sky’s mobile fortress, offering a patronizing smirk.

"A territory governed by a true Mythical Gold Core Lord typically displays a far more radiant spatial atmosphere... overflowing with dense ambient mana, glowing celestial flora, and access to elite high-tier mythical beasts.
Your surroundings appear to be nothing more than a standard damp Ironwood Basin.
So tell us... what is your true Core grade?"
’Standard?
The fuck... did he even watch the last stream?’
Vespera sat completely still in her chair.
Beneath her dark traveler’s hood, Vespera’s blood began to boil with pure irritation.
With every passing second, it felt like this arrogant white-suited billionaire was looking down his nose at her.

’I literally went through the entire hassle of dressing up in a tailored suit, putting on a gauntlet, riding a Blessed Wolf through the mud, and sitting under floating camera drones for this stream...’ Silas thought furiously, his jaw clenching hard beneath his hood, ’...just for this pompous corporate bastard to sit in his marble room and look down on me?!’

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Vespera On Stream [V]
paragraphs: Etilga completely ignored Lohan’s silent temper tantrum, focusing her full captivating attention on Vespera.
She studied Vespera’s athletic frame, her broad shoulders in her double-breasted suit, her calm demeanor and the effortless unshakeable aura radiating from her posture.

"I must say, Lord Vespera..." Etilga mused, a soft approving smile touching her lips, "...you seem to be an extraordinarily strong, composed, and independent woman. You govern an elite territory, command respect without raising your voice, and carry yourself like true nobility."
Etilga tilted her head, her red eyes sparkling with a strange sudden curiosity.

"Tell me... is your mother perhaps a hidden member of our Bloom Clan? We possess several distant matriarchal branches scattered across the outer territories. If you carry our bloodline, we wouldn’t mind officially recognizing your heritage and taking you into our main house."
Vespera shook her head calmly, declining the offer without hesitation.
"No," Vespera answered smoothly with her voice sounding flat. "My mother was not a member of the Bloom Clan. Honestly... my mom died before I was even born."
Etilga’s crimson eyes softened slightly, a rare expression of genuine dignified sympathy flickering across her sharp face.
"Ah..." Etilga murmured softly, lowering her cigarillo. "I see. You have my deepest condolences, my dear. To carry the weight of a territory without maternal guidance is no easy feat."
Etilga paused, adjusting her posture in her chair.
She took another slow puff from her cigarillo, leaning forward toward her camera lens, her eyes narrowing into an intensely focused sharp gaze.
"Tell me, Lord Vespera..." Etilga asked smoothly, her voice dropping into a low, intriguing register, "...what do you think of men?"
Vespera blinked beneath her dark hood, taken aback by the sudden bizarre turn in the conversation.
"Men?" Vespera replied cautiously, raising her single gauntleted hand. "Well... I believe men are go—"
"Men are stepping stones!" Etilga instantly cut her off, her voice ringing with unyielding conviction.
Etilga slammed her booted heel down onto the World Council Magistrate crawling beneath her chair, delivering another firm, authoritative stomp to his back for emphasis.

"Men exist for one singular, divine purpose..." Etilga declared passionately with her red mana flaring around her room. "They exist to provide raw martial utility, perform heavy manual labor, and elevate the sacred bloodline of great women! That is the fundamental law of nature! That is the sole reason why I am still married to this pathetic bastard under my boots."
Below her, the high-ranking World Council Magistrate let out a muffled, defeated groan, burying his face deeper into the velvet carpet.
Sitting in her chair, Vespera sweatdropped hard beneath her hood.
’You know that guy is an active member of the World Council, right?!’ Silas screamed in his own head, staring at the poor Magistrate getting used as a human footstool live on camera.
Then again... as Silas quickly remembered the political structure of Lord Society, did it even matter?
Etilga’s older sister was a high-ranking Arch-Magistrate on the World Council tribunal itself.
In truth, Etilga marrying this specific Council Magistrate years ago had been a purely calculated political move to secure legislative immunity and advance her personal family gains.
’But still he can leave right...? The pussy can’t be that good.’
On her feed, Etilga took another drag from her cigarillo, exhaling a thin ring of smoke as her gaze locked onto Vespera with an unsettling intensity.
"Which brings me to my next question, Lord Vespera..." Etilga continued smoothly, a dark secretive smirk spreading across her face. "...how do you feel about marriage?"
Vespera blinked twice beneath her traveler’s hood, completely stunned.
"Marriage?" Vespera repeated, her deep voice carrying a rare note of utter bewilderment.
Why on earth was marriage being brought up right now?!

They were supposed to be conducting a formal territory interview regarding construction and political recognition, and suddenly this crazy matriarch was asking about her personal marital status live in front of over one hundred million viewers.
Seeing Vespera’s thoroughly confused, speech-deprived expression, Etilga threw her head back and let out a rich melodic laugh.

"Oh, don’t look so alarmed, my dear!" Etilga chuckled playfully, waving her hand. "You aren’t getting married to a man! Perish the thought! As a strong independent woman of your caliber, taking a pathetic man as a spouse would only dilute your authority!"
Etilga leaned close to her camera feed, her red eyes gleaming with wild ambitious excitement.
"You... are going to get married to my oldest daughter! My heir!"
’Huh?’
Vespera sat completely frozen in her leather chair, her brain halting entirely.
Etilga clapped her manicured hands together, continuing with immense enthusiasm.

"Yes! It is the perfect arrangement! My oldest daughter is a prodigy, but she is currently being blinded by a foolish temporary infatuation! She claims she likes some ordinary slum boy and wants to marry him since he saw her naked."
Etilga offered a cold, dismissive sneer, flicking her cigar ash dismissively.

"Naturally, I am going to personally get rid of that useless guy she likes and wants to marry. Once he is permanently erased from the picture, my daughter will need a proper partner to lead the Bloom Clan into the next era!"
Beside her, Vespera let out a dry nervous chuckle, a mountain-sized sweatdrop virtually dripping down her forehead beneath her dark traveler’s hood.
’Get rid of the guy she likes and wants to marry... That saw her naked?!’ Silas screamed in utter horror within his soul.
Wait a second! The guy that saw her naked... WAS HIM! IT WAS SILAS GRAVES!

This crazy crimson-haired mother was literally sitting on a live stream, in front of over one hundred million citizens, openly plotting to murder him so that her daughter could marry VESPERA... WHO WAS ALSO SILAS GRAVES IN DISGUISE?
’IS THIS WOMAN SERIOUS?!’ Silas panicked internally. ’SHE WANTS TO KILL ME SO THAT MY FEMALE DISGUISE CAN MARRY MYSELF?! WHAT KIND OF TWISTED PARADOXICAL HORROR MOVIE IS THIS?!’
He was right to complain and over-exaggarate... After all, this came too suddenly.
On the stream feed, Etilga clapped her hands together with immense delight, completely unaware of the mental breakdown happening inside Vespera’s head.

"So! What about it, Lord Vespera?" Etilga asked eagerly, her eyes shining with ambition. "Marrying my oldest daughter, merging our territorial resources, and keeping the sacred matriarchal bloodline pure! As the independent, powerful woman that you are, I am entirely certain you descend from an ancient offshoot of our bloodline anyway! So now, all that remains is to finalize the formal betrothal contract—"
"I refuse," Vespera interrupted firmly, raising her single gauntleted hand in a sharp, absolute gesture!
Etilga froze mid-sentence, her red eyes widening in genuine surprise. "Eh...?"
Vespera slowly lowered her hooded head, resting her hand face-first against her lap as a long sigh escaped her lips.
Inside Silas’s soul, a single agonizing thought repeated over and over in pure, deadpan exhaustion.
’Why the fuck did I even agree to do this stream in the first place?!’
The live stream broadcast finally came to a grinding merciful halt.

When the three floating silver camera drones finally powered down their glowing blue LED lenses and hovered back up toward the upper hull of The Unmovable Wall, Vespera collapsed backward into her high-backed leather chair, letting out a long and thoroughly exhausted sigh that rattled her chest.
She looked drained.
Her shoulders, usually broad and unyielding beneath her charcoal-black tailored suit jacket, slumped against the leather padding.
Beneath her dark traveler’s hood, Vespera felt as if her very soul had been dragged through a meat grinder.
Beside her, Lord Sky turned his head, his full-face streaming mask reflecting the morning light while his dark designer sunglasses rested awkwardly over his eye-lenses.
Even behind his mask, he could see the overwhelming fatigue radiating from her frame.
"Man..." Sky muttered, shaking his head as he unclipped his comm-transceiver. "You look like you just survived a Tier 6 dungeon raid."
It was supposed to be a quick five-minute co-host segment. Five minutes of easy banter to hype up the network before their official territory war next week...
Instead, the stream had stretched into a grueling, twenty-minute geopolitical nightmare.

Over two hundred and fifty million concurrent viewers had tuned into the broadcast, watching live as Lohan Sterling who had managed to frantically buy back enough corporate shares on the open market to unblock his muted microphone and Etilga Bloom engaged in a ruthless, verbal tug-of-war over Vespera.

One of them had tried to pressure her into bringing the Blessed Land into his global corporate guild network, while the other had tried to force her into a matriarchal betrothal contract to marry her daughter and merge family bloodlines.
Sky stood up from his chair, placing a heavy sympathetic hand on Vespera’s suit-clad shoulder.
"Are you hanging in there, Vespera?" Sky asked softly, his voice dropping its hyperactive streaming tone for a moment.
Vespera didn’t even bother looking up. A sigh escaped her lips beneath her hood.
"I am not okay," Vespera replied, her smooth voice flat and completely devoid of life. "Not in the slightest."
Sky let out a loud, jovial laugh, waving his gloved hand dismissively as he stepped around the folding table.

"Now you see why I avoid face-to-face meetups with high-society nobles like the plague!" Sky declared cheerfully, leaning against an Ironwood trunk. "They are an exhausting, self-important, and utterly unhinged breed of people! Give them five minutes of camera time, and they’ll try to buy your soul, restructure your debt, and marry off your entire family!"
Beneath her hood, Silas’s golden-ringed eyes narrowed into razor-sharp, murderous slits.
He stared up at Sky with an expression that looked like she wanted to slaughter his entire ancestral bloodline.
’You two-faced fucker...’ Silas cursed viciously in his internal thoughts.
Wasn’t Sky the exact snake who had put her up to this Q-and-A in the first place?!

He had literally baited her into sitting in that chair under the guise of a "simple, harmless five-minute stream" fully aware that high-tier family heads were waiting in the private lobby to ambush her.
Sky was nothing more than a calculating view-hungry snake in the grand scheme of things, leveraging every second of her presence to line his own pockets.
As if sensing the suffocating aura beginning to leak from Vespera’s frame, Sky cleared his throat behind his mask, quickly raising his hands in a placating gesture.

"Look, look! I know that got a little out of hand," Sky admitted smoothly, stepping closer. "So, considering how ridiculously well my stream performed... and how much raw engagement we generated. I was thinking... I should probably compensate you for your trouble."
Vespera’s head snapped up instantly.
The exhaustion in her aura vanished, replaced by the sharp focus of a hardened Lord.
"Compensate me?" Vespera repeated, leaning forward in her chair. "How?"
Sky smirked behind his mask, folding his arms over his bright Hawaiian print shirt.

"Well, my personal channel just pulled in millions of credits in direct ad revenue, super-chats, and high-tier sponsorships during those twenty minutes," Sky explained, gesturing toward the mobile fortress. "I was thinking I’d give you a nice, generous twenty percent cut of the broadcast profits as a gesture of goodwill."
"Sixty-fourty," Vespera countered immediately, her deep voice dropping into an unyielding tone.
20? For all that work? What was he... A slave?
Sky nearly choked on his breath.
"Sixty-fourty?! Are you insane, Vespera?! It’s my channel! My equipment! My network servers!"

"And it was my face, my reputation, and my sanity that got dragged through the dirt in front of two hundred and fifty million people." Vespera argued sharply, leaning back and crossing her single gauntleted arm over her chest. "You used my presence to pull in the heads of the Bloom and Sterling families. Without me in that chair, you would have been streaming to your audience. Sixty percent goes to the Blessed Land, forty stays with you."
’Wow... Harsh.’
"Fifty-fifty!" Sky tried to bargain, sweating beneath his mask. "That’s my final offer! Half the ad revenue!"

"Sixty-fourty," Vespera repeated calmly, her gaze locked onto his mask like an unshakeable iron wall. "Or I issue a public statement on the global forums declaring that The Unmovable Wall ambushes guest co-hosts with predatory corporate contracts. Let’s see what that does to your viewer retention during next week’s war."

On her feed, Etilga took another drag from her cigarillo, exhaling a thin ring of smoke as her gaze locked onto Vespera with an unsettling intensity.
"Which brings me to my next question, Lord Vespera..." Etilga continued smoothly, a dark secretive smirk spreading across her face.
"...how do you feel about marriage?"
Vespera blinked twice beneath her traveler’s hood, completely stunned.
"Marriage?" Vespera repeated, her deep voice carrying a rare note of utter bewilderment.
Why on earth was marriage being brought up right now?!

They were supposed to be conducting a formal territory interview regarding construction and political recognition, and suddenly this crazy matriarch was asking about her personal marital status live in front of over one hundred million viewers.
Seeing Vespera’s thoroughly confused, speech-deprived expression, Etilga threw her head back and let out a rich melodic laugh.
"Oh, don’t look so alarmed, my dear!" Etilga chuckled playfully, waving her hand.
"You aren’t getting married to a man!
Perish the thought!
As a strong independent woman of your caliber, taking a pathetic man as a spouse would only dilute your authority!"
Etilga leaned close to her camera feed, her red eyes gleaming with wild ambitious excitement.
"You... are going to get married to my oldest daughter!
My heir!"
’Huh?’
Vespera sat completely frozen in her leather chair, her brain halting entirely.
Etilga clapped her manicured hands together, continuing with immense enthusiasm.
"Yes!
It is the perfect arrangement!
My oldest daughter is a prodigy, but she is currently being blinded by a foolish temporary infatuation!
She claims she likes some ordinary slum boy and wants to marry him since he saw her naked."
Etilga offered a cold, dismissive sneer, flicking her cigar ash dismissively.
"Naturally, I am going to personally get rid of that useless guy she likes and wants to marry.
Once he is permanently erased from the picture, my daughter will need a proper partner to lead the Bloom Clan into the next era!"
Beside her, Vespera let out a dry nervous chuckle, a mountain-sized sweatdrop virtually dripping down her forehead beneath her dark traveler’s hood.
’Get rid of the guy she likes and wants to marry...
That saw her naked?!’ Silas screamed in utter horror within his soul.
Wait a second!
The guy that saw her naked...
WAS HIM!
IT WAS SILAS GRAVES!
This crazy crimson-haired mother was literally sitting on a live stream, in front of over one hundred million citizens, openly plotting to murder him so that her daughter could marry VESPERA...
WHO WAS ALSO SILAS GRAVES IN DISGUISE?
’IS THIS WOMAN SERIOUS?!’ Silas panicked internally. ’SHE WANTS TO KILL ME SO THAT MY FEMALE DISGUISE CAN MARRY MYSELF?!
WHAT KIND OF TWISTED PARADOXICAL HORROR MOVIE IS THIS?!’
He was right to complain and over-exaggarate...
After all, this came too suddenly.
On the stream feed, Etilga clapped her hands together with immense delight, completely unaware of the mental breakdown happening inside Vespera’s head.
"So!
What about it, Lord Vespera?" Etilga asked eagerly, her eyes shining with ambition.
"Marrying my oldest daughter, merging our territorial resources, and keeping the sacred matriarchal bloodline pure!
As the independent, powerful woman that you are, I am entirely certain you descend from an ancient offshoot of our bloodline anyway!
So now, all that remains is to finalize the formal betrothal contract—"
"I refuse," Vespera interrupted firmly, raising her single gauntleted hand in a sharp, absolute gesture!
Etilga froze mid-sentence, her red eyes widening in genuine surprise.
Vespera slowly lowered her hooded head, resting her hand face-first against her lap as a long sigh escaped her lips.
Inside Silas’s soul, a single agonizing thought repeated over and over in pure, deadpan exhaustion.
’Why the fuck did I even agree to do this stream in the first place?!’
The live stream broadcast finally came to a grinding merciful halt.

When the three floating silver camera drones finally powered down their glowing blue LED lenses and hovered back up toward the upper hull of The Unmovable Wall, Vespera collapsed backward into her high-backed leather chair, letting out a long and thoroughly exhausted sigh that rattled her chest.
She looked drained.
Her shoulders, usually broad and unyielding beneath her charcoal-black tailored suit jacket, slumped against the leather padding.
Beneath her dark traveler’s hood, Vespera felt as if her very soul had been dragged through a meat grinder.
Beside her, Lord Sky turned his head, his full-face streaming mask reflecting the morning light while his dark designer sunglasses rested awkwardly over his eye-lenses.
Even behind his mask, he could see the overwhelming fatigue radiating from her frame.
"Man..." Sky muttered, shaking his head as he unclipped his comm-transceiver.
"You look like you just survived a Tier 6 dungeon raid."
It was supposed to be a quick five-minute co-host segment.
Five minutes of easy banter to hype up the network before their official territory war next week...
Instead, the stream had stretched into a grueling, twenty-minute geopolitical nightmare.

Over two hundred and fifty million concurrent viewers had tuned into the broadcast, watching live as Lohan Sterling who had managed to frantically buy back enough corporate shares on the open market to unblock his muted microphone and Etilga Bloom engaged in a ruthless, verbal tug-of-war over Vespera.

One of them had tried to pressure her into bringing the Blessed Land into his global corporate guild network, while the other had tried to force her into a matriarchal betrothal contract to marry her daughter and merge family bloodlines.
Sky stood up from his chair, placing a heavy sympathetic hand on Vespera’s suit-clad shoulder.
"Are you hanging in there, Vespera?" Sky asked softly, his voice dropping its hyperactive streaming tone for a moment.
Vespera didn’t even bother looking up.
A sigh escaped her lips beneath her hood.
"I am not okay," Vespera replied, her smooth voice flat and completely devoid of life.
"Not in the slightest."
Sky let out a loud, jovial laugh, waving his gloved hand dismissively as he stepped around the folding table.
"Now you see why I avoid face-to-face meetups with high-society nobles like the plague!" Sky declared cheerfully, leaning against an Ironwood trunk.
"They are an exhausting, self-important, and utterly unhinged breed of people!
Give them five minutes of camera time, and they’ll try to buy your soul, restructure your debt, and marry off your entire family!"
Beneath her hood, Silas’s golden-ringed eyes narrowed into razor-sharp, murderous slits.
He stared up at Sky with an expression that looked like she wanted to slaughter his entire ancestral bloodline.
’You two-faced fucker...’ Silas cursed viciously in his internal thoughts.
Wasn’t Sky the exact snake who had put her up to this Q-and-A in the first place?!

He had literally baited her into sitting in that chair under the guise of a "simple, harmless five-minute stream" fully aware that high-tier family heads were waiting in the private lobby to ambush her.
Sky was nothing more than a calculating view-hungry snake in the grand scheme of things, leveraging every second of her presence to line his own pockets.
As if sensing the suffocating aura beginning to leak from Vespera’s frame, Sky cleared his throat behind his mask, quickly raising his hands in a placating gesture.
"Look, look!
I know that got a little out of hand," Sky admitted smoothly, stepping closer.
"So, considering how ridiculously well my stream performed... and how much raw engagement we generated.
I was thinking...
I should probably compensate you for your trouble."
Vespera’s head snapped up instantly.
The exhaustion in her aura vanished, replaced by the sharp focus of a hardened Lord.
"Compensate me?" Vespera repeated, leaning forward in her chair.
"How?"
Sky smirked behind his mask, folding his arms over his bright Hawaiian print shirt.

"Well, my personal channel just pulled in millions of credits in direct ad revenue, super-chats, and high-tier sponsorships during those twenty minutes," Sky explained, gesturing toward the mobile fortress.
"I was thinking I’d give you a nice, generous twenty percent cut of the broadcast profits as a gesture of goodwill."
"Sixty-fourty," Vespera countered immediately, her deep voice dropping into an unyielding tone.
For all that work?
What was he...
A slave?
Sky nearly choked on his breath.
"Sixty-fourty?!
Are you insane, Vespera?!
It’s my channel!
My equipment!
My network servers!"

"And it was my face, my reputation, and my sanity that got dragged through the dirt in front of two hundred and fifty million people." Vespera argued sharply, leaning back and crossing her single gauntleted arm over her chest.
"You used my presence to pull in the heads of the Bloom and Sterling families.
Without me in that chair, you would have been streaming to your audience.
Sixty percent goes to the Blessed Land, forty stays with you."
’Wow...
Harsh.’
"Fifty-fifty!" Sky tried to bargain, sweating beneath his mask.
"That’s my final offer!
Half the ad revenue!"
"Sixty-fourty," Vespera repeated calmly, her gaze locked onto his mask like an unshakeable iron wall.
"Or I issue a public statement on the global forums declaring that The Unmovable Wall ambushes guest co-hosts with predatory corporate contracts.
Let’s see what that does to your viewer retention during next week’s war."

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Vespera’s Reward
paragraphs: Sky stared at her in total shock.
For ten agonizing seconds, the neutral clearing was completely silent. Sky’s shoulders slumped in utter defeat.
He knew she wasn’t bluffing.
In the streaming industry, a single public reputation hit from a high-profile Lord could tank his sponsorship deals for months.
"Fine! Sixty-fourty!" Sky groaned, throwing his hands up in the air. "You’re a terrifying negotiator, Vespera! An extortionist! That’s what you are..."

In truth, Sky was willing to eat the loss on the direct stream ad revenue because the real astronomical bags were made afterward... through the recorded LordTube highlight clips, short-form viral edits, and exclusive Itraeon membership subscriptions that would generate multiple of millions of credits over the coming months.
Sky unclipped a digital data-pad from his belt, tapping the screen.
"Give me your official real-world account details after we finish the Lord War, and I’ll wire your sixty percent share straight over."
"Deal," Vespera agreed smoothly.
They stepped forward and shook on it... Vespera’s heavy silver-and-gold gauntlet gripping Sky’s gloved palm in a firm binding handshake.
With the financial agreement finalized, Vespera stood up from her high-backed leather chair with her frame swaying slightly as the lingering mental exhaustion hit her again.
STEP! STEP!
From the sidelines near the Blessed Wolf mounts, Rowenna arrived at her Lord’s side in an instant.
The Grand Runemaster moved with effortless grace, her long violet-tinted hair shifting gently in the morning breeze.
The moment Rowenna stepped beside her, Vespera didn’t even hesitate.
She leaned her frame sideways, resting her heavy hooded head directly against the soft side of Rowenna’s body, letting out a quiet tired sigh.
"I just want to have a bit of a rest..." Vespera muttered, her voice muffled against Rowenna’s robes.
Rowenna’s blue eyes filled with immense warmth and tender devotion.
She carefully reached up with her slender, manicured hand, gently running her fingers through her Lord’s dark hair beneath the hood, cradling her head against her waist.
"Rest as much as you need, My Lord..." Rowenna whispered sweetly with her voice soft and soothing. "You did wonderfully out there."
In her comforting haze, Rowenna’s words went completely unnoticed by Sky, who was busy reviewing his data-pad inventory logs.
Sky clicked off his screen, turning back toward them with a wide energetic grin.

"Alright, Vespera! Follow me!" Sky called out, gesturing toward a heavy cargo ramp extending from the side of his mobile fortress. "Since you were a champ during the broadcast, I’m going to throw in some extra units of the Obsidian-Slate Stone! Consider it a bonus for dealing with those crazy nobles..."
Vespera lifted her head from Rowenna’s side, adjusting her coat collar as she stepped forward.
"Extra units? How much are we talking about?"
Sky paused near the ramp, tilting his head.
"Well, first of all... do you actually know what raw, unrefined Obsidian-Slate Stone looks like in person?"
Vespera blinked beneath her hood, offering a straightforward answer.
"No. I’ve only seen the blueprint requirements on my system interface."
Sky smiled broadly behind his mask, waving his hand for them to follow.
"Come on inside. Let me show you."
Vespera and Rowenna followed the streaming Lord up the metallic cargo ramp and into the lower industrial holds of The Unmovable Wall.
The interior of the mobile fortress was a marvel of modern engineering... massive steel girders, automated overhead cranes, and rows of reinforced containment vaults lined the multi-tiered floor.

Deep within the central material storage bay, two specialized dwarven architects wearing heavy leather aprons and safety goggles were hard at work, standing over a floating holographic blueprint table as they attempted to calculate structural load capacities for an upcoming fort expansion.
Hearing footsteps, the two architects turned, immediately bowing respectfully toward Sky and Vespera.
"Lord Sky! Warlord Vespera!" the head architect greeted gruffly.
"At ease, boys," Sky replied casually. "Pull up a primary sample crate of the high-density Obsidian-Slate Stone we hauled from the deep quarry veins."
"Right away, sir!"
One of the architects stepped over to a heavy, reinforced steel container, punching an access code into the digital keypad.
PFT-SHHH!
Pressurized steam vented from the container hinges as the heavy lid slid open.
The dwarf reached inside using insulated leather gloves, lifting out a heavy, dark rectangular stone block roughly the size of a chest piece, and handed it over to Sky.
Sky caught the stone block, turning toward Vespera.
The material was breathtaking.
It was a dense pitch-black slate stone with an impossibly smooth, obsidian-like sheen that seemed to absorb the ambient light of the storage bay.

"This is unrefined, Tier 2 Obsidian-Slate Stone," Sky explained, holding it up for her to see. "It’s virtually immune to standard fire magic of the same level, possesses an absurdly high physical impact threshold, and holds enchantment runes better than standard granite."
Sky then offered a confident smirk beneath his mask. "And check out this unique property."
Sky raised his gloved hand and sharply tapped his knuckle against the center of the dark stone block.
PING!
The moment his knuckle struck the surface, a soft ethereal wave of lighter purple energy rippled outward from the impact point.
The violet pulse traveled across the smooth face of the black slate like a liquid stone wave before slowly fading back into the deep obsidian finish... It looked really cool like a shockwave forming.

"Pretty cool, right?" Sky grinned, turning the glowing stone block in his hand. "When kinetic or magical pressure hits the stone, it disperses the force along internal mana veins, creating that purple resonance glow... It makes walls look incredible at night."
Vespera stared at the block, offering a calm composed response.
"Wow. That’s quite impressive, Sky."
...However, deep inside Silas’s mind, he couldn’t give a single flying fuck about how cool the stone looked.

’So what if it glows purple when you tap it?!’ Silas complained in his internal thought. ’Where are my actual units?! I don’t care about a magic trick... I have an entire residential quarters to construct, perimeter walls to reinforce, and a territory to return to! Just hand over the stone so I can leave this place!’
Sky chuckled, clearly enjoying her calm demeanor.
He tucked the sample stone block under his left arm, stepping up directly in front of her.

"I promised you two thousand units, Vespera..." Sky stated smoothly, his eyes glinting behind his mask, "...but because you endured that insane twenty-minute interview, I’m doubling it. I’m handing over four thousand units of Obsidian-Slate Stone."
Vespera’s golden-ringed eyes widened slightly beneath her hood.
Four thousand units!

That was a massive astronomical surplus of high-density construction material! With four thousand units, she could build multiple of the Tier 2 Living Quarters, reinforce the Keep’s outer walls probably and still have enough granite left over just to use later.
"Thank you, Sky," Vespera acknowledged smoothly, keeping her voice composed. "How do we execute the transfer? Do I need to bring in Cargo wagons?"
It was not like she did have any.
Sky laughed, shaking his head. "Cargo wagons? What is this, the dark ages? Hold out your right hand."
Vespera held out her right hand encased in the sleek silver-and-gold Sil-Grave Arm Guard.
Sky reached out, lightly pressing his gloved palm against her gauntleted fingers.
HUMMM!
A bright brilliant pulse of deep blue light erupted between their touching palms.
A spatial transfer channel established itself instantly between Sky’s inventory reserves and her sovereign system storage.
A sleek translucent blue system notification materialized directly before Vespera’s vision.
[RESOURCE TRANSFER RECEIVED]
+ RESOURCE: Obsidian-Slate Stone (Tier 2 High-Density Granite)
+ QUANTITY: 4,000 Units
+ SOURCE: Mobile Fortress ’The Unmovable Wall’ (Lord Sky)
[CURRENT INVENTORY LIMIT: 4,000 / 10,000 UNITS]
Vespera looked at the notification, verified the exact four-thousand-unit count sitting safely inside her Lord Inventory, and closed the window with a satisfied flick of her wrist.
"The transfer is complete," Vespera confirmed, pulling her hand back. "Thank you, Sky. I appreciate the generous bonus."
"Don’t worry about it!" Sky replied warmly, giving her a thumbs-up. "Consider it payment for the absurd stream numbers. Happy building, Lord..."
"Until next time," Vespera nodded.

Turning on her heel, Vespera walked back down the cargo ramp with Rowenna by her side, exiting the humid interior of the mobile fortress and stepping back out into the bright morning sun of the neutral clearing.
Out on the grassy perimeter, near the tree line where Sky’s perimeter guards were stationed, one of Sky’s elite Hero-class combatants was hard at work.
It was Hiro... the tall blind warrior dressed in lightweight, dark training tunic and trousers.
He was currently standing in a wide combat stance, practicing precise, high-speed sword slashes against a massive training post with his steel blade cutting through the in with whistling precision.
SWISH! SWISH!
Exiting the fortress holds, Vespera’s gaze briefly flickered toward Hiro’s sharp sword forms.
Seeing his clean blade execution, Silas felt a sudden, tempting urge ripple through his body.
He felt a strong desire to pull out his own blade and test out the Second Style of the Tide-Blade Arts.
...However, Silas quickly suppressed the urge.
He wasn’t entirely sure he had the intricate mana flow of the Second Style fully mastered yet at all so it would look like he was doing nothing but covering himself with water.

Executing an incomplete high-tier sword style in front of a rival Lord and his elite Hero would not only expose his physical combat techniques, but it would also put himself in unnecessary danger too.
’Patience,’ Silas reminded himself. ’I’ll practice it safely back at the Keep’s training grounds with Morwenna...’
Stepping over to the resting Blessed Wolf mounts, Vespera reached out her single gauntleted hand, gently patting the thick fur of Valkyrie’s head.
"Good girl..." The wolf let out a low, affectionate huff, lowering its snout so Vespera could smoothly swing her frame into the leather riding saddle.
Beside her, Rowenna stepped up to her own mount, Luna, fluidly climbing into the saddle and taking the reins with ease.
"Let’s head home, Rowenna," Vespera instructed softly.
"Understood, My Lord," Rowenna replied sweetly.

With a sharp tug on the reins, the two riders turned their giant Blessed Wolves around, kicking up small clouds of dust as they trotted away from The Unmovable Wall, disappearing into the dense forest paths leading back toward the Blessed Land.
Standing near the edge of the clearing, Lord Sky stood watching their retreating backs as the two wolf riders disappeared into the dark Ironwood canopy.
Sky reached up, slowly sliding off his dark sunglasses, his full-face streaming mask reflecting the shadowy forest horizon.
Beneath his mask, Sky’s face twisted into an intensely frustrated stress-filled grimace.
"Fuck..." Sky muttered under his breath, his voice laced with deep simmering anxiety.
Sky was a master at reading people, but Vespera was an enigma.
Every single time she visited his territory, she brought along a completely new, absurdly powerful individual...
Last time, it had been that silent shadow assassin who radiated an overwhelming physical killing intent and next it had been the Jade Beauty with ice magic.
Today, she had brought along this breathtaking woman in arcanist robes.
And yet... Sky hadn’t managed to catch even a brief, passing flicker of what class or elemental discipline this new woman actually possessed.

Sky possessed a high-tier passive sensory skill that allowed him to detect ambient magic signatures, but as he had watched Rowenna stand beside Vespera, her mana reserves had felt completely smooth and unreadable too.
Sky gripped his hair through his mask, feeling like he wanted to pull his hair out in frustration.
’Fuck! She’s a mage, I know she’s a mage!’ Sky screamed internally. ’But what kind of mage is she?! Fire?! Ice?! Spatial?! Void?! How the hell does Vespera keep finding these absurd S-Rank casters?!’
"Runes..." a quiet calm voice suddenly spoke from beside him.
Sky blinked, turning his head toward the training grounds.
Hiro was standing by his wooden training post, smoothly sheathing his steel sword into his scabbard with a soft sound.
CLICK!
The warrior walked over to Sky, pointing a long, callous finger toward the leather chair where Rowenna had been earlier.
